dkar chag47thog mar ngos 'dzin zhu stangs dang /grwa sar zhugs nas gzhung lugs rgya mtshor slob gnyer ji ltar mdzad tshul/2 dgung grangs nyi shur bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang /dge bshes lha rams pa'i rtsod rgyugs dam bca' sogs mdzad tshul/ 293 dgung grangs nyer bzhir rgyud grwar phebs nas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos sgor slob gnyer gnang tshul/ 334 rje pha bong kha pa sogs bshes gnyen du ma'i drung nas mdo sngags kyi zab chos rgya che gsan bzhes gnang tshul/ 475 7rgyal mchog sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen wa'i sku gdung zhabs zhu dang /gser sdong gsar bzhengs gnang tshul/ 596 dgung grangs so bzhi'i thog rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad dang /de rjes rgyud pa'i mkhan po gnang ste rgyud grwa'i 'chad nyan sgrig khrims legs par bskyangs tshul/ 637 mtshan zhabs dang /yongs 'dzin chung ba'i mtshan khur rim bzhes thogaspyi byer mdo sngags kyi zab chos rgya cher mdzad pa/ 858 dgung grangs zhe bdun thog dga' ldan shar pa chos rje'i khrir phebs nga 05

1 5 7skya bas rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen pa 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa 9 dgung grangs nga gcig thog sku ngas 'dzin che ba'i mtshan bzhes dang /rgya nag tu gzigs skor/ rgya gar dang / bal yul du gnas gzigs gnang ba/ 11310 phyi lo 1959 lo rgya gar la btsan byol du phebs rjes la dwags dang /ḍal hor/ sbag sa/ wār khā+e/rdor gdan bcas par phebs pa 13111 ma su ri nas dha sar spo shugs gnang rjes kyi mdzad pa'i lha ra/ 14312 dgung grangs re gsum la dga' ldan khri thog go bdun pa'i mtshan khur bzhes te bstan 'gro'i don chen ji ltar mdzad tshul/ 16313 sus si dang / 'jar ma ni/ dbyin yul/pha ran si bcas par phebs te 'acad don bskyangs tshul/ 18314 phyi lo 1980 'o/ra slar yang sku snga ba dang / byang a ri'i khul du zhabs sku ra bkod de 'gro don mdzad tshul/ 25515 mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don chen mdzad tshul sku gas spyi'i don bsdu ba/ 29916 dgung grangs gya gcig 10ga tshul bstan snyun bzhes kyis dbe/ngas pa mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan pa/ 30717 sku gdung ril bur bzhugs pa dang / gser zangs kyi byang chume mchod rten bzhengs pa/ 31718 mchog sprul yang srid brtag dpyad ngos 'dzin ji ltar zhus pa dang /ya mtshan can gyi mdzad pa 'ga' shas dpe mtshon tsam bcadad pa/ 323

༄༅༅//'jam mgon 7rgyal ba'i 7rgyal tshab 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang rje btsun thub bstan lung rtogs rnam rgyal 'phrin las dpal bzang ngo'i thun mong ba'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa nor bu'i+o do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs sa//

1thog mar ngos 'dzin zhu stangs dang / grwa sar zhugs nas gzhung lugs rgya mtshor stsodab gnyer ji ltar mdzad tshul/rungapo ra༅༅/ /oṃ su sti/ rgyal kun mkhyen rab dmar ser li khri'i rdul/ /mtshan dpe'i sku la sku gcig tu gtams pa la /'jam dpal dbyangs su snyan pa'i lhag pa'i lhas/ /'dzad med smra ba'i spobs pa mchog sbyin mdzod/ /gang nyid phyi nang gsang ba'i gshin rje yi/ / sbyin skyes dpung gi gshed du rab bzhengs pa/ /skal ldan rnam sad rnams kyi mabo na gcig pu / /bcom ldan skabs gsum bdag pos dge legs 〈tal/ /dus dgra'i dbang po nyid kyang dus mtha' 'dir/ /tha mal gar du sdudas pa'i brdzu bag gis/ /bgrang yas skye 'gror mngon mtho nges legs kyi/ /dga' ston chen po'i ngo mtshar ci yang byin/ /྅ba bstun 'dzin mkhas bshes gnyen gser ri'i dbus/ /srung dang ṭ+wā+oṃgs pa'i ba gam ches mtho zhing / /

ri 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa phyogs las /ma par shīl ba'i 'phyin swās kyi/ /snang byed zung gi rna chas sgeg der bsngags/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i yal 'dab khyon yangs shing / /gzhan phan 'bras bu g.yur du za ba yi /'khrungs rabs yongs 'du'i ljon phreng bstar pa las /ris med bstan pa'i nor 'dzin mdzes par mdzad/ /lhag par dge ldan ring lugs bsam 'phel nor/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i dpung pa brtan po yis/ /srid zhi'i do ker gtsug tu 'god mkhas pa/ /du ma zhig gis rang bstan bdag gir bzungs/ /kun gsal khyon dang mnyam par 'jug pa yi/ /gsang gsum sngo mtshar gzugs brnyan mtha' dag pa/ /rnam kun gzigs pa'i gzhal bya kho na las/ /byis pa'i blo yis gzhal bar ga la nus/ /de lta na yang mdzad pa'i cha shas 'ga'/ /tshur mthong 'dren byed yul du gsal ba rnams/ /mi phyed dad gsum pir gyi 'du byed kyis/ /dpyod ldan dga' ba'i gzigs mo 'di na bskrun/ /zhes yul dam pa la mchod par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pas ngag gi lam dge bar byas nas/ de yang bdag cag gi rnam par 'dren pa chen po 'di nyid bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i snga rol nas rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar phyin te phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams dang

thog mar ngos 'dzin zhu stangs dang / grwa sar zhugs nas gzhung lugs rgya mtshor slob gnyer 3mnyam pa nyid gsum gyi lha nas mnyam pa'i go 'phang mthar thug mngon du mdzad de 'phrin las lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i sgo nas gang 'dul sprul pa'i rol gar mkha' khyab yid can gyi khyon dang mnyam par 'jug pa'i tshul sogs gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas mtha' dag ni/ chos sku mkha' khyab kyi dbyings su 'dres pa'i bdag nyid chen sngo nang phan tshun kho na'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul las so so skye bo tha mal pa rnams kyis 'di dang 'di zhes gzhal bar dka' zhing / sku ngas su grub pa'i 'khrungs rabs kyi dbang du byas na yang / khyim pa 'dul ba la mchog tu gyur pa nyan thos chen po dgra bcom pa 'char ka nas bzung sku 'phreng gong ma rje btsun blo bzang lung rtogs bstan 'dzin 'phrin las dpal bzang khra'i bar mkhas dang grub pa'i skyes bu mu tig bstar la rgyus pa ltar rim par byon te/ gas nga sngags gsar rnying ris su ma chad pa'i bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul sogs brjod par 'os pa mtha' yas pa zhig mchis mod/ 'dir 'god pa'i ngal ba ma bsten zhing / skabs su babs pa sku 'phreng 'di nyid kyis gtso bor 7rgyal ba'i bstan pa la thos bsam sgom gsum dang /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mdzad pa rmad du byung ba'i sgo nas rjes 'jug rnam dpyod dang /blo nor ldan pa dag la yang dag pa'i lam bzang po gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul rags tsam zhig 'god pa la/ gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ bsil ldan gangs kyi rwa bas bskor ba'i ljongs la bod dang / bod chen po gnyis su phye ba'i bod de la sngar chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi dus dbus gtsang ru bzhir grags pa'i dbu ru'i sa/ dge bcu'i yon tan mtha' dag tshang ba'i skyid shod dam/ lha ldan rgyal sa nas brtsis pa'i nub byang gi phyogs nyin lam gcig tsam gyi sar dpal 'khor lo sgyu ma pa yab yum gyi gnas su grags pa'i yab phu zhes pa'i sa khul de yin/ de ni gnam sa chos 'byung gi dbyibs can/ rgyab ri rin chen spungs pa 'dra ba/ g.yas g.yon gyi ri'i ngos su dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge'i rnam pa dang / mdun ri dar gyi yol bas khres pa lta bu'i dbus su ra tsa zhes pa'i ri khrod du rten

3 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rirdo rje 'chang chen dzo 'a mu dzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pri gyi gtso bo paṇa chen nā ro pa chen wa'i thugs dam gyi cen nā ro ma/kha' spyod ma'i sku brnyan gsung lan mang drodan pa'i mthong bo/la byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che bas dbus rten khyad par can mang du bzhugs shing / 'khrungs khang dkar bog ces pa'i grong chung de dang / ra tsa ri khrod gnyis kyi bar mkha' 'bor+sāsno gseg lam zhes pa'i lam chung brgyud de song na thag nye lam babo da bde ba yod/ rgyab ri'i ngos su dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi pho brang du grags pa'i brag ri brtsegs ma zhig kyang mjal du sku/da pa sogs la brten nas yul de'i ming la yang yab ces yongs su grags/ rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas lha sa sku/gas nas mchod 'bul zhu mkhan dad ldan ser skya pho sna/ zam mi chad par rgyu bar ma zad/ skyes chen dam pa mang pos gnas der sgrub pa mdzad nas nyams rtogs kyi chodang rdol ba'i lo rgyus kyang shin tu mang / de yang so so skye bo bdag lta bus skyes bu dam pa de nyid kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa 'di dang 'di lta bu'o zhes gzhal bar dka' mod/ 'ol tshod kyis dpyad na/ bdag cag gi rtsaba'i bla ma nyid thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum dang / 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i lam la brten nas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon sngo ra gshegs par gyur ba dang / rjes 'jug rnams la yang kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi zung 'jug gi go 'phang myur du thob par 'dod na yi dam 'di dang 'di lta bur brten par rigs so zhes 'doms par mdzad pa dang / khul de'i skye bo rnams kyang mthong thos dran reg gi sgo nas rjes su 'dzin par mdzad pa'i ched yul der 'khrungs sam snyam/ yab yum gnyis kyi rigs rus 'byung khungs sogs 'dri rtsad byed yul khungs ldan ma rnyed kyang / 7rgyal mchog sku 'phreng bcu pa'i yab gzhis sger g.yu thog pa'i sgra chen gzhis kha'i khongs dkar bog ces pa'i khyim tshang ha cang dbu(ra ngo/ zhig tu yab kun dga' tshe ring dang / yum bsod nams bde skyid gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ de yang dam pri 'i skye bo rnams rgyal rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i rigs su 'khrungs pa dang / dbul phyug bar ma'i thum du 'khrungs

thog mar ngos 'dzin zhu stangs dang / grwa sar zhusas nas gzhung lugs rgya mtshor slob gnyer 5pa sogs de la dgos pa dang / rgyu mtshan khyad par can ldan zhing / dam pa 'di nyid bsam bzhin du dbul wa'i khyim du 'khrungs pa ni tshe rabs du mar dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun te dam pa'i skyes mchog 'di nyid kyi yab yum du 'gyur bar smon pa'i skye bo gnyis rjes su gzung ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis nga'i bstan nga la rigs dang / rus mi gtso/ chos gtso bo yin no zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 7rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin cing spel ba la thos bsam sgom gsum la sku/gas pa'i yon tan las gzhan rigs rus sogs la mi ltos sku/ zhes 'doms par mdzad pa yin nam snyam/ 'khrungs pa'i dus ni phri lo chig lha nga dgu brgya bcu med gnyis/ bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu yos zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes drug zhogs pa tho rengs skabs yin zhing / de yang grod thum can du yod par yum ci byed som nyir gyur skabs a ye zhes gsung byon te/ phyag 'gul bakhyodad kyi stodabs kyis spo da thum gyi rgya las grol ba red ces bshad srol du mchis/ sku phreng gong ma rje btsun blo bzang lung rtogs bstan 'dzin 'phrin las de nyid chu stag zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad dgung grangs zhe bdun la phebs skabs zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul mdzad pa/ rnam pa gcig tu na sku tshe mdzad pa mthar ma phyin pa lta bur mngon yang / don du gong ma de nyid slar yang bdag sogs bstan 'gro'i mgon du mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam par rol te/ bod yul chos ldan gyi zhing sar rgyal bstan nyin byed ches cher 'bar ba'i skabs mkhas grub du ma'i mdun nas dbang lung man ngag sogs cha tshang gsan/ lung 'o/gas bstan pa'i bdag por gyur te thub bstan spyi dang / bye brag blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i srog bzung ba skabs su babs pa dang / lhag par du pad dkar 'chang ba'i skye 'phreng bcu bzhi pa bdag la yi se sbyor klog nas bzung mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi gdams pa rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du bstsal bar bzhed nga ma zad/ ston pri sa 7rgyal ba'i bstan pri byang nas byang dang / de nas slar yang dbus su dar bar 'gyur bar lung bstan nga ldar bod ljongs chos kyi zhing sar rgyal

6 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo lnge 'chang chen po' mjad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa ba'i bstan pa ming med lta bur gyur rjes rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab tu mngon par bzhengs te/ bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa sogs kyi slad du dus de lta bur sku 'khrungs pa yin par gdon mi za'o/ /de lta bu'i yab yum gnyis la rigs kyi myu gu bgres shos dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'di nyid dang / bu 'od zer/ bu mo bag gro gnyis las med cing bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid yum gyi lhums su bzhugs bzhin pa'i skabs yab lha sa khul du lci ba btsong bar phebs par khal 'gol byed bong bu shi ba sogs kyi 'tshub cha byung ba ni chos zab bdud zab kyi dpe ltar dam pa'i skyes bu 'di nyid sku bltams te 7rgyal ba gnyis pa lta bu'i bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher mdzad par 'gyur ba la chu srin rgyal mtshan sder gtogs dang bcas pas bar gcod rtsom pa yin nam snyam/ yab sku gshegs pa'i rkyen dang / dus tshod sku gas gsal po ma shes kyang / rin po che nas yab dngos su gzigs ma myong zhes sku'i gam bcar ba dag la dngos su gsungs/ dam pa 'di nyid de lta bu'i sku'i na tshod ches phra ba'i skabs nas kyang skye bo phal pa'i ngang tshul las 'das pa zhig sku da par gor ma chag kyang / mdzad pa zhib cha'i skor 'dri yul khungs ldan ma rnyed pas 'dir 'god par ma nus/ de yang sku gong ma zhi bar gshegs rjes gong ma'i sku tsha dang / gsol dpon gnyis ka yin pa byams pa blo bzang nas yang srid slor 7gong sa bcu gsum pa chen po mchog la thugs dam dang /gnas dga' gnyis la lung brtag zhus pa'i phyir phebs su nor gling skal bzang pho brang gi gaṭ+wā+oṃ la'i thad drangs nub byang dang khad nye bar/sku 'phreng gong ma'i dus nas te/ /de nas brtsis nga/'i lho phyogs su /sku gsung thugs gsum gcig bsdus kyi/ /yang sri da 'khrul bral de la yod/ /

thog mar ngos 'dzin zhu stangs dang / grwa sar zhugs nas gzhung lugs rgya mtshor slob gnyer 7ces sogs phebs shing / slar yang dga' gdong bstan srung chen pri+o sa yul ni yab ces bya ba yin zhes sku gas kyi bka' lung bstsal bar brten 'khrungs yul yab kyi nang yin pa gsal 'phrod byung ste yang srid rtsad gcod zhu phyogs skor la the tshom gyi dra ba chod/ rgyu mtshan ni yab phu 'es pa'i yul de nor gling skal bzang pho brang nas brtsis pa'i nub byang gi phyogs dang / gling sku gong ma 'khrungs yul 'phan po rag ma'i lha phyogs su rgyab mdun gyi tshul du yod pa red/ de nas yab phu zhes pa'i grong chung der skyes pa'i khye'u rtags mtshan dang ldan pa ji yod 'tshol zhib skabs 'bras spungs spyi so'i mi ser/ byang kha lho nga/'i bu slo bzang rgya mtsho dang / dkar bog bi bu bsod nams dbang ldan/ phug po che'i gzhis lnga'i khral pa'i bu ye shes rnam dag bcas mtshan rtags bzang bar brten de gsum gyi nang nas yang srid 'khrul bral su yin skor dga' gdong gnas srung chen dze ra lung zhu phul bar gnas srung nyid nas 'di yin zhes zhal gsal ma phebs par 'di'i skor re dogs chod phyir slob dpon mthong ba don ldan rgya sog gi yul gyur zhabs 'khod sar 'gro dgos tshul phebs pa ltar gsol dpon byams pa rlo bzang ngo 'khor lha sa nas lnga na/ de sngon gsol dpon byams pa blo bzang nyid nas dga' gdong gnas srung chen po rten gzhir spyan drangs te thag ring rgya sog gi yul gyur yang srid 'khrul med sngo sa 'dzin zhu ched 'gro rgyu'i skor 'gal rkyen bral zhing / bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i skyabs zhu bgyis skabs bar chad phran bu sku da srid kyang / 'dre ngos nas sngar bzhin 'phrin las byed ces gsungs pa ltar zhabs phyi 'ga' shas thag ring 'gro 'dod med par brten phri nang lag 'brel lta bu'i rkyen pas byang thang zhig la dgong mo mtshan rub brgyab ste gur thag bcad pa dang rdo rub sogs brgyabs kyang / skyon cha che ba ma byung zhing / de 'phral dogs gzhi can gyi zhabs phyi rnams sa gnas de ga rang nas phyir slog byas/ gsol dpon de nyid dus rgyun gnas chung la rlo rtse gcig tu gtad

8 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling dril sdo rje 'chang chen nga 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod nga mkhan zhig la brten/ gnas chung sku phebs kyi 'dra sku gzim chung du bzhugs pa zhig yod pa lhan du gdan zhus ltar sku 'dra'i na bza'i rgyan du er ka yod pa nas skad sgra bsgrags pa red ces bshad srol mchis/ gang lta ra yang chos srung dam can rgya maṣ+ṭharware las bzhi'i 'phrin las g.yel ba med par brten 7rgyal mchog sku sku nga ma mkha' 'gro ching bi nga rda khu ral gyi dason bkra shis lhun po gling du bzhugs 'jags skabs bde 'byor gyis de 'phral mjal phyag zhus te yang srid rin po che rtsad gcod ji ltar zhus lugs skor gyi gnas tshul zhib cha snyan khyodan thog gong gsal khye'u gsum gyi nang nas gong ma'i yang srid 'khrul bral ngos 'dzin zhu 'os su cher thugs dam ye r+shas gzigs dpyad skyabs 'jug zhus pa'i phyir phebs su/ dkar bog gi bu bsod nams dbang ldan gyi mtshan sngo ga tu yang srid 'khrul med yin pa'i phyag rtags dang 'brel thub bstan lung 'o/gas rnam rgyal 'phrin las zhes pa'i mtshan gsol dang / brtan bzhugs smon tshig 'chi med 'dod rgu'i mchog khyojil zhes bya ba yang ljags rtsom mdzad/ 7gong sa bcu gsum pa chen ngo'i gsung 'bum gyi gras su bzhugs pa'i zhabs brtan smon tshig gi mdzad byang du/ gling bla brang gi mdzod pa nas yang srid skor phan cha'i skul ma ma byung yang / ngos kyi yongs 'dzin dam pa'i bka' drin dran zhing ma hā rā dzar brtag pa bgyis par yid ches rnyed cing / zhes sogs gsungs pa/ skabs de'i bla brang gi phyag mdzod lho kha dar rgyas gling gi grwa rigs shig yin 'dug pa khong gis lho kha phyogs su yang srid dogs gzhi can gyi byis pa zhig yod pa de yang srid yin nges kyi re ba chen po byas te khye'u gzhan rnams la de tsam gyis do snang ma byas pa yin tshod snang / gong gsal ltar gong ma'i 'khrungs yul 'phan po rag ma dang / da lta'i rin po che 'khrungs yul ra tsa bcas sku 'phreng snga phyi gnyis ka ra yig ming gzhi yod sar 'khrungs pa ni rwa lo tsā ba'i sku'i rnam 'phrul yin nga/ mtshon byed red ces babad srol kyang mchos/ 7rgo+ol mchog sku song mas gyosol dpri+o na byams nga blo bzang la yang srid khri gsol bya rgyus mtshon byed sgo'i

thog mar ngos 'dzin zhu stangs dang / grwa sar zhugs nas gzhung lugs/ rgya mtshor slob gnyer 9skor bka' slob gzab nan gnang ba ltar/ bong lha sar phebs 'byor mtshams na bza' sgron 'bul dang 'brel sgar pa ri khrod du gdan zhus kyis 7bong ma na rim gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos kyi khri 'phang mthon sngo ra mnga' gsol/ de yang 'khrungs khang dkar ho ga nas gdan zhus kyis 'ogs pa snga sngo ra rwa che'i gtsug lag khang gi nye 'dabs skor lam du phebs pa dang rgyud stod grwa tshang gi zhogs tshogs kyi 'khar rnga brdung ba dus mtshungs byung tshul grwa bgres rnams nas gsungs pa ltar na/ dam pa 'di nyid rjes su dpal ldan rgyud stodad grwa tshang du sgrig zhugs kyis rgyud sde rgya mtshor gsan bsam sgom pa mthar phyin/ de nyid bcu zung dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi ston pa chen por bzhengs te rdo rje thog mar ngos 'dzin zhu stangs dang / grwa sar zhugs nas gzhung lugs rgya mtshor slob gnyer 19pa chen mo'i bshad lung bstsal ba gsan cing / de skabs rtsod pa sems bskyed skor la phebs sku da tshul gsungs/ de rjes 7rgyal mchog sku gong ma gnas chen yer par chibs bsgyur gnas gzigs grub ste mar lam sgar pa ri kho da du 7zhabs sor 'khod de gnas gzigs dang / sku 'phreng gong ma shar chos yongs 'dzin gling rin po che rje btsun blo bzang lung rtogs bstan 'dzin 'phrin las dpal bzang 16) gdung rten rin po che'i mdun du mchod 'bul sogs mdzad/ nyin gcig ri khrod kyi rgyab ngos spang gshongs zhig tu 7gong sa chen po spro seng lta bur bzhugs gdan 'jags skabs rin po che yang gdan zhu gnang / de gar sku gong ma'i gzim khyi chung chung 'ga' shas yod pa tshos 'chang skabs yongs 'dzin rin po ches kha rog sdod ces gsungs par 7rgyal mchog sku bonang mas gzim khyi kha rog bzhugs zhes zhe sa gnang dgos tshul bka' phebs byung zhes rjes sor yang yang gsungs/ de rjes shig la 7skyabs rje pha bong kha rin po che ri khrod du gdan zhus kyis bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang chen dang / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs bcas gsan te de nas bzung lhag pa'i lha mchog de dag gi bdag bskyed dang / thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsung rgyu sogs phyag bzhes ltar mdzad/ dus tshes gsal bar ma shes kyang rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha par thugs dam gyi lha gang la las 'brel che ba dang / shes rab kyi lha gang bsten na legs tshul thugs dam zhu gnang gi bka' lan du/yab gcig rgyal kun mkhyen rab gar /rab sgeg ga'on nu'i sku spangs nas/ /zhi dul ngur smrig zhing 'di'i dang la/ /blo bzang rgyal bas khyod skyongs thig /

yodad/ de ga re byas nas dran pa yin nam zhes rnam thar dang / khengs skyungs sbrags nas 'bras chod gling shag skor mkhan zur nyi ma rgyal mtshan mchog la bka' bstsal 'dug sgo chod gnyis kyi blo gsal ba rnams 'bras spungs rigs grwa'i skabs tshogs chen du so so'i snu/sa 'dems kyis bla ma gzhung las par zhu skul dang 'brel gzhung chen tshogs langs bya srol ltar mabo na po mchodag gis skabs bzhi pa'i tshogs langs thugs 'dems gnang ste tshogs langs dngos gzhi'i sngon du bod zla gnyis pa'i nang dpyid chos chen sna/ nas bzung tshogs langs dam bca' ma zin bar rigs smra'i khyu rgyan nyag re bkra shis rnam rgyal dang lhan du blo gling khongs kyi khang tshan khag dang / 'dzin grwa khag dbyar chodas chen mo'i skabs tshogs chen rdo gcal mthil du dam bca' 'jo ga rgyu sogs sngar srol ltar gnang / phyi thog mar ngos 'dzin zhu sdangs dang / grwa sar zhugs nas gzhung lugs rgya ma tshor slob gnyer 23bstan pa sogs nas mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom las brtsams pa'i brgal brtag ji snyed cig zhus rung / mkhas pa dgyes pa'i gsung lan chodags med du bstsal ba skabs der rtsod dpang du yod pa'i mkhas pa dag gi zhal nas thos/ bod zla bdun pa'i tshes brgyad klu 'bum dus chen nyin rin po che dang / lha mang grwa tshang nas sku 'bum 'gag shing zhabs drung ngam/mang ra zhabs drung zer ba rnam gnyis mang ja'i thog grwa tshang bzhi'i dge 'dun phal cher tshang 'dzoms kyi spyan sngar snu gas langs dngos bzhi mdzad skabs 'gag shing nas/ sher phyin nyan pa'i snod rung gi skor/sangs rgyas rnams la lha ga par byas/ /de la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun/ /zhes pa las brtsams te bgro gleng dang / rin po che nas bdud kyi mthu ba3)ma la sogs pa/ /zhes pa las 'phros te brgal brtags mdzad/ phar phyin la gsan sbyong grub rjes/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa gtan la 'bebs pa/ shing rta chen po klu sgrub zhabs kyi dbu ma rigs tshogs drug dang / de'i nang gi rtsa she la zab pa dang / rgya che ba'i tshul gnyis kyi lha nas 'jug pa/ 'phags yul gyi slob dpon chen 14 zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i 'jug pa ma'agrel/ 'jam mgon tsong kha pa chen pos mdzad nga 'i ṭika chen rigs pa'i rgya mtsho dang / rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i dbu ma'i spyi don dang / mtha' dpyod bcas gtsor bzung gis dbu ma'i gzhung spyi dang /nang gses thal zlog bden gnyis/ tshad 'bo ga bdag 'gog sogs dbu ma'i dka' gnad che rigs khag dang bcas par zhib tu sbyangs par mdzad/ dbu tshad seṅge mjing bsnol zhes grags pa ltar zab mo dbu mo'e lta ba gtan la 'bebs nga la med du mi rung ba tshad ma'i gzhung la thos bsam bya slad tshad ma'i gzhung gi 'chad nyan gtso bor bzung ba'i mnyes thang

24 4skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sbrul rngo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i ma dzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa stag tshang rwa ba stod pa zhes pa'i chos sde zhig yod pa de'i dge 'dun rnams lo ltar bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes shar nas zla ba phyed gnyis ring lha sa'i nub phyogs 'jang zhes pa'i khul du 'jang dgun chos kyi codas chodag chen mo tshugs skabs gdan sa chen sngotsware slob gnyer ba rnams kyang tshad ma'i gzhung la sbyangs brtson gnang ched chos thog der phebs srol ltar mgon po mchodag dang yongs 'dzin rin po che yang zhabs sor 'khod/ 'bras nyag re khang tshan dang / gling khang tshan gnyis lnga'i khongs kyi dge 'dun rnams kyang de skabs rwa stod nyag re'i dge 'dun rnams dang lhan gcig tu bzhugs te chos dang zang 4zeng gi dga' ston la longs su spyad de nyag re'i spyi khang gi yang thog der bzhugs/ thog mar rtags rig gi 'dzin grwar phebs nas blo rtags dang / de rjes tshad chen 'dzin grwar phebs te kun mkhyen gnyis pa dbyig gnyen zhabs kyi lho ba ma tshad ma rang 'a sa mkhas pri / slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa'i tshad ma kun btus kyi dgongs 'grel du rigs pa'i dbang phyug dpal chos kyi grags pas tshad ma sde bdun du grags pa mdzad pa 'i nang chan gtso bo lus lta bu'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel dang / de'i 'grel pa rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyis mdzad nga/'i rnam 'grel thar lam gsal byed/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas mdzad pa'i dka' 'grel dgongs pa rab gsal bcas gzhir bzung ste tshad ma'i gzhung la thos bsam mdzad/sngon gyi rigs pa'i dbang phyug gong ma rnams nas srol btod mdzad pa ltar rigs smra nang phan sngon gzhung chen lnga'i dgongs don bgro gling byed skabs lus kyi rnam 'gyur dang bcas lag pa brdabs srol yod pa bzhin/ skabs der dgun dus grang sbang dang / sa khul der grang ngar shin tu che bas chos grwa'i nang rigs pa smra ba ga'an rnams dang lhan du babo gleng gnang skabs phyag brdabs pa dang grang ngar gnyis 'dzadams dbang gis phyag mdzub kyi bar seng sogs nas sku sha gas te sku khrag thon kyang / sazhung don la thugs g.yeng ba'i dbang bos ma mkhyen par slar gzim shas tu phebs zin rjes sku gzugs jo sa skabs phyag la tsha

thog mar ngos 'dzin zhu stangs dang / grwa sar zhugs nas gzhung lugs rgya mtshor slob gnyer 25zug mngon pa de 'dra lan mang byung zhes gsungs/ khang tshan du mtshan 'bud dam bcar bzhugs par zab cing myur ba'i gsung lan la brten nas bgro gleng zhu mkhan mang po mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin dgos pa byung / dgun chos grol nye'i skabs brag g.ya ba gdong kong sprul sku zhes rjes su lam rim rnam grol lag bcangs kyi zin bris dang po 'god mkhan de dang lhan du grwa tshang du tshogs langs skabs gdong kong sprul skus dkon brtsegs kyi lung /'od srungs 'di lta ste/ dper na zla ba tshes pa la phyag bya ba ltar nya ba la ma yin no/ /'od srungs de bzhin du gang dag nga la rab tu dad pa de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag bya yi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la ni ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' las ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'byung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa las ni/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ngo zhes pa las brtsams te rtsod pa zhus/de nas rin po ches rtags gsal phar btang gnang ste bgro gleng mdzad/ chos thog grol mtshams yar zhor mnyes thang rwa ba stod du phebs/ nyag re khang tshan gyi yang thog tu bzhugs zhag gcig gnang / gnas gzigs dang 'brel der tshad ma'i bshad nyan sogs mi nyams yun du gnas pa'i thugs smon bskyangs/ de nas 'bras spungs su phebs/ 'jang dgun chos su lan grangs ji phebs sogs kyi gnas tshul gsal bar ma shes kyang gdan sa chen po rang du bzhugs skabs kyang zhor du rnam 'grel gyi gzhung la gzigs rtogs mdzad pa la brten nas gzhan sde mu stegs can 'ga' shas kyis sdug bsngal la rgyu med par 'dzin pa/'ga' zhig gis rgyu yod kyang / spyi gtso bo dang / dbang phyug la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i rgyu las byung bar 'dzin pa dang / don ma yin pa'i dka' thub/ dbang phyug gis dbang bskur ba sogs lam ma yin nga la yin par 'dzin pa/ thar pa ma yin pa thar par 'dzin pa sogs mdor na de dag gis gzhi lam 'bras bu las brtsams te los pa'i grub mtha' ji ltar 'jog pa/'i tshul/ de dag la sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' rnams kyis dri ma med pa'i

rgyud bzang ba'i snyan grags shin tu che zhing / 'ga' zhig nas gzhan gyi drung nas dpe khrid zhus pa las/ dge bshes 'di nyid kyi drung nas dpe cha khrid na shes sla bar yod tshul zer srol kyang mchis/ la 7rgyal dbang sku gong ma bcu gsum pa chen pos rwa stod grwa tshang gi mkhan por bsko bzhag bstsal ba ltar mkhan thog lo bcu'i ring rgyun du phyag dpe sha stag khrid par mdzad/ de rjes gsang phu gling stod zhabs drung lo gsum gnang / de nas pha yul du phebs/ sa dkar ri khrod du bzhugs te phyogs der dpe khrid mdzad pa sogs bstan par sman pa'i mdzad rjes shin tu che ba zhig tu gsal/ dbu ma'i gsan bzhes grub rjes 'dul ba'i 'dzin grwar phebs te bstan pa'i nang mdzod 'dul pa'i kun spyod gtso bor ston pa pha ma'i so thar gyi mdo dang / 'dul ba lung sde bzhi sogs rtsa bshad kyi mdo'i dgongs thog mar ngos 'dzin zhu stangs dang / grwa sa ra zhusas nas gzhung lugs rgya mtshor slob gnyer 27kun mkhyen ma tsho sna ba chen wa'i rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer/ 7rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyi gsung 'dul ṭika rin chen phreng ba/ paṇa chen bsku da nams grags pa'i 'dul ba'i mtha' dpyod bcas gzhir bzung 'dul ba'i gzhung spyi dang / nang gses cho ga'i skor lnga phrugs/spang ltung thun mong ba/ sde lnga'i ngos 'dzin/ zhu ba spyir bstan/ bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba'i gzhi gsum sogs gzhi bcu bdun gyi skor la sbyangs pa mdzad/ de rjes theg dman gyi spyod pa'i rnam bzhag gtan la 'bebs pa/ mngon pa sde bdun gyi dgongs 'grel/ dbyig gnyen zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i mngon pa mdzod dang / mchims 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi 'grel pa mngon pa rgyan/ rje dge 'dun grub pa'i mdzod ṭika thar lam gsal byed bcas gtsor bzung gis shes bya gzhi lnga'i rang spyi'i mtshan nyid/ bden bzhi'i 'jug ldog lam dang gang zag 'bras bu yongs shes/ nyan rang 1/gas dang / thun sna/nga dang thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan sogs rgyas par ston pa'i masngoran pa 'og ma'i gzhung la sbyangs pa dpyis phyin par mdzad/ chodas mtshams skabs rgan lo yag rin po che nas skabs re nyin gang sngo ra dpe khrid gnang zhing / mchims mdzod dang / mtsho ṭika cha tshang tshig gcig kyang ma lus par mdzub khrid gnang stabs 'dul mdzod la bgro gleng skabs gzhung ma mthong ba de 'dra yong gi med ces gsungs/ de yang rang rnam las/ skabs der rang nyid lo na chung stabs rtsed 'jo sogs kyi rnam g.yeng dang / le lo che yang / gsol dpon dam pa mchog nyid dang / yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bka' drin can rnam gnyis kyis 'jam rtsub thabs mkhas sna tshogs kyi sgo nas khyod gsum gyi bya ba ngo na ldan gyi gnas la sbyor zhing / thos bsam slob gnyer la bskul ma mthil phyin gnang ba'i bka' drin dang / de 'brel blo gsal rigs pa smra ba'i chos kyi grogs rnams nas kyang mdzes zol med par lung dang rigs pa'i lam nas gzhung gi dka' gnad sogs la blo bskyed phan grogs sgo du ma nas bstsal ba bcas la brten lo ngo bcu gnyis ring thos bsam slob gnyer la brtson pa phran bu bsten pa'i nyer

2dgung grangs nyi shur bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang / dge bshes lha ra mas pa'i rtsod rgyugs dam bca' sogs mdzad tshul/khe /zhe༄༅//phri lo 922lor rin po che dgung grangs nyi shur phebs par lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i dus chen skabs rtse gzim chung sa gsum rnam rgyal du tshigs snga ma'i mkhan po 7rgyal ma6)ga sku gong ma bcu gsum pa chen pos mkhan slob sbrags ma mdzad de dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su da chog nyes med phun tshogs kyi sgo nas bslab gzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa bstsal/lo der nyin gcig blo gling mkhan po go thod blo bo/sa rgyal mtshan nas dge bshes ming rtags 'bul ched gdan zhus ltar grwa tshang gi yang thog mkhan wa'i gzim chung du phebs te sku phyag lan gsum sngon du 'bo/ ba'i sgo nas mjal dar rten dod bcas phul zin 'phral mkhan ho/sa da phan gsan bsam mdzad tshul sogs la bsngags brjod dang 'brel 'byung 'gyur shing byi lo'i lha ldan smon lam skabs rab 'byams pa shin mtshan bzhes rgyu yin stabs da dung yang mu mthud gsan bsam sngar bzhin gnang dgos pa'i bka' slob dang sbrags mjal dar yang phul/phyi lor dpyid chos chen mo tshugs skabs nas bzung phyag dpe ljags klogre gi skabs dang bstun gzhung de dang de'i 'dzin grwa so sor dam bcar phebs rgyu dang /slob gnyer legs gras kyi khang tshan 'ga' shas la thengs gsum re cam dang /gzhan rnams la thengs gnyis las mi nyung bar

zhes khas len gnang bar ser byes bya bral ba ngag dbang phun che gas dang / lwa ba ye thes sogs nas ha las las kyis bgro gleng zhus kyang 'al rtsod r+shar ba sogs ma byung / de sngon dge bshes rnams sadan sa so so'i mkhan pos dbe bshes kyi ming ji ltar 'dogs pa ltar rang 'jags las/gzhung gnas nas rtsod rgyugs ba'es sdudal med kyang / lo shas song nas sku 'phreng bcu gsum pa chen pri+o sa gdan sa'i 'chad nyan 'phe ra rgyas ched gzim chung nyi 'od du rgyugs bzhes dang

dgung grangs nyi shur bsnyen pa ra rdzogs nga dang / dge bshes lha rams nga 'i rtsod rgyugs 31'brel rtsod rgyugs go 'pher ma byung ba rnams phyir 'bud gnang gi yod stabs nyid kyi yongs 'dzin rgan lo yag rin po che nas rtsod rgyugs phebs gras slob gnyer phran bu zhan rigs nas tshur rtags gsal 'bul dus 'dzin mtshams dam sngo gnang ba/ yang khong tsho la phar rtags gsal gtong ba gnang dus ha cang sgrub byed tsha po gnang ba sku/gas kyis rkyen pas 'ga' shas dge bshes lha rams pa'i gral du ma tshud pa lta bu byung na mi legs pas de ltar ma gnang zhes bka' slob phul ba ltar mdzad/ 'di ni bla slob gnyis gas bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems la thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad pa'i rang rtags bla na med pa shin tu bsngags par 'os pa'i gnas su 'khums/ dgun chos chen motsware skabs 'bras spungs tshogs chen du mang ja sku 'gyed/ blo gling grwa tshang dang khang tshan khag bcas par gsol ja/bzhes thug 'bras tsha/ sku 'gyed/ spyi 'bul bcas kyi bsnyen bkur gya nom pa gnang /grwa tshang chos grwar dam bca' nyin gnyis bzhag skabs bla brang du chos grogs dge bshes tshang ma tshogs chen mang ja tshugs pa dang dus mnyam par gdan zhus kyis gasku/la ja dang / gsol ba/ thud/ chu tshod dgu pa tsam la gro ma mar khu/ nyin dgung dang / dgong mo bcas par gsol tshigs gzab rgyas phul/ chos grwar phebs skabs ma gtogs lhan bzhugs kyis phan tshun gzhung don la bgro gleng mdzad/ nyid kyi dam bca'i skabs tsam du ma zad/ dge bshes gzhan dam bcar lan 'debs rogs dgos rigs rnams kyi ched du yang gsung lan gnang ste rogs pa mdzad/ phyi lo 1924 shing byi lha ldan cho 'phrul chen mor gdan sa gsum dang / rgyud grwa rnam gnyis bcas kyi mkhan bla/ bla sprul/ bka' rams dge bshes/ rigs pa smra ba'i blo gsal mkhas mang bcas dge 'dun khri phrag 'dus pa'i dbus su bod zla dang tho'i tshes bcu nyin grwa bskor dam bca' dngos gzhi 'khel bar brten zhogs pa gsung chos rwa bar blo gsal las dang po ba shas che ba nas blo rtags/ bsdus grwa/ rnam 'grel bcas kyi bgro gleng / nyin dgung la skal bzang khyams ru mtshungs gzhong pa lha chu zhes dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang slob dpon rin po ches rdzu 'phrul gyis chu gsar du bton par grags pa der byon te nya rnams la zas sbyin gyis tshim par mdzad/ de ltar rgyud pa'i chos 'grims lo gcig gi ring tshogs chos su phebs rgyu sogs gang cir rgyud grwa rnams kyis bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor ba'i yul du gyur/ gtso bor rgyud don la dri ma med pa'i rigs pas dpyad pa zhib mor mdzad cing/ zhar la gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi bdag mdun bum gsum/ chos khyodang rnams kyi bskang gso/ gtor chen rab gnas sogs grwa tshang gi cho ga phyag len sogs la sbyangs pa dpyis phyin par mdzad/

dgung grangs nyer bzhir rgyud grwar phebs nas bsang sngags rjo rje theg pa 'i chos sgor 41phyi lo 1925 bod shing glang lor rgyud stod du sngags kyi dam bca' 'jog mkhan dge bshes lha rams pa rnams nor gling du bcar dgos pa mkhan po brgyud brda tho 'byor pa ltar nor gling du rtsod rgyugs la phebs/ dga' ldan khri rin po che dang / shar byang gi chos rje rnam gnyis sogs rtsod dpang rnams lhan 'dzoms sar thog mar rin po che dam bcar bzhugs pa la rim bzhin rnam 'grel/ phar phyin/ dbu ma/ 'dul ba/ mdzod/ sngags kyi skor bcas te gzhung chen drug la dge bshes gnyis res bgro gleng zhus/ de nas dge bshes gzhan rnams dam bcar bsdad pa la rin po ches gzhung gang 'khel de dang de'i dri ba mdzad/ de ltar rtsod rgyugs la phebs pa'i grub 'bras su dam pa 'di nyid ang rim dang por phebs pas lo de rang la sngags kyi dam bca' 'jog gnang mdzad dgos pa ltar paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus snyu gas rim gyi phyed tsam dang / rgyud stod ṭika yang thugs 'dzin gnang ste rje bdag nyid chen pos mdzad pa'i sngags rim chen mo/ rdzogs rim rim lnga gsal sgron sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas pa dang grub pa'i bdag nyid chen po du ma zhig gis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa 'grel bshad dang sbrags te rgyud sde bzhi lnga'i skor la sbyangs pa lhag par mdzad/ yer par dbyar gnas skabs bod zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer lnga nyin dgung tshigs mang jar phebs te gdong gral g.yon pa'i gral mgor bla ma dbu mdzad dang zhal sprod du bzhugs/ byang 'dren nas rje kun dga' don grub kyi gsol 'debs dbu bskul zhus pa ltar lhan gsungs zin rjes tshang mas ri dwags sgra la chags pa ltar dga' dad spro gsum gyi ngang nas gsan bzhin du bzhugs par snyan cing 'jibs pa'i gsung gi dbu 'phangs bstod de 'grel pa sgron gsal dang / rje btsun kun dga' don grub kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud ṭika gnyis sbrags te nor 'khrul gyi skyon phra mo tsam yang med par thugs thog nas gsungs par/ e waṃ gyi yi ge gnyis kyi de nyid shes pa dang ma shes pa'i phan yon dang /nyes dmigs 'chad pa'i sa bcad kyi khongs 'grel pa sgron gsal gyi tshig chos phung brgyad

mtshams brda mdzad pa ltar 'chogag gnang mdzad/ de ma thag bla ma dbu mdzad bzhugs khri las bzhengs te gsang 'dus kyi rdzogs rim las brtsams pa'i bgro gleng yun mi thung tsam mdzad/ de nyin bla brang nas tshogs yongs la sasol ja/ bzhes thug 'bras tsha/ sku 'gyed/ spyi 'jog bcas gong ma'i mdzad lam las lhag pa gnang /dgung tshigs kyi rjes dang / dgong mo bcas la chos rur dam bcar bzhugs/ de sku gong ma'i mjal khar phebs skabs shig la dge bstodas gral mtshams su slebs pas dgongs pa zhu 'gab che min bka' slob zhu gnang la/7rgyal mchog sku gong mas/ dge bskos nges par du gnang dgos/ rgyud pa'i sgrig khrims 'gro stangs tshang ma blo nges rgyus yod yag po bzo dgos/ rjes su rgyud pa'i bla ma mkhan po rim bzhin gnang dgos kyi red ces bka' bstsal/ mjal kha gzhan zhig bi skabs su/7rgyal ba rgyab chog pa/ zhwa mo phrag la bzhag chog pa/ 'bog thag 'khyer nas gral bskor du 'gro chog pa/ grwa mang la 'di dang 'di lta bu byed dgos zhes blang dor bkod khyab byed chog pa sogs kyi gnang ba gnang ba zhus par de bzhin bgyid 'thus kyi gnang ba bsung5/ de nas khang tshan dge rgan sku sku nas nad gnang / zhag gnang /lo gnang dgongs zhu sogs ji sku da kyi ngo sprod zhus/ grwa tshang gnyer pas khang gi sgo mchor mdun phebs par/ yang steng nas tsha rting gi mkhar rnga brdungs/ dge 'dun rnams rdo gcal du phebs nas bzhengs te bzhugs par thog mar byang 'dren chen mo dang / de nas rgan rim bzhin 'du khang du phebs rgyur phyag g.yas pa'i brda mdzad/ tshang ma 'du khang du bzhugs zin rjes gral tshang mar phebs te rnam snang gi chos bdun gyi sgo nas rgan gzhon bon rim ltar bzhugs min sogs la thugs zhib mdzad/ gsol ja bzhes skabs gdong gral gnyis kyi dbus nas sku phyag lan gsum gnang zin rjes mang ja'i gnang bar 'os pa rnams la gnang ba thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhes/ tsha sir btang chog pa sogs kyi gnang ba zhu gnang mdzad par byings nas gsung 'phangs mthon po dang bcas te de bzhin bgyid 'thus kyi sanang ba bstsal/ de rjes dad ldan rnam sa kyis phul ba'i skyabs zhu sogs snyan nywa na mdzad/ tsha rting grub nas gzim shag tu phebs par 'brel yod rnams nas rten 'brel mjal dar phul/ dgong mo chu tshod dgu pa tsam la slar yang ru cher phebs/ dkon gnyer gyis gzim brda btang zin pa na dge 'dun rnam/sa/ 'du khang si sgo mchor du phebs

dgung grangs nyer bzhir rgyud grwar phebs nas gsang sngasas sdo sgyu theg pa 'i chos sgor 45te ltung bshags gsung bzhin pa dang bcas sku phyag dang 'brel nyin re'i bshags sdom mdzad zin pa na/ phyag gasku/na par snum zhu zhig bsnams te gus pa dang bcas phyag g.yas pas brda mdzad pa ltar dge 'dun rnams nang du phebs/ ca co sogs gtan nas ma bsgrags par gzims grub pa na gral tshang mar phebs te rgan gzhon go rim dang mthun par seṅge'i nyal stabs kyis gzims lugs sogs mdo rgyud nas bshad pa ltar byung 'dug min thugs zhib gnang / de nas phyag tu spos kha shas bsnams te mgon thang rin po che'i mdun dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang gi sa nas bshad sgrub 'chad nyan 'phel ba'i 'phrin las bcol/ gral mjug nas dge 'dun rnams la sku phyag lan gsum gnang ste/ dge bskos kyi khri'i steng gzims/ phyi nyin tho rengs tsam la bla ma zhal ta pa nas gsung brda zhus pa ltar sku bzhengs gnang ste gral mjug nas dge 'dun rnams la sku phyag lan gsum mdzad de dus dran sogs gsungs/ lha mo bzhis glus bskul nas gnyid kyi 'od gsal las bzhengs pa dang tshul mtshungs par rdo ting skad je mthor brdungs te dge 'dun rnams gnyid kyi 'od gsal las bslangs/ zhogs cho gas skabs gsol ja dang po bzhes grub mtshams gral tshang mar yang yang phebs te zhal 'don gnang min sogs thugs zhib gnang /gnyid khug mkhan rnams la gnyid las slong ba'i thabs mdzad/ tsha rting grol rjes chos rur rgyud grwar 'dzul nas lo dgu ma song ba rnams so so'i rdo sgrom du thos bsam mdzad bzhin bzhugs 'dug min sku/gas gzigs zhib gnang /de ltar bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu nas bzung lo phyi ma'i bod zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bar zla ba bzhi'i ring chos mtshams skabs ma satogs nyin mtshan kun tu dge 'dun rnams dang 'bral med mdzad de gral bskor phebs rgyu sogs la sku ngal gtan nas med pri ra sgrig khrims gnon sdom la thugs khur chen po bzhes/ bag med pa'i dbang bis nang khrims dang 'gal ba rnams la bka' bkyon dang / phyag 'bebs sogs 'dzems med du gnang /

46 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul ldo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam baji+od pa skabs shig la mi nyag khang tshan gyi grwa shes rab rdo rje zhes pa klu nad kyis zin pa zhig la phyag 'bebs drag po gnang ba'i rkyen gyis nad las grol bar brten rjes su mjal bcar gyis thugs rje che zhus tshul skabs de dag tu rgyud la bzhugs mkhan rnams nas mgrin gcig tu gleng / yang skabs shig zhang po shing gnyer ming 'dogs la rus sbal zer ba zhig grongs nas 'drer skyes te mi mang por bsun gtser ci cher byung stabs rin po cher skyabs 'jug zhus rjes 'dre'i skye gnas las grol te 'jam thing du gyur pa dang / 'bras spungs su dge 'dun 'du 'khor sgrub 'dzugs gnang bas dge 'dun 'phel rgyas mngon gsal du byung lugs rgan rabs chorware ngag nas gleng ba thos/ dge bstodas kyi mtshan khur bzhes pa'i nyin tha ma'i zhogs par gsol ja dang po bzhes skabs rmongs pa dang / bag med pa'i dbang gis dge 'dun gyi thugs dang 'gal rigs byung yod tshe/ bzod bzhes mdzad du gsol zhes sngar srol ltar tshogs dbus su snyan gsan gnang / byang 'dren nas dbu bskul gyi dge 'dun rnams nas ltung bshags gsung skabs gral mjug nas sku phyag lan mang gnang / tsha rting ma grol gong rgyud khang gi yang thog tu tshogs 'du'i sar bla ma dbu mdzad kyis khang tshan dge rgan rnams la dge bskos gnang sgo legs nyes ji byung gi go bsdur skabs tshang mas 'gran zla dang bral ba byung tshul zhus par/ bla ma dbu mdzad nas mjal dar a she zhig phyag tu phul ba dang bcas legs pa'i bstod bsngags rgya cher bsgrags//

48 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sbul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod nga chen mang ngo'i bshad rgyun gsan yul de nyid kyang gsung chos la phebs/ khong gsan rgya che zhing / bde mchog lus dkyil gyi dbang de sngon nas gsan bzhes grub nges kyang / bla ma rdo rje 'chang bde mchog dang thun mong ma yin pa yin tsa na bskyar du gsan pa yin gyi red ces gsungs/ de skabs rje pha bong kha pas chos zhu ba tshogs chen la sta gon gnang zin yang ched gnyer gyis dam pa 'di la sta gon zur du bstsal ba ni/ ji skad du/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i gsung khyodan gsal las/tshul khrims dag cing mkhas la bsgrin/ /shes rab ldan zhing rgyud gcig pa/ /thos nas legs par ston pa ni/ /rin chen zhes bya'i gang zag go /zhes gsungs pa ltar mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i rin po che lta bu'i gdul bya 'di lta bu las lhag pa'i snod ldan gyi slob ma rnyed par dka' bas de'i gnad kyis yin nges/ de rjes dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i nang bde mchog lus dkyil gyi lam rim pa gnyis la brten nas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa lcang skya ye shes bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i bskyed rim bde chen gsal ba'i sgron me/ dus phyis kyi mkhas grub chen po dwags po bshad sgrub gling gi skal bzang mkhas grub bam/ chos kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bskyed rim thabs kyi theg pa'i gsang lam/ grub pa'i dbang phyug dril bu zhabs lugs kyi bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lus dkyil gyi mngon par rtogs pa bde chen rab 'phel zhes bya ba pha bong kha pa nyid kyis mdzad pa gsum sbrags pa'i steng nas bskyed rim gyi nyams khrid/dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang gi mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung bka' rgya ma'i gras dril bu rim lnga'i rdzogs rim tshig lhug dang /

chod bzang ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i myur lam dmar khrid gnyis sbrags pa'i steng nas byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nyams khrid/ mjug tu byams khang nas byams pa'i sku chung ba zhig gdan 'dren mdzad de
