gnang gi yod 'dug lam rim grub rjes bla ma lnga bcu pa'i bshad lung sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas gsang 'dus 'phags lugs mi bskyod rdo rje lha so gnyis/bde mchog dril bu lugs phyi dkyil lha lnga/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ kun rig lha so bdun/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu/ dge slong ma dpal mo'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal bcas kyi dbang chen/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi sngags btu'i rjes gnang / bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi bka' dbang bcas cha tshang gsan/ gsang 'dus kyi dbang chen sta gon skabs so shing 'dor gnang bar gyen 'greng du bsdad pa kun gyis ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su 'dzin/ bka' dbang rnams kyi rjes rin po che rang nas ched

rje pha bong kha pa sku gas bshes gnyen du ma'i drung nas mdo sngags kyi zab chos rgya che gsan 51gnyer gyis zhu gnang mdzad de thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ sngags kyi rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang / sbom po brgyad kyi sdom tshig sdom pa nyi shu pa bcas kyi bka' khrid gsan/ 'di dag gi bshad khrid de sngon 'bul sdud rdo rje 'chang gi drung nas gsan grub kyang / theg pa chen sngotsware lam la slob par khas 'che ba rnams kyis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dpang por gsol te khas blangs pa'i bslab bya rnams la ji ltar slob pa'i tshul mtha' dag shes nas tshul bzhin du slob pa zhig ma byung na/ de theg pa chen po ming tsam du 'gyur ba dang / the rje theg pa spyi dang / khyad par bla med kyi lam la slob par 'dod pa rnams kyis ni/ bla ma bsten tshul theg chen thun mong ba'i skabs su bshad pa las kyang ches khyad par du 'phags pa zhig gzhir bzung ste sngags kyi dam tshig dang / lha ma pa rnams mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces par 'dzin dathodas par gsungs pa ltar dam sdom tshul bzhin srung ched gal che nan tan tshul gyis bskyar du gsan par mdzad pa gor ma chag pha thodang kha rin po cher bkra shis 'khyil gyi co ne+e dge bshes chod bzang rgya mtsho'i mdun nas gsung chos gsan 'gabs che min bka' 'dri zhus par/ khong snyan brgyud man ngag gi gter mjo da rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i zhabs la yang zin pa zhig yin cing / nges par gsan so/sa che tshul phebs pa ltar/ de lo'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyer gcig nas pha bong kha pa sogs dang lhan du mdo sdud pa dang /mngon rtogs rgyan sbyar ba'i bshad lung / dbu ma la 'jug pa'i bshad lung / yang zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nas rje'i gsung drang nges legs bshad snying po/ 'jam bzhad ngag dbang brtson 'grus kyi gsung grub mtha' cangab sku gas kyi bshad khrid gsan/ pha bong kha gang nyid kyis tho no dge bshes kyi drung nas gzhung chen 'di dag gi bshad pa gsan pa'i zhor la dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po gzim 'og rin po che sogs kyis zhu bskul gnang ba ltar snga dgong chos bar rnams su bla sprul dge bshes mang tsam zhig la rang nyid kyi gzim chung du dbyangs can sgra mdo'i bshad lung zhib rgyas bstsal ba gsan/

51 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo lnge 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa phyi 'o/ 1928 sa 'brug lo'i zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nas bzung pha bong kha rin po ches sbyin bdag mdzad de co ne+e dge bshes rin po che'i drung nas chu bzang 'du khang du rje'i gsung sngags rim chen mo dang / ngan song sbyong rgyud mchan dang bcas pa/ kun rig rgyud don gsal ba/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i bshes pa'i springs yig bcas kyi bshad lung / bde mchog margyud dang / sbas don kun gsal/ de'i sa bcad bsdus don gsum sbrags kyi bshad lung / bkra shis 'khyil gyi sde khri 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma'i gsung dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rim/ co je dge bshes rang nyid kyi gsung / legs par bshad pa'i snying po las brtsams te spel mar bstod pa dgongs don zad med nam mkha' ma17da kyi sgo 'phar rgya cher phye ba rdzogs ldan sprin gyi sgra dbyangs kyi bshad lung bcas gsan/ thod ne+e rin po che gsung snyu ma legs shing / ha cang sems la phan po yod ces bsngags brjod yang yang gnang / spel bsko da kyi tshigargyal ༷/ma rgyal ba'i thugs bcud ma dros mamyo+odro+o/ /klu sgrub klu yi dbang pos yongs bzung ba/ /zla grags zla ba'i 'od kyis 'phyur ba'i klung / /blo bzang blo yi dza hus hub kyis 'thung / / zhes dang /rten zhes chodas nyid mi 'dor la/ /'byung zhes 'jig rten tshul yang mthun/ / ces dang / yang /snyan ngag kun gyi rgyal po 'khri shing gi /shing rta'i 'phang lo g.yos pa'i rgyu lam du/ /deng dus skye bo'i rgyu 'grul zad pa na/ /grib ma gnyis pa'i bo/gas bcas 'gro ba su/ /

rje pha bong kha pa sku/gas bshes gnyen du ma'i drung nas mdo sngags kyi zab chos rgya che gsan 53zhes sogs rgyun ldan bka' mol gyi skabs tshun chad du yang yang 'dren par mdzad/co ne+e rin po che'i mdun nas gong smos gsung chos gsan pa'i zhor la pha bong kha rin po che'i drung nas bla sprul dge bshes 'ga' shas dang lhan du gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung khro bcu'i srung zlog ngar ma'i rno mtshon dang / dra sdom 'khor lo bri sgrub bya tshul gyi zab khrid/ mkhas dbang daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung snyan ngag me long gi 'grel pa rgyal mchog lnga pas mdzad pa'i dbyangs can dgyes glu'i bshad lung / pha bong kha nyid kyi gsung bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs 'dod rgu'i gter mdzod bcas kyi khrid gsan/ snyan ngag gi bka' khrid skabs dper brjod kyang ljags rtsom mdzad de bla mar spyan bstar gyis bka' bcos kyang zhu bar mdzad/ snyan ngag la spyangs pa dpyis phyin pa zhig 'dod na/ rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing la sbyangs pa gal che zhes gsungs tshul ltar rjes sor pha bong kha'i bla brang nas dpag bsam 'khri shing la dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa'i mchan/ 1/ ston 'jigs med grags pa'i nag mchan/ lha 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dmar mchan bcas 'khod pa'i po ti gnyis g.yar po bzhes te yang yang thugs zhib dang / 'dra bshus shig kyang mdzad rgyu'i thugs 'dun mchis mod/ de spos su lus/ lar nas dgos med bab col du mi gsung yang ston pa'i 'khrungs rabs sogs kyi skor la thugs nges shin tu che/ yang co ne+e dge bshes rin po che nas bra ti rin chen don grub kyis mdzad pa'i sum cu pa'i 'grel pa'i bshad lung bstsal ba gsan par/ na sgra de nyid la 'jug pa'i khungs su mdzod rtsabar/bsam gtan dang po na thams cad ces pa drangs so zhes gsungs/ de rjes shig la ser byes har gdong sog po dge bshes snyan grags nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ bkra shis chos gling ri khrod kyi 'du khang du rje pha bong kha pa bde chen snying pos 'dus pa sum brgya tsam la mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho dang / rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rdzogs rim rim lnga gsal sgron bcas kyi bshad lung sogs

54 4skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sbrul rdo the 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod nga bstsal ba cha tshang gsan/ skabs shig la rin po che nas ched gnyer gyis zhus ngor pha bong kha rin po ches smin gling gter chen gyi gsung sgrub thabs 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang dang /thu'u bkan chos kyi nyi ma'i gsung steng nas chos skyong rgyal po chen po sku lnga'i srog gtad bstsal skabs mdang nga'i rmi lam du mi dmar po zhig yong nas dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur byed pa zhig rmis shing / khyed la sku lnga shin tu 'go ba zhig yin 'dug ces bka' phebs/ chig stong dgu brgya sum cu tham pa'i lor chu bzang chos rur 7skyabs rje pha bong kha rin po che'i drung nas zab lam bla ma mchod pa'i bka' khrid gsan te phur tshugs ga1/la 'debs kyi skabs tsam du ring nas gsol ba btab pa ltar yar stod thos bsam dar rgyas gling dgon sogs nas gdan zhu 'byor bar gsung chodas gsan 'phro 'jog dgos byung / phur tshugs gso/la 'debs yan la gsung bshad kyi zin bris kyang mchis/ rjes sor 7skyabs rje lha btsun rin po che dang / khri byang rin po che bcas kyi mdun nas bskyar du bla ma mchodad pa'i bka' khrid gsan tshul 'og tu gsal bar 'gyur/ gdan zhus ltar lho khul du zla ba drug bzhugs shing /thos bsam dar rgyas gling grwa tshang du dge 'dun mi mang dad 'dus khag la myur lam dmar khrid kyi steng nas lam rim gyi nyams khrid sems bskyed mchod pas mtha' brgyan pa bcas bstsal zhing / 'di nyid sku tshe 'dir lam rim gyi bka' khrid gnang ba'i thog mar mngon/de mtshungs g.yang bzang dgon du yang chos 'brel bstsal zhing dgon khag gnyis shar bsnyen bkur gya nom pa mdzad/ gzhan yang khra 'brug gtsug lag khang / stag spyan 'bum pa/ ho/ brang yam bu bla sgang / ras chung phug rnam rgyal mchod khang / rtsed thang lnga mchod dgon sogs yar lung khul gyi gnas rten 'ga' zhig dang / bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang sogs gnas rten 'gangs che du mar zhib mjal mchod smon sogs dang / skya ser du mar 'dod bstun gyis chos kyi 'brel ba bstsal ba sogs bstan 'gro'i dge mtshan spel bar mdzad/ dar rgyas gling du bzhugs skabs sku gong ma'i sku tsha gasdudal

rje pha bong kha pa sogs bshes gnyen du ma'i drung nas masnga sngags kyi zab chos rgya che gsan 55dpon byams pa blo bzang nyid srin pho glang gi nad gzhi lta bu'i rkyen gyis tshe ma zin par dge blo gsal 'debs dang 'brel dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul mdzad/ gsol dpon de nyid sku gzhon dus nas lhan 'grogs kyis yi ge 'bri klog dang / chos spyod thugs 'dzin skyor sbyang sogs kyi zhabs bskul dang 'brel nang gi dge rgan lta bu zhig yin 'dug pas bla ma'i grangs su 'jog pa ma zad/ dus rgyun ming 'bod gnang skabs kyang sku zhabs ga1/la dpon lags dam pa zhes bkur sti mdzad/ rtsed thang lnga mchod du zhabs sor 'khod skabs phyag mdzod blo bzang lung rigs de dus lo bcu tsam la son pa sru mos 'khrid de mjal khar bcar/rjes sor kho rang lo bco brgyad skabs nas bla brang gi zhabs phyi zhus/ thog mar mjal bcar skabs rten dod gsar thon zho pad lnga phul bar shog chag steng zla tshes sogs bkod de thugs mkho 'jug snod sgam chung zhig yod pa der dus phyis bar thugs nyar gnang ba ni blo bzang lung rigs nas thugs bzhed dang mthun pa'i zhabs phri sku tshe mthar 'khyol zhus pa mngon shes kyi gzigs pa lta bur mchis/ yang stag brag bsam gtan gling du 7skyabs rje stag brag rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang gsung rab mthu stobs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas slob dpon chen po a bha ya ka ras mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rdo rje'i phreng ba nas 'byung ba'i lha zhe gnyis dang / paṇ+ḍita darlan atsar+yas mdzad pa'i bya ba bsdus pa nas byung ba'i bde legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum bsnan pas dkyil 'khor zhe lnga'i dbang chen yongs su rdzogs pa gsan/ nyin gcig ma6)da g.yog pa e ka ljongs sprul sku nas chodab ma rnams la sku bsangs bdug skabs rin po che skur sgur gnang ba dang bsangs phor thug pas shangs khrag phran bu thon tshul gsungs/ yang skyabs rje pha bong kha rin po cher spu+od 'jug gi bshad khrid cig gnang rogs zhu gnang mdzad par/ gzhan zhig nas kyang gsol ba btab ste zhal bzhes zin pas gnang rgyu gtan 'khel song bas de skabs phebs na legs tshul bka' phebs mod/ 'on kyang thugs stabs 'khel ba ma byung / bkra shis 'khyil gyi sog po dge bshes

56 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa dpal ldan bzang po gsan rgya che stabs lha btsun rin po che nas lha sar gdan zhu gnang ba gang de'i drung nas 7skyabs rje stag brag rin po che dang / sgo mang khang sar rin po che sogs dang lhan du dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i nang gi rda khu ral gyi dge bshes snyan grags can blo bzang rta dbyangs kyi yig cha'i steng nas grub rgyal lugs tshe dpag med nang sgrub zhi ba dkar po lha so gsum/ gsang sgrub khro bo dmar po lha nyer gsum/ yang gsang ras chung gong khug ma dmar po lha dgu/ 'chi med nges ster dkar po lha dgu/ gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun gyi dbang chen sku gas mang rab cig gsan/ skabs shig la dpal ldan bzang pos 'jigs byed dpa' gcig gi bskyed rdzogs nyams 'khrid gnang yang / sku ga skad dam pas phran bu'i go dka' tsam 'dug par brten khang sar rin sngo/ ches khrid rgyun khong gi mdun nas gsan rjes su thob nges snyam du dgongs te/ bka' 'gyur bla ma blo bzang don ldan gyis bshad sgra'i gzim shag tu dmigs brtse ma'i the'u bum gyi ljags lung gnang ba der phebs pa yin zhes gsungs/ paṇa chen chos rgyan gyi gsung 'bum/ dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang gi phag mgo bla ma ye shes brtson 'grus kyi gsung / thu'u bkan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsung 'bum/ yang dus phyis bkra shis 'khyil gyi mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan a khu shes rab rgya mchorware gsung 'bum sku gas mang po zhig gsan/ bla ma 'di nyid mkhas grub gnyis ldan zhig red ces bsngags brjod yang yang mdzad cing / khong gis kyang rin po che rgyal bstan gyen du 'degs pa'i ka ba chen por 'gyur nges su dgongs te thugs sras kyi gtso bo zhig tu mdzad/ zhwa 'phel rin po che'am bka' 'gyur bla ma sku gzhon par grags pa'i drung nas lung chad 'ga' shas kha gsab kyi chos 'brel zhig gsan/ dus tshes zhib cha ma shes kyang / snyigs ma'i dus 'dir yi dam gyi lha gzhan las khyad chos chen po lnga'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa gerdo rje 'jigs byed lda bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs za ma tog gi steng nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams khrid/ stag phu blo bzang bstan

rje pha bong kha pa sogs bshes gnyen du ma'i drung nas masngo sngags kyi zab chos rgya che gsan 57pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rnal 'byor ma'i khrid yig boṭar zhun ma'i them skas/ zhwa lu ri zur blo bzang mkhyen rab kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig mkha' spu+od bgrod pa'i myur lam/dngul chu dharma bha dra'i gsung zin bris bcas kyi steng nas nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig the gas rim celadabu ma chung ba thun mong ma yin pa bsam mi khyab kyi man ngag bcas sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang / sems 'dzin zung 'brel du gtong ba sogs gsang chen slob bshad kyi phyag bzhes ltar zab khrid sogs pha bong kha pa'i gsung chos tshang ma dang / gzhan yang 7skyabs rje stag brag rdo rje 'chang / sgo mang khang sar rin po che/ bka' 'gyur bla ma blo bzang don ldan/ bkra shis 'khyil sog po dpal ldan bzang po/ co ne+e dge bshes rin po che blo bzang rgya mtsho sprin gtsug lag chos kyi 'dod 'jo bcas kyi gsung chos phal cher la phebs/mdor na rgyud pa'i dge baho sa mdzad zin pa nas bzung 7rgyal mchog gong ma'i gser sdong zhabs zhu ma gnang bar lam rim blo sbyong / sngags kyi dbang dang / khrid sogs kyi skor thos pa 'chosal ba la ngoms pa med par mdzad pa'i stobs kyis snyan brgyud man ngag gi gter mdzod chen sngo ra gyur kyang / gsan yig bod du lus pas zhib tu 'bri bar ma spobs shing / chig stong dgu brgya sum cu so gsum lo'i dbyar mjug chu bzang ri khrod du 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po ches gsol 'debs mdzad pa ltar pha bong kha pas rdo rje nag po chen po stobs 'phrog dbang po zhal bzhi pa rnam 'gyur bcu bdun du grags pa'i rjes gnang rnams bstsal ba gsan cing / skabs der gsan bzhes ma grub pa dpal mabo/na zhal bzhi pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur las ches shin tu gsang zhing bka' gnyan pa gsang khrid kyi sngon 'gro gsang sgrub mgon sngo / dpal mgon bran du gtad pa bram ze nag ngo'i mngags gtad du grags pa gnyis kyi rjes gnang / mgon sngotsware gsang khrid bcas pha bong kha dgongs pa zhi bar gshegs zin rjes gzim 'og rin po che gling bla brang du gdan zhus kyis cha tshang gsan/

58 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod nga/ gong gsal de rnams ma zad/ gzhan yang tshe dbang dang / byad grol sogs yang yang gsan/gzim 'og rdo rje 'chang grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa zhig yin pa'i cha 'jog mdzad cing / gzhan la yang de ltar gsungs//

57rgyal mchog sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i sku gdung zhabs zhu dang / gser sdong gsar bzhengs gnang tshul/zhe /zher༅༅//phyi 'o/ 933lo bod zla 0tshes 30nyin 7rgyal mchog sku 'phreng bcu gsum pa chen po dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshegs tshul bstan rjes/cadar gling gzim chung 'gag nas 7rgyal mchog sku gong ma'i sku'i gdung sgrub dang / gdung khrus/ pur tshwa brje 'bul zhu rgyu sogs kyi phyag las zhabs zhu'i thugs 'gan bzhes dgos pa'i bka' phebs/skabs der mkhan chen zhig nas dam can dam la btags song zhes sku rtsed kyang zhus/de nyin sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel 'dzin bzung gnang rgyu yin tshod dang / nor gling du dmag mi sogs mi mang po zhig yar 'gro mar 'gro zang nge zing nge zhig 'dug ces gsungs/de nas rje pha bong kha pa'i mdun du phebs te gdung sgrub zhabs zhu'i skor la bka' 'dri zhu gnang mdzad pa'i zin bris su gsal ba ltar phyag len 'phyugs med kyis gdung sgrub mchod 'bul sku gas dang /gser sdong gsar bzhengs kyi tshad gzhi thig gdab dang /nang gzungs nyer bsdogs gnang rgyu sogs khri byang rin po che sogs las sbrel gzhan dang lhan du zhabs zhu mdzad/ chodags par gdung sgrub kyi cho ga grub nas nyin gung rgyab gdung sgrub tshogs thengs gnyis pa ma tshugs bar yun ring zhing /skabs der rtser bzhugs yul zur du med stabs sku ngal phran bu byung rung /khri byang rin po che dang lhan du pho brang gi ldebangag

60 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa ris khag la nyin ltar thugs zhib gnang / rjes sor rnam grwa dbu mdzad khri smon sras dang thugs 'dris chags gshis/ rnam gnyis 〈peng gi shag tu sku ngal gso bzhugs mdzad/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis lo gcig dang phyed lnga'i ring gdung sgrub zhabs zhu mdzad/ mchod sdong bzhengs grub zin pa'i rjes gser sdong khang gi ldebs ris kyi dbu 'dzin thugs 'gan 7skyabs rje stag brag rin po che dang lhan du gnang / lha bris dbu che rgyal mtshan nas 7skyabs rje rin po che tshon gyi 'gro stangs dang / sku gzugs kyi thig tshad sogs la mkhyen rgya ha cang che tshul gyi bsngags brjod zhus tshul gleng / me tog dang / byi'u/ lha'i phyag mtshan sogs kyi ri mo legs po 'bri gnang thub pa ma zad/ shing bzo dang / lcags bzo gnang rgyu la thugs dgyes mnyes che stabs gsol khyodag dang / sgam chung de 'dra thugs phan gsos nges bzo gnang gi lha sa bla brang dang ri khrod gnyis /ra phyag bzhes lag cha 'bur len che chung / teb tsag sogs yod pa'i sgam chung re yod par mtshams re 'bur len rno brdar yang gnang / 'bras sgo mang sog po spu rad bzang po nas par chas shig phul te/ par rgyab stangs dang 'khru stangs sogs ji ltar bya tshul spyan bstar zhus pa ltar/ rin po che rang nas par legs po bskyon thub cing / skabs re zhabs phyi chos par brgyab pa 7skyabs rje mchog nas 'khru bar mdzad/ 'on kyang rgyun du de rigs mi gnang / par chas dang /chu snu da/ rgyang shel bcas la mnyes po gnang zhing / yang chu tshod phyag la 'dogs par mnyes po med cing / chu tshod spus legs de 'dra bcu tsam zhig yod pa sgam dkar po zhig gi nang bcug ste zla re chu tshod tshang mar lde mig re bskyon pa dang / gzhan sku chas gnad che'i rigs la thugs snang gang yang med/ bcos ma'i re/ tog lta bu mchod par sgrig byed de 'dra la thugs mnyes po yod/ rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad ma gnang gong lha sar bzhugs skabs nyin re bzhin gling skor la phebs shing / gtsug lag khang yas mas su yang gnas gzigs su yang yang phebs/ lo gcig la rje 'bum sbang gi lha khang dang / rigs gsum

7rgyal mchog sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i sku gdung zhabs zhu dang / gser sdong 61sgang gi lha khang sogs lha sa'i grong khyer nang gi lha khang tshang mar zhabs kyis bcags te mchod 'bul dang / thugs smon bcas gnang / sa ga zla ba'i nang gling skor du phebs skabs ched mngags sgang stod gzhis nas rtsam pa 'or 'dren gyis sprang por sbyin pa gnang pa dang / bla ma ma ṇi bar gzigs lha ga gis mnyes tshul mdzad/ sku gzhon nu'i skabs sngon 'gro sbyor ba'i snu sa drug gi nyams bzhes ched sngon gyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi mdzad pa dang mthun par gzim chung du gad phyis dang / 7skyabs rje gang nyid nas yon chab 'bul gnang mdzad/ ri khrod du bzhugs skabs shig la dgong mo sku gzim gnang rjes bzhugs sgrom seng nas hrag hrag ces skad grag mkhan zhig 'dug par tsi tsi min nam dgongs kyang / zhogs par gzim chas bsdus te gad bskyon dus sdig pa ra tsa yin par gzigs te zhed snang byung zhes gsungs/gtsug lag khang gi khyams rur brkyang phyag 'bum grangs gsog mdzad skabs phran bu'i sku mnyel tsam byung yang / phyag 'bum kha slong dang bcas pa legs par grub/ skyes stobs kyi shes rab rtsal che ba dang / sngon sbyangs kyi bag chags yongs su brtas pa'i mthu las gzhan dag ltar ha cang lo mang ring gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa mdzad pa la ma ltos par mdo dang sngags/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol du son cing / de don tshul bzhin du sgrub pa'i mthu las rtogs pa'i yon tan mthon por phebs zin pa ma zad/sku phreng gong ma'i gong ma khri chen ngag dbang lung rtogs yon tan rgya mtshos 7rgyal mchog sku 'phreng bcu gcig pa'i yongs 'dzin mdzad/ de rjes 'di'i gong ma rje btsun blo bzang lung rtogs bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyang shar pa chos rje'i bar phebs/ 7rgyal dbang sku 'phreng bcu gsum pa chen wa'i yongs 'dzin kyang lo bdun mdzad de skabs de'i ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan 'dzin grags can phal che ba'i rigs kyi bdag por gyur pa bcas la brten rgyud grwa rnams nas dam pa 'di nyid la bla ma dbu mdzad gnang re che zhing / rang khongs lha rams ang yod sngags kyi dam bca' zin rigs rnams bla ma dbu mdzad kyi 'os khongs

67 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul sdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa su 'bul srol ltar rtsod rgyugs la thengs kha shas phebs kyang sku na gzhon pa dang / dbang lung khrid gsum so/gas gsan bzhes gnang spos la gnod par dogs pa ma zad/ gtso bor phyi lo 1959 lor rgya mi'i drag shugs btsan gnon gyis rgyal bstan ming tsam du 'gyur nye'i skabs 'phags yul du 'jam mgon 7rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab tu skur bzhengs te bstan pa'i me ro gso bar mdzad pa sogs dgos pa du ma zhig la gzigs te/ ji skad du/ ci phyir zhe na skyob pa dus la gzigs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal mchog bcu gsum pa chen po zhal bzhugs skabs su dam pa 'di nyid la bla ma dbu mdzad bsko bzhag ma bstsal/ 'on kyang rjes sor bla ma dbu mdzad gnang dgos pa ni gong du bshad pa ltar dge bskos dgongs zhu gnang skabs rjes sor bla ma dbu mdzad kyi mtshan khur bzhes dus sgrig lam sogs kyi skor la thugs rgyus che khyad dge balha/sa gnang dgos tshul 7rgyal mchog bcu gsum pa chen pos bka' ba355 ba des shes par nus//

6dgung grangs so bzhi'i thog rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad dang /de rjes rgyud pa'i mkhan po gnang ste rgyud grwa'i 'chad nyan sgrig khrims legs par bskyangs tshul/ne /zher༅༅//phyi lo 936lor 'bras blo gling nyag re dge bshes bkra shis rnam rgyal bla ma dbu mdzad kyi lo yun tshang ste mkhan por 'pho nye'i skabs rwa sgreng rgyal tshab rin po che nas bla ma dbu mdzad kyi 'os kho ngas su yod rigs bka' 'gugs kyi rtsod rgyugs bzhes par dam pa 'di nyid ang dang por bzhengs pa ma zad/skabs su babs par dgongs te dam pa 'di nyid kyi mtshan chodag tu phyag rtags gnang nas bla ma dbu mdzad bsko bzhag bstsal/de ltar khang tshan dge rgan lnga nas snyan gsol ltar/tshes cha bzang ba zhig gi zhogs par bla brang du rten 'brel mdzad sgo gnang skabs rin po che tshoms chen du bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod/khang tshan dge rgan rnams nas rgyal tshab rin po che'i phyag rtags bka' yig de 7skyabs rje rin po cher phul skabs sngar srol ltar rin po che yar sku bzhengs gnang ste phyag gnyis kyis gus pa'i tshul gyis bzhes/ de nas bla brang dang / rgyud stod/ blo gling grwa tshang /khang tshan khag sogs 'brel yod mang rab cig nas mjal dar rten gsum phul/bla brang nas kyang sku mgron tshang mar gsol ja bzhes 'bras phul/nyin shas rjes khri 'don dacaras gzhi'i skabs zhogs pa nam gsal tsam nas rgyud pa'i dge bskos/byang 'dren/khang tshan lnga'i dge rgan/gzhan yang bla brang dang thugs nang dkar yul dad can

64 4skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sbrul ldo rje 'chang chen wa 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa mang pos spos snes sngun bsus/ rin po che nas sku chos bzhes te gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud sogs nang du bzhugs pa'i shog ka li dang / lhung bzed bcas sku rgyab tu bsnams te rwa mo cher phebs/ zhogs tshogs grol/ tsha rting ma tshugs pa'i bar 'du khang du phebs te sadong gral dkyil tsam nas me tog dang phyag nas gtor/ jo wa'i sku mdun du phebs te sku phyag dang 'brel thugs smon snyan shal 'bul gnang mdzad/ de nas mgon thang chen mor snyan shal 'bul gnang mdzad rjes bla ma dbu mdzad na rim gyi bzhugs khri'i steng zhabs sor 'khod/ shog ka li bzhugs khri'i sku rgyab kyi ka ba la bkal/ byang 'dren chen mo nas zhal 'don dbu bskul zhus te dge bskos dang / khang tshan dge rgan lnga bcas lhan du gsang 'dus kyi skad cig dkrong bskyed dang 'brel rdor dril dang / nang mchod byin rlabs bcas gsungs/ de nas tshang mar grwa tshang nas gasku/la ja bzhes 'bras btegs/ ja mchod 'dren pa mnyam med dang / 'bras mchod yid coding mchod sku/na sna tshogs bcas byang 'dren gyis dbu bskul te gsung zin mtshams sasol ja mchod/ 'bras sil phud gtor gnang zin rjes spos sne ba 'du khang gi phyi rol tu phebs/ grwa mang 'du khang du yar phebs te/ dpal ldan sa gsum 'bo ba'i mig gcig pu/ /zhes sogs mkhas grub rin po ches mdzad pa'i rje'i bstod pa byang 'dren nas dbu bskul zhus pa ltar gsungs/ grwa tshang dang / bla brang nas rin po cher maṇ+ḍal rten gsum phul/ dge 'dun rnams nas gsol ja bzhes ring rin po che nas bsngo ba gsungs/ de nas spos sne ba rnams kyis sngun bsus te 'du khang gi yang thog sman bla khang du gdan drangs te mdzad sgo zab rgyas gnang / de nas rtse pho brang chen por drung jar phebs te gsar mjal mdzad/ de nas rwa che'i yang thog rgya phibs kyi 'og bla ma dbu mdzad kyi las shag tu phebs/ grwa tshang / khang tshan/ sku 'phreng snga phyi'i slob ma sogs ser skya du mas khri phebs kyi rten 'brel mjal dar phul ba dgyes bzhes mdzad de mjal zhu ba rnams la mjal dar dang / phyag mdud bstsal/ sngon du mdzad sgo gra sgrig skabs

dgung grangs so bzhi'i thog rgyud nga/'i bla ma dbu mdzad dang / de rjes rgyud ju 'i mkhan ngo/ 65'bras sgo mang zung chu mi tshan khongs khri chen ngag dbang nor bu'i bla brang nas khri lcog cig g.yar zhus phyir 'bul skabs khri lcog nang khri chen ngag dbang nor bu zhes mtshan snyan shin tu che ba des rgyun bzhes mdzad pa'i zhabs bcags 'ja' chen ser po zhig yod 'dug pas rjes sor dge ldan khri pa gnang rgyu'i rten 'brel 'grigs song zhes las byed tshang mas yid ches byas/ bla ma dbu mdzad gsar pa dge bskos ma bzhengs pa'i rigs yin tshe dge bskos blu cha lta bur gung tshigs la gsol ja bzhes thug gsum dang / sku 'gyed skar lnga re bcas 'bul dgos pa las gzhan dge bskos zin rigs nas de ltar gnang mi dgos kyang / gling bla brang nas 'dus chogs su nyin 'khyongs gsol ja/ bzhes thug sku 'gyed bcas gzab 'bul zhus/ bla ma dbu mdzad gsar pa nas mtshan gsum ring rgyud gzhung la phebs rgyu dang / gtsug lag khang du dgong mo dge 'dun rnams dang lhan du tshogs la gzim dgos pa ltar rgyud gzhung tshogs skabs grwa mang chos rur phebs zin rjes byang 'dren chen mo dang lhan du phebs/ byang 'dren zhal mar gzigs shing / rin po che zhal yar gzigs te bzhugs gdan sogs gang yang med par sa steng du bzhugs/ dge 'dun rnams kyis rdor dril gcig gis gcig gi phyag brgyud de rin po cher phul/ zhal 'don cha gsum nas bzung rgyud gzhung dang / de rjes bstan 'bar ma bcas lhan du gsungs/ de nas gzim bde btang ba dang dus mnyam du tshogs su phebs te seṅge'i nyal stabs kyis sku gzims gnang / phyi nyin snga dro chu tshod gsum pa tsam la dge 'dun rnams kyi sngon du sku bzhengs gnang ste dus dran sogs gsungs zin rjes zhogs tshogs la phebs pa sogs nyin gsum gyi ring de ltar mdzad/ bla ma dbu mdzad gsar pa na rim rgyud pa'i chos 'grims phebs yul tshang mar lo gcig gi ring phebs dgos pa lta ra/ thog mar bod zla gnyis pri 'i nang skyor mo lung du phebs te rgyud khang gi yang thog tu bzhugs gding sgron rjes tshogs su phebs pa ma zad/ de nub grwa mang dang lhan cig tu 'du khang du gzims/ phyi nyin grwa mang rgi sngon la sku bzhengs gnang sde

66 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sbul rdo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa phyag bsil grub rjes zhogs tshogs la phebs/ dge 'dun rnams nas gsol ja bzhes skabs gsum ldan rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'dus sde rnams nas sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams rnams mig gi 'bras bu ltar srung ba gzhir bzung ba'i steng nas klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo dang / spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo la ji ltar brtson tshul spyi dang / lhag par skyor mo lung chos thog ring mdzad sgo rnams 'di dang 'di lta bu dgos zhes bka' slob tshogs gtam gnang / nyin gnyis par mkhan sngo/ gsar pas brtsi bzhag gnang skabs skyor dpon lta bur mdzad de brtsi bzhag tshar gcig yar skyor gnang mdzad/ de rjes dge bshes sogs 'dzin grwa der phebs mkhan rnams chos grwa'i zur gcig tu tshogs pa'i dbus su brtsi bzhag lan gsum du skyor bar mdzad/ nyin gung rgyab mkhan pos chodas 'chad nyan gnang skabs dang / dgong mo rgyud gzhung tshogs skabs bcas par grwa mang dang lhan du phebs/ bdun gcig gi rjes chos 1/ga bo/la mtshams yar zhor stag brag ri khrod du rigs brgya'i khyab bdag stag brag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i drung du gsung chos gsan par phebs/ stag brag bla brang gi mdzo mo rwa bar bzhugs yul mdzad/ blo bzang lung rigs de dus zhabs gras su yod par/ ser smad 'phan po brag rgyab rin po che yang gsung chos la phebs yod par brten rnam gnyis yang yang lhan 'dzoms kyis rta dbyangs 'then gnang dang / thig bskyon pa sogs la dpags na phal cher lcags mkhar gyi bka' khrid gsan pa yin nam snyam pa las zhib cha ma nges/ de gar gsung chos grol rjes lha sar phebs/ rwa mo cher rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog lū i pa'i lugs kyi bdag 'jug chen mo bdun gcig ring lo re bzhin tshogs srol ltar sa chog gi nyin tshogs su phebs te bdag 'jug chen mo'i skor sogs tshogs gtam gnang / mchod g.yog pa rnams nas dkyil 'khu+or bzhengs zin rjes thig tshad dang / ston gyi 'gro stangs sogs gang cir rgyud sde dang mthun par byung min gzigs zhib nan tan mdzad/

dgung grangs so bzhi'i thog rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad dang / de rjes rgyud pa'i mkhan ngo/ 67bod zla gsum pa'i nang chu mdar phebs te/ mkhar sngo zhes pa'i gzhis khang de sngon rgyud pa'i chos 'grims phebs skabs kyi bzhugs yul der bzhugs/ der gding rgyag gi nyin rjes ma'i zhogs par chu mdar bzhugs ring dge 'dun rnams nas gang ci'i gnang sgo sogs kyi skor tshogs gtam mdzad rgyus mtshu rgan pa'i sngar srol gyi mdzad sgo thams cad ma nyams par gnang / bod zla bzhi pa'i mjug tu bka' gdams man ngag pa'i brgyud 'dzin dang po grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi thugs sras gtso bo dge bshes bya yul ba gzhon nu 'od kyi gdan sa 'bri gung mang ra dgon du gdan zhus ltar zhabs kyis bcags/ gtsug lag khang gi yang thog gzim chung du bzhugs sgrig zhus pa de dag ha cang spro po med kyang shin tu bag phebs pa'i tshul mdzad/ de phyogs ser skya mang 'dzoms la 'dod bstun chos 'brel dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur mchod 'bul bcas gya nom pa zhu gnang mdzad/ nyin gcig mang ra se gtor zhes pa'i 'cham gzigs 'bul lam zhus skabs dge slong 'khar bsil thogs shing / thang zhu bzhes pa bcu drug dang / rnam sras rta bdag brgyad sogs kyi gar 'cham la thugs zhib dang / de rjes nyis 'bags zhes pa dang / rdzong kha zhol pa gnyis nas lha mo 'khrab ston zhus par yang dgyes gzigs mdzad/de ga'i yul lha sgom chen zer ba zhig yod pa sa gnas su phebs skabs rten gzhir spyan 'dren zhu srol yod pa ltar mdzad/ bzang gos las grub pa'i na bza' stod lhe dang pang khebs/dbu zhwa bcas cha tshang gsol bstsal thog yul der char chu dus 'bebs 'byung ba dang /yul mi rnams la yang blang dor slob ston sogs rogs ram ci thub bya dgos tshul gyi bka' slob gnang / spom chen gyis mchod rten mgo mjug log na yang / bang rim sked par gnas tsam yod tshul zhus/ (bla brang gi drel gcig gis rta dang rtsed mo rtsed de 'ded res btang bar drel de shing brtsegs pa'i steng lhung bar grod khos la shing zug ste dka' ngal che byung skabs yul mi'i slob ston ltar spom chen rten gzhir spyan drangs nga/ khong gis gri

68 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo lnge 'chang chen ngo/'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa ring po zhig mer bsregs te kho rang gi lces ldag gri de rta'i grod khog steng btsugs te sngags brgyab nas phan po byung ba'i sku/ rgyus mchis/)sngar dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang lnga bo bka' gdams pa'i bstan pa khyab gdal du spel ba'i ched bya yul ba gzhon nu 'od du skye ba bzhes pa'i rtags mtshan lta bur rten gtso bya yul ba'i sman sku ngo mtshar can zhig yod pa de gling rin po che'i sku 'phreng rnams sku khams bzang 14 dang / mdzad 'phrin rgyas skabs zhal gnam gzigs lta bur bzhugs/ sku bsnyun tshul bzhes pa'i skabs sman sku de bzhin dbu dud tsam byas nas bzhugs kyi yod lugs ser skya rgan rabs rnams kyis bshad srol ltar de dus sku 'dra de ha cang gi gzi brjid can zhal gnam gzigs lta bur yod tshul brjod/ skabs de nas bzung gsol dasngo/na thub bstan rig 'dzin zhes pa bla brang gi mi khongs yer pa rgyud pa'i khang gnyer gyi bu yin pa der lha zhig thog phebs yang yang brgyab pa/ skabs der yar lha sham wa'i sku rten med pas phal cher yar lha sham po min nam zhes gsungs pa'i gnas tshul go thos la brten lho kha phyogs kyi yar lha sham wa'i lha mi ba rnams nas gasku la dpon sku rten du dgongs zhu zhus pa 'di'i skor tan tan byas na yag gi red ces de mo rin po che'i mdun rtsasgo phye bar btang ste rjes sor thub bstan rig 'dzin yar lha sham wa'i chos rjer gtan 'khel nas lho khar bskyod/'di tsam du ma zad dus rgyun lha 'dre lta bu khog brlams byung rigs rnams sku mdun du mjal bcar zhus skabs phal cher de shā rin po che'i mdun du gtong gnang ba las/ dam pa rang nyid nas bka' bsgos dam bzhag sku gas dngos su mi mdzad/ mang ra dgon du mdzad sgo grub mtshams dga' ldan la phebs zhor lho brag grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes nges don du rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag po mi'i gar gyis rnam par rol ba tsam du ma zad/ thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor yang / yi dam de nyid kyis rjes su bzung ste/ nam 'dod du mi dang mi 'phrad pa ltar gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa bstsal zhing / rje tsong kha pa chen

dgung grangs so bzhi'i thog rgyud pa 'i bla ma dbu mdzad dang / de rjes rgyud pa'i mkhan po 69pos kyang bka' gdams man ngag pa dang / lam rim pa gnyis kyi bshad srol ltar gyi lam rim gsan yul de'i sku gdung lho brag 'bum pa zhes pa de'i nye 'dabs su dbu gur sgron te nyin gsum ring sku bzhugs gnang / skye 'gro rnams la steng 'og bar gsum gyi gdon bgegs kyis mi tshugs pa dang / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs paci) sems can rnams kyi rgyud la grub chen de nyid kyi thugs rgyud la ji ltar 'khrungs pa ltar thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rtogs pa myur du skye ba sogs kyi thugs smon dang 'brel gsung ngag bcad de zhabs rjen mar skor tshad ltar zhabs skor brgya dang lnga bcu grangs gsog gnang skabs zhabs mthil la chu bur thon te nyin shas sku mnyel sngo/ byung / dang thog zhabs phyi tshang mas rin po che dang lhan du skor ba bsags kyang / rjes su skor tshad longs pa blo bzang lung rigs gcig pu byung /de nas dga' ldan du phebs te lho pa khang tshan gyi yang thog tu bzhugs/ rgyud khang du tshogs su phebs rgyu sogs bla ma dbu mdzad kyi mdzad sgo rnams ma nyams par gnang / rje rin po che'i sku gdung chen mo'i spyan sngar mchod pa stong tshar dang 'brel gnas gzigs dang mchod 'bul sogs dga' ldan la nam phebs su mdzad/ dga' ldan dbyar chos grol nas lha sar phyir phebs skabs ldan zhes sngar dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang gi grub thob chen po rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags zhes pa rje nyid kyi 'khrungs rabs su gsal ba de nyid yun ring bzhugs pa'i gnas kyi thad la gzigs te khong gis sgrub pa nyams len mdzad tshul dang /chos 'chad tshul sku/gas kyi rnam thar 'ga' re zhabs ṇ+ḍi dang slob ma rnams la bka' bstsal/bod zla lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga 'dzam gling spyi bsangs kyi nyin slar yang rwa mo che'i yang thog tu zhabs sor 'kho da/ gtsug lag khang du 'o/ re bzhin rgyud stod chortags yongs nas gsang bde 'jigs gsum res mos kyis rab gnas dge legs char 'bebs mdzad srol ltar/ cho ga rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas dam ye dbyer med du mdzad/ bod zla drug pa'i

70 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul ldo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa mjug tu rgyud grwa rnams se rar codas thog tu phebs par der yang bla ma dbu mdzad kyi mdzad sgo rnams nyams med bskyangs/ sngo da zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu bzhi nyin brag yer par phebs/rgyud stod dang / yer pa grwa tshang gi dge 'dun pa rnams dang lhan du dbyar phyi ma zhal bzhes mdzad srol ltar dge 'dun rnams la tshul shing 'grems pa/ khrims su bca' ba brjod pa/ gnas khang dang / mal chas bstabs pa sogs dbyar gyi gzhi las bshad pa ltar mdzad/ thig rjodang nyin bdun gyi rjes thig chen nyin gsum ring khang tshan so so'i thig rur phebs te dge bshes rnams la chodas bslangs dang / mtshon snga na/ mamyosad g.yog pa rnams la dkyil 'kho ra gyi chortan thig gsar bu pa rnams la thig tsudzir sprod dang 'brel rgyugs bzhes nan tan mdzad/ dbyangs sbyong nyin gsum gyi ring chos grwar phebs/ gdong gral ba so so nas dbu bskul te rta dbyangs gyer bar lhan gsungs kyis zhib 'jug mdzad/ bla ma dbu mdzad lo dang wa'i skabs dge bshes rnams nas sngags kyi dam bcar babo/ gling rang 'dod bzhin bya sa med par rtags gsal 'di dang 'di lta bu zhes shog lhe gnang srol ltar dge bshes rnams la shog lhe gnang /bod zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer lnga nyin/ slo gling nyag re dge bshes dbang 'dus rgyal mtshan nas sngags kyi dam bca' 'jog skabs rin po che nas thog mar 'du khang du lus dkyil las brtsams pa'i brgal brtag mdzad par lan zhu rgyu dka' ngal byung tshul dge bshes rang nas gsungs/ de ltar brag yer par nyin lnga dang / bod zla dgu pa'i nang ston chos dang por nyin lnga re sngags kyi dam bca' tshugs ring rtsod dpang du rtag phebs kyis phri rgol rnams la bgro gleng yun ring thung gi tshad 'dzin dang / skabs 'gar rin po che rang nyid kyis kyang bgro gling mdzad/ de rjes lha sar phebs te bod zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis 7rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i dus chen gyi nyin sngar sku la gzhung gnas nas gdan zhus ltar sne shan pa rtse drung zhig gis spos snes sngun bsus te bla ma dbu mdzad dang / dge 'dun rnams rgan ga'on go rim ma 'chol bar bstar gcig tu sbrel/ zhi dul dang ba 'dren pa 'i spyod

dgung grangs so bzhi'i thog rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad dang / de rjes rgyud pa'i mkhan po 71lam 'phags pa rta thul gyi rjes su 'ching ba dang bcas rtse pho brang gi tshoms chen srid zhi'i phun tshogs su phebs/ gding rgyag zin rjes dgong ja la tshogs su lhan bzhugs gnang rjes lha sar phebs/ nyin rjes ma nas mabo na wa'i gtor sgrub tshugs par gsol tshogs su rtag phebs thog nyin tha mar rje nyid kyis rdo rje slob dpon mdzad de pho brang gi mdun zhol gzhung sgo'i phyi rol tu gtor zor 'phangs/ gtor rgyag grub rjes slar yang pho brang du phebs te mnga' gsol sogs mjug gi bya ba rnams mdzad/bod zla bcu pa'i nang ston chos gnyis pa tshogs par sngags kyi dam bcar bdun gcig ring rtag phebs kyis thugs zhib dang / de ga'i tshes nyer lnga 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pas bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sgyu ma'i sku mngon du mdzad pa'i dus chen nyin/rtse pho brang du 7rgyal mchog bcu gsum pa chen thorware na bza' gdan zhus thog rgyal tshab srid skyong rwa sgreng ho thog thu chen po dang / bka' shag bcas zhabs 'khod dang 'brel drung ja'i skabs sngar lam rgyud stod tshogs yongs lhan du dgun mjal la phebs/ drung ja grol rjes 'phags pa 'o/ ke shwa ra dang / gzhan yang gser sdong 'dzam gling rgyan gcig sogs la snyan shal thugs smon dang 'brel gnas gzigs lhod lhod mdzad/ dge ldan dgun chos kyi skabs gsar 'dzul byed mkhan bskyed rim pa rnams 'du khang gi sgo mchor du tshogs par bla ma dbu mdzad 'du khang du sngon phebs kyis byang 'dren dang lhan du bzhugs zin pa na/ sgo phye ba dang dus mnyam du tshang mas gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi dbu rgya gar skad du zhes pa nas brtsams te skad gsang mthon pos skyor ba dang bcas 'ur bsdebs kyis gdong gral g.yas g.yon gyi sa mthil rang du 'khod de/ rgyud gzhung le'u bcu gnyis pa yan dang / bde mchog margyud le'u dang po/ gsang 'dus kyi bdag bskyed smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pa dal bus skyor te rgyugs sprod zin mtshams gsang chen bstan pa'i 'byung gnas chen por sgrig zhugs byas pa'i dgos don/ khas blangs pa'i dam sdom dang / dge 'dun gyi sgrig

77 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pri khrims tshul bzhin du srung ba gzhir bzhag ste mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi lam la thos bsam sgom pa ya ma bral bar byed tshul sogs kyi bka' slob mdor bsdus bstsal/ rgyud grwar sgrig zhugs snga rting gis rgan gzhon phye srol yang / rgyud stod du rgyugs 'bul zhu mkhan tshang ma dus gcig la gsar zhugs byas rkyen sngar lha/la bla ma dkon gnyer nas tshang ma'i phreng ba bsdus te mi mthong bar gzan 'og tu bcug re re bzhin gzan 'og nas bton te so sos 1ras 'dzin byas rim bzhin tshogs su 'dug skabs sogs rgan gzhon bo rim dang mthun par byed/ de rjes bla ma dbu mdzad las shag tu phebs zin pa na/ khang tshan so so'i dge rgan nas snyan seng ltar gsar bu ba rnams rgyud pa'i sgrig khongs su tshud pa'i gnang ba bstsal/bod zla bcu gcig pa'i zla mjug tu dge ldan dgun chos su phebs/ gding rgyag gi dgong mor dge 'dun rnams dang lhan du 'du khang nang du gzims/ zhogs pa gsol ja dang po bzhes skabs dge ldan du bzhugs ring dge 'dun rnams kyi byed sgo'i skor tshogs gtam gnang / yangs pa can du bskang gso chen mo tshugs skabs tshogs dbur phebs pa sogs sngar srol bzhin mdzad/ bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang dga' ldan nas lha sar phyir phebs kyis rwa mo cher lcags mkhar chen snu tshugs skabs mchod g.yog pa rnams nas lcags mkhar zur dgu pa'i thig gdab tshul/ mchod gtor bzhengs tshul sogs rgyud dang mthun par byung yod med zhib gzigs mdzad/ lcags mkhar gyi nyin tha mar zhogs pa nas cho gas su phebs te 'du khang du 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bdag bskyed/ bka' sdod dam can chos kyi rgyal wa'i bskang gso gtor sgrub sogs dang / sgo mchor the gcal steng mtshon cha dgu skor sogs kyi bsgral chog grub rjes lcags mkhar blug gnang skabs thog mar me ma 'bar bar nag lhum lhum byas rjes glo bur me ha cang chen po ril ril lta bu zhig thon te liṅga mer bsregs/ slar yang nam mkhar me chen po zhig skad sgra dang bcas 'bar bas

dgung grangs so bzhi'i thog rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad dang / de rjes rgyud pa'i mkhan po 73chog grwa dge 'dun dang / zhal mjal zhu mi skya ser rnams nas ngo mtshar che tshul brjod/de rjes gtor rwa ra 'phen pa sogs sngar gyi phyag bzhes ji bzhin ma nyams pa mdzad/me glang zla ba dang wa'i tshes gcig nyin rtse pho brang gi tshoms chen du gnam lo gsar tshes kyi rten 'brel dga' ston mdzad sgo'i skabs 7skyabs rje rin po che dang / dga' ldan shar rtse mkhan sngo phu khang 4 nga sprul sku rnam gnyis nas tshogs langs gnang ba rin po che nas mdzod kyi/de nyid tshangs tshul tshangs pa yi/ /'khor lo tshangs pas bskor phyir ro/ /zhes pa las brtsams te bgro gling mdzad/ bla ma dbu mdzad lo dang wa'i skabs 'dir nyin gcig rwa che'i yang thog nas gling skor phyi rol du bshan pas lug gcig gasku da grabs byed pa gzigs ma thag zhabs phyi zhig ched mngags gtong gnang gis bshan par 'dod mos ltar gyi dngul gnang ste lug de srog blu mdzang de tshe ring zhes ming btags/ rwa cher rgyud pa'i sgrig khrims stabs kyis lug nyar mi chog par brten bla brang du 'jog par mdzad/ de'i skabs rgyal mchog sku gong ma'i gsung 'bum phyogs sgrig dang / gser sdong dge legs 'dod 'jo'i dkar chag 7skyabs rje stag brag rin po ches mdzad pa de la rtsom pa po rang nas zhus dag gnang rogs zhes zhus pa ltar/ 25gas la phebs dgos 14gas ha cang mdzad brel med skabs zhal khu sim ched bzhugs gdan dang / bya g.yab bcas bsnams te chab rdzing gling khar mi mang 'du 'dzoms de tsam mi byed pa'i sa cha zhig la bya g.yab skyon te bzhugs/ tshe lug de yang nye 'khor la bsdad/ gling kha der bzhugs ring dkar chag phyag dper zhus dag gnang / de ltar yang yang phebs stabs rgyud grwa 'ga' shas kyis rang re'i bla ma dbu mdzad ni so so'i bzhugs yul der ma bzhugs par rtag tu gling gar phebs kyi 'dug ces 'phya smod bya tshul thugs nang gtsang yul 'ga' shas nas zhus par/ khong tshos

74 4skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sbrul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa nga gling gar 'gro ba'i don gnad ji bzhin ma shes pa red/ snying rje zhes gsungs te thugs snang gang yang ma gnang /yang 'di'i skabs yas mas shig la ris bral bstan pa sku ngas rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag khu nu bla ma rin sngo che bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan mchog nas 7skyabs rje rin po che'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi mtshan snyan gsan te rwa cher mjal khar phebs skabs chos kyi bgro gling mdzad par phan tshun gnyis gas gcig gis gcig gi mkhyen yon la thugs yid 'aho/gas te chos 'brel gsan res mdzad/ 7skyabs rje rin po che nas de sngon rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha'i drung nas dbyangs can sgra mdo'i steng nas sgra'i bka' khrid gsan grub mod/ khu nu rin po che sgra rig la mkhas pa'i rtser son gyi mtshan snyan shin tu che bar brten nyin gcig bla brang gi yang thog tu rgya khang zhig yod pa der gsan sbyong dbu 'dzugs kyis dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i nang snga rabs kyi mkhas pa sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen zhes rje the nga kha pas sgra'i bka' khrid gsan yul des mdzad pa'i ṭika'i steng nas sgra mdo ka la pa'i bshad khrid gsan/ de rjes sdeb sbyor dang / snyan ngag rtsaba'i steng nas snyan ngag gi bka' khrid kyang gsan/ phan tshun thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur te/ rjes sor rgya gar du phebs grub nas kyang chos bka' gsan tshul skor gsham du gsal/ khu nu bla ma rin po che ni byang chub kyi sems la thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad pa'i bya btang grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po zhig yin pa ma zad/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas sogs kyi lha ra bka' 'dri ji zhus la gsung lan bstsal chodag yod tshul gyi bsngags brjod yang yang mdzad/rin po che bla ma dbu mdzad kyi mtshan khur bzhes te lo gnyis pa'i skabs brag yer par dbyar gnas kyi ring yer pa'i rtsis pa 'phrin las dbang grags zer ba sman rtsis khang nas cadab sbyong thon pa de'i mdun nas rtsis kyi sa ris kyang cha tshang gsan/ khong gshis ka 'jam zhing rtsis la mkhas tshul sogs bstod bsngags mdzad/ lo mang jo mo lha ri dang /

dgung grangs so bzhi'i thog rgyud nga 'i bla ma dbu ma dzad dang / de rjes rgyud nga 'i mkhan po 75de rjes yer par bzhugs pa'i bya btang ba chog mo mtshams pa ba zhu mkhan chos pa bzang po zhig yod pa kho nga gi shag tu chos zhu ba bzhi bcu tsam zhig la 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang chen sta gon dang bcas pa bstsal ba/ de ni yer pa'i lha khang nyams gso'i do dam pa rgyal rtse mkhan chung gis zhus ngor bka' dbang gnang ba zhig red/ mtshams pa ba 'di nyid la ha cang mnyes po gnang zhing / khong nam bcar la gsol ba zhal lag 'bul du 'jug pa gnang / khong bzhes thug man chin la dga' po yod stabs bla brang du bzhes thug man chin nam bzhengs skabs thog steng du gzan dmar po zhig shing la bkal te 'jog dgos pa zhabs zhu ba tshor bka' mngags gnang gi yod pa de ni bzhes thug man chin bzhengs kyi yod pa'i brda ston lta bu yin pa dang / mtshams pa 'di nyid nas nyin gcig slob ma zhig la zhal lag mog mog bzo rogs gsungs pa ltar bzhes mog mchod zin pa'i rjes su sku gshegs pa'i lo rgyus kyang gling /dge bshes rnams dang / rab 'byams pa rnams las gzhan rgyud grwa rnams dang por gsar zhugs skabs gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud le'u bcu gnyis pa yan dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u dang po/ gsang 'dus bdag bskyed sogs 'don cha mang po blo 'dzin rgyugs sprod byed dgos kyang / ji skad du/ spyod 'jug las/shes bzhin med pa'i sems ldan pa'i/ /thos dang bsam dang lha ma pa yang / /glo rdol bum pa'i chu bzhin du/ /dran pa la ni de mi gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'ga' zhig nas/ brjed ngas rkun wa'i gzhan dbang du gyur nga sogs kyis tshogs su 'don pa 'ur po de tsam ma byung zhing / 'don cha rnams rang rkya

76 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa 'pher ba nges par dbo/sa pa bzhin/ tshang mas brjed gsos byas na ma gtogs rgyugs len skabs/ 'don mi thub pa'i rigs la nyes chad gcod nges yin tshul tshogs brda snga phyi thengs gsum tsam gnang / de rjes rgyugs bzhes dbu 'dzugs gnang / nyin grangs mang por rwa che'i 'du khang gi bsil yang thog rin po che dang / byang 'dren chen mo/ dge bskos bcas lhan 'dzoms sar grwa grangs bdun tshan rer dbye ste rgyugs bzhes dang 'ga' zhig la rang rkya 'pher min gyi thugs dogs byung skabs de nyid gcig por skyor du bcug gcig la gsang 'dus kyi gzhal yas khang bskyed tshul nas 'don dgos gsungs par/ des gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi gzhal yas khang bskyed tshul rnams phan tshun 'dres nas rang rkya ma 'pher bas 'o na gsang 'dus kyi bstod pa nas 'don dgos zhes gsungs/ bstod pa zhes pa ci yin nam zhes zhus par/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar / kho 'jigs skrag rkyen gyis gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa tsam las/ bar gyi tshig rnams ma dran par/ bzhad snu shor te/ zhal ngo nag sngo bton gnang dang bcas te rgyugs bzhes mdzad/ rgyugs ma 'phrod pa'i rigs rnams kyis bye rags nas so so rang gi chos rur bye ma dbor dgos pa tsam du ma zad/ mang ja tshogs nye'i skabs tshang ma rdo gcal du 'du 'dzoms sar so so'i bye ma'i do po rgyab tu 'khur nas bsdad par bla ma dbu mdzad kyis thugs zhib gnang / gcig la dge bskos kyis 'bog thag zhu ru bcug pa sogs mdzad/ de'i skabs 'ga' zhig gis bla ma dbu mdzad 'dis rang re rnams bong bu dang 'dra bar nyes chad 'di ltar gnang gi 'dug ces skur 'debs zhus/ de ltar do dam chen po gnang ba'i mthu las tshogs 'asnga na ha cang legs po chags par grwa bgres rnams kyis bstod bsngags kyi me tog 'thor/ de mtshungs skabs der yul gyi nang 'brum nad khyab gdal ci che byung yang rgyud grwa tshos bye ma 'or 'dren gnang dgos byung pa des grwa nyung shas ma gtogs spyi byings rnams 'brum nad las thar lugs brjod/

dgung grangs so bzhi'i thog rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad dang / de rjes rgyud pa'i mkhan po 77bde mchog gi bdag 'jug tshugs skabs shig la gung tshigs mang ja'i skabs mkhan po tshogs su phebs mo thub par bla ma dbu mdzad nyid nas sbyang chog gi+o slob dpono mdzad par/ pha rgyud la mchad pa g.yas nas mag brtsams/ ma rgyud la g.yan nas mag brtsam dgos pa de ltar yang / mchod g.yog pas 'jigs byed bdag 'jug skabs ltar bsgrigs pa thugs zhib 'chugs te bka' bkyon drag po dang bcas kho par dge bskos nas 'bog thag kha shas gzhu dgos bka' khyab gnang / yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i bdag 'jug chen mo tshugs nye zhig gi skabs mchod g.yog gis rdul tshon blugs stangs nor bar kho rang tshon phor lag tu thogs te tshogs su gral bskor du gtong gnang mdzad/yang thengs gcig zhogs tshogs shig gi skabs mgon khang byang 'dren gnyid khug par dang po bla ma dkon gnyer la mchod me gcig byang 'dren gyi mdun du 'jog bcug da dung yang kho pa gnyid la yang yang shor bar rdo rje zhig lag tu gtad de tshogs ma grol bar lang ste sdod dgos pa sogs sgrig khrims skor la ha cang nan po mdzad/de snga phyi lo 1910 tsam la man ju'i dus skabs su rgya nag nas btsan 'dzul dus zing byung pa'i rkyen gyis rgyud grwa'i sgrig khrims kyang phran bu'i nyams chag tu gyur pa rnams/7skyabs rje dam pa 'dis slar sor chud par mdzad pa bka' drin shin tu che zhes rgyud grwa rnams kyis bstod bsngags kyi me tog 'thor/ bla ma dbu mdzad gnang ring lo dang gnyis so sor yer par gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi bris thig dang / rdul tshon sogs kyi skor rgyugs bzhes gnang zhing / dkyil 'khor blos bslangs bzhengs rgyu'i lag len slob khrid rgyun spel gyis sbyangs 'bras dkyil 'khor gsar bzhengs dang 'brel rgyugs bzhes gnang rgyu sogs lo sasum pa'i skabs su gnang rtsis kyang / phyi lo 1928 lor mkhan po las thog pa bkra shis rnam rgyal sku tshe ma zin par brten rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog nas rin po che gang nyid 'phral du mkhan wa'i mtshan bzhes sanang dgos tshul phebs/ zla tshes sogs zhib

78 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa cha ma nges kyang / gza' skar dge ba zhig gi snga char zhogs tshogs dang tsha rnying gi bar grwa tshang gi yang steng bla ma dbu mdzad kyi bzhugs yul nas srid pa ho yi phyag rgya sngon 'khyer dang 'brel khang tshan lnga'i dge rgan/ byang 'dren chen mo/ dge bskos sogs kyis spos snes sngun bsus te mchod pa khang gi ltag sgo brgyud lcang rag gi tshoms chen nang phebs te/rje btsun kun dga' don grub kyi bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod pa dang dus mnyam du grwa tshang sogs kyis maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dang / gsol ja bzhes 'bras phul te khri 'don thog ma der mdzad/ dge 'dun rnams tsha rting la phebs te tshogs gzhug 'gril ba dang chabs cig lcang rag rgyal sgo nas phebs thon gyis rdo gcal zur la srid pa tho'i rgyab yig klog zin pa na/ spos sne ba rnams 'du khang du phebs te/ mchod gsham g.yas pa nas gral mgo bar bstar bsgrigs pa na rin po ches gdong gral gyi dbus rgyal mtshan gyi 'og phying dmar bting ba'i steng nas sku phyag lan gsum gnang / kha che gur kum sogs kyis kha bsgyur ba'i 'thor 'bru me tog bcas gtor gnang mdzad/ mgon thang rin po che'i mdun du phebs nas snyan shal phul grub mtshams/ dkon gnyer nas klong jo la mchod kong zhes pa sngar bya bral grub pa'i dbang phyug klong rdol bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang nas phul ba'i mchod kong mar khus bkang pa phyag tu phul bar thugs smon dang 'brel mchod me zhal phye gnang / sku ber bzhes te tshogs yongs nas mdun bskyed kyi skabs 'og min nas 7rgyal ba rnams spyan pungs te mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ zhes gsungs pa'i tshig mtshams su rgyud don ji bzhin 'doms pa la bsnyengs pa dang bral ba'i chos kyi rje rgyud grwa'i mkhan po na rim gyi bzhugs khrir phebs/ rgyud stod grwa tshang dang / gling bla brang / 'bras blo gling grwa tshang sogs nas maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dang / rim gyis 'brel yod dad ldan rnams nas mjal dar phul ba dgyes bzhes mdzad/ bla brang nas de nyin rten mchog spyan sngar mchod sprin dang / tshogs yongs la bsnyen bkur nyin 'khyongs/ sku 'gyed mjal dar bcas

dgung grangs so bzhi'i thog rgyud nga 'i bla ma dbu mdzad dang / de rjes rgyud pa 'i mkhan ngo 79phul/ 'dus mang nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu nyer lnga ma gsungs te bdag gzhan lus ngag ces pa'i tshig mtshams su rgyud gzhung byang 'dren nas maṇ+ḍal cho ma bu dang bcas pa rin po che'i phyag tu phul/ rin po ches sangs rgyas codas tshogs ma lan gsum dbu bskul gyis 'dus mang nas gsungs zin pa na/ lha dang lha min mi dang mi'am ci'i dbang po sogs gsungs te dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha klu sogs la chos nyan par bskul rjes 'dus pa'i margyud kyi dbu nas ljags lung gang 'tshams shig bstsal rjes dge mabasngo ba'i tshigs bcad dbu bskul dang 'brel mjug tu chos 'chad nyan las byung ba'i dge marnams bstan pa rgyas pa dang / 'gro ba bde ba'i thabs su bsngo bar mdzad/dus rgyun mkhan 1tshere bzhugs khang ha cang chung bas rgyud khang gi nye 'dabs ru mo che bde gsal zhes pa'i grwa tshang gi khang pa de dag phran bu gu yangs stabs mkhan ngo'i mtshan gnas bzhes ring bzhugs yul der gra sgrig zhus pa ltar grwa tshang gi las sne tshos spos snes sngun bsus te gdan drangs/ de rjes rtse pho brang du gsar mjal zhu bar phebs/ rtse pho brang gi rang byung 'phags pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po sku/gas kyi nang bzhugs pa'i rten gatho rnams la gnas gzigs mchod 'bul dang 'brel sngags kyi 'chad nyan bla nas blar spel ba'i mdzad pa mkha' khyab bstan 'gro'i gsos su smin pa'i thugs smon mdzad/bod zla gsum pa'i nang chu mdar phebs te rgyud khang gi sgo mchor steng gi rab gsal nang bzhugs/ tshes nyer drug gi zhogs pa chos rur zhabs sor 'kho da/ chos thodag lha ra mkhan gyi dge bshes rnams dang / bskyed rim pa rgan gras rnams nas sku phyag gsum re 'tshal rjes byang 'dren chen mo yar langs te maṇ+ḍal dbu bskul zin pa na/ rin pri+o ches dbu zhwa bzhes te/ rgyud ṭika gi dbu nas brtsams te shog bu phyed tsam thugs thog nas dal bus tshig mtshams bcad phyogs kyis gzhung sngo na la go ba rags tsam bskyed nus pa dang bcas te tshar gnyis/ de rjes dbu zhwa bsil te/ lung rigs kyi spros pa dang bcas tshig gcig

80 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen shu 'i mjad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa/ kyang ma lus par 'byu snon gyi bshad pa mdzad rjes/ bla ma dbu mdzad gsar pa 'bras blo gling mi nyag khra'u chos mdzad nas brtsi bzhag tshar gcig yar skyor bar dgyes bzhin du gsan/ de rjes 'dzin grwa gnyis par gong ltar rgyud ṭika gsum par paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas mdzad pa'i gsanga'adus rdzogs rim/ bzhi par des mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus bskyed rim bcas kyi steng nas brtsi bzhag gnang / nyin gung dgung tshigs grol rjes sngar bzhin du chos khrir phebs/ byang 'dren chen mos dbu bskul ltar tshang mas 'grel gtor dang / de rjes rin po che nas shes rab snying po dang / bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang sogs dbu bskul mdzad/ de rjes 'dus mang nas bla brgyud gsol 'debs gsungs te/ dam pa gang nyid kyis 'grel pa bzhi sbrags gsan yul mi shig khri pa ye shes dbang ldan gyi mtshan sgra 'i gsol 'debs kyi thad du shog ka li kha phye bar mdzad/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rim pa cha tshang ba'i sngon 'bo|rno chos bshad grub rjes/ 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi bshad lung dbu tshugs/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis nyin bstud de 'chad spel mdzad/sngar dus rabs bco lnga pa'i nang lha sar chu skyon chen po zhig 'byung nye'i skabs gzhung gnas nas gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar/ rgyud chen kun dga' don grub kyis rgyud kyi 'chad nyan sanang bzhin pa'i skabs/ chu yi steng du bcag par bya/ /zhes pa'i tshig mtshams su gtsang por bzhugs gding bskyon te lha sar phebs pa red ces pa'i ngag rgyun dang mthun par sngar srol ltar gong tshigs de'i skabs 'chad nyan cung zad bar seng 'jog par mdzad/de ltar 'chad nyan zin rjes lhag pa'i lha gang gi sgo nas yin pa ma shes kyang las rung zhig gnang tshul khyodas/bod zla bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin brag yer par rgyud grwa yongs rdzogs dang / yer pa grwa tshang gi dge 'dun lhan 'dzoms sar so thar gyi mdo rgyas pa bsgrags rjes/ dbyar bdag bsko ba dang / tshul shing bzhes pa sogs mdzad/ nyin shas rjes gsang 'dus 'grel

dgung grangs so bzhi'i thog rgyud pa 'i bla ma dbu mdzad dang de rjes rgyud pa 'i mkhan po 81ba bzhi sbrags kyi bshad lung gi lhag 'phro dang / bde mchog cangargyud/ sbas don kun gsal sbrags pa'i bshad lung bcas bstsal/ yang nyin gcig khrid khang du gdan zhus ltar phebs te gsang 'dus dang rta mgrin sogs kyi las rung gtong mkhan rnams la rje'i gsung khyodags rim rnal 'byor chen mo sku gas kyi bshad pa bstsal/ 'di'i skabs snga dgong du gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i las rung zhig gnang grub mtshams chosags yongs kyis gsang 'dus kyi sbyin sreg gnang skabs slob dasngo na mdzad dgos pa ltar kha skong gi sbyin sreg des 'thus pa mdzad/ lha sar ston chos dang po dang gnyis par bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho dang / rdzogs rim rim lnga gsal lha na gnyis kyi bshad lung / dgun chos lcags mkhar skabs 'jigs byed kyi rtsargyud shodag bdun gyi bshad lung bstsal/ bar lam rgyud grwar rtog bdun gyi 'chad nyan nyams sku da kyang dam pa 'di nyid kyis slar gso mdzad de dus da lta'i bar ma nyams par gnas/ bla ma dbu mdzad nas sgrig khrims gnon ༷ ma dang / mkhan wa'i phyag las gatho bo chos 'chad spel gnang rgyur brten 'chad nyan la ha cang gi thugs 'khur che bzhes mdzad/gsang 'dus kyi bskyed rdzogs gnang skabs shig la de 'o'i chos thog bskor mkhan dge bshes 'ga' shas kyis so sku'i gdan sar kha zas len par 'bo/ rtsis kyis 'chad nyan la bcar mi dathodas pa'i dathodangs zhu zhus par ha cang gi thugs pham byung tshul rjes sor yang yang gsungs/ 'o/ khams gang yin ma nges pa zhig gi bod zla gsum pa'i tshes btso lnga nyin/ rtse pho brang gi cho mas chen srid zhi'i phun tshogs su 'bras sgo mang khang sar swā rje 'chang ngag dbang thub bstan chos kyi dbang phyug dpal bzang gro'i drung nas 7skyabs rje stag brag rin po che sogs dang lhan du bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor 'o'i dbang chen yongs su rdzogs pa gsan/ de'i skabs/ 'dir 'jug pa ni skal ba bzang ngo zhes sku gas kyi tshigs bcad drangs te sngon 'gro'i chodas bshad mdzad tshul gsungs shing / gsung bshad rnams la zin bris kyang 'debs par mdzad/ yang de rjes shig la phyag drung rta dbang gi shag tu/ rmog

87 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul ldo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa lcog rin po che ye shes byams pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs chos zhu ba sum brgya tsam la khang sar rin po ches 'jigs mdzad rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams khrid bstsal ba gsan bzhes kyi khrid dmigs skyong rgyu sogs dam pa'i phyag bzhes ltar mdzad/'di'i skabs nyid kyi yongs 'dzin rwa stod mkhan zur rgan lo yag rin po che yang gsung chos la phebs yod par bka' chos tshugs grol sogs kyi skabs lhan phebs kyis zab pa dang rgya che ba'i bka' mchid lhug par grol/ yang skabs shig la bla ma dkon gnyer nas mgon thang rin po che'i mdun du r+bhe dro rgyun mchod 'bul rgyu'i mchod me dngul kong phyag tu phul te thugs smon zhu skabs yong don gtan nas med par 'o ma lta bu dkar po zhig sku pang du babs par khyad mtshar lugs tsam las ma gsungs kyang / rtags rten legs pa zhig tu mngon/phyi lo 1939 zla ba drug pa'i tshes drug dang / bod zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer gsum nyin kho bo thog mar mdo smad a mdo nas lha ldan rgyal khab tu 'byor skabs rin po che nyid brag yer par dge 'dun rnams dang lhan gcig tu dbyar phyi ma zhal bzhes mdzad spos kyang /gzhung zhabs yongs snyu gas dang mkhan po khri gdan zur sogs dang chabs cig 'dod rgu thang du phebs par gzim gur rma bya chen mor tshe rabs nas las smon gyis 'brel ba'i dam pa 'di nyid kyi mthong na don yod pa'i zhal dkyil mngon sum du mjal ba'i dga' ston thog mar myong / a mdo 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku 'phreng lnga pas bkra shis 'khyil du rgyud stod grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs kyis thig rdul chortan/ cho ga phyag bzhes sogs dbus kyi rgyud khyodad dang mthun par 'byung ched dge rban gnyis grwa tshang nas gtong gnang dgos tshul zhus par/grags pa khang tshan khongs brag g.yab mchod g.yog pa bstan pa chos ldan dang / a masngo khang tshan khongs gdong gral pa ye shes don grub gnyis gtong sanang mdzad pa ltar/ khong gnyis kyis bkra ris 'khyil du dbus kyi rgyud stod pa'i phyag bzhes gsar btod byas/ ngos 7rgyal mchog song ma'i yang srid du brtag dpyad ngos 'dzin dang 'brel rgyal khab tu bde

dgung grangs so bzhi'i thog rgyud si 'i bla ma dbu mdzad dang / de rjes rgyud nga/'i mkhan ngo 83'byor byung bas lha mo gtsor gyur chos srung dam can rgya mtshor gtang rag 'bul ba sogs kyi ched dam pa 'di nyid chos 'bor rgyal du 'phral phebs dbos tshul gzhung nas bka' phebs pa ltar/ bod zla bcu pa'i tshes shar la sne shan rtse drung gcig dang / bla brang gi phyag gsol/drel pa sogs zhabs phyi 'ga' shas dang bcas rgyal me tog thang du phebs/phyi lo 1509 lor rgyal masnu ga sku 'phreng gnyis pa thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos phyag btab pa'i gdan sa chen po chos 'khor rgyal legs bshad sgrog pa'i dga' tshal bkra shis lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du nyin bcu gsum tsam bzhugs/ de ga'i dge 'dun pa dang lhan du nyin grangs mang por 7rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las kyi rang gzugs ma gcig re ma tir 'bum tshogs dang 'brel mchod pa'i sprin phung spros te/ ngos nas 7rgyal mchog sku 'phreng na rim gyi mdzad pa phyobs gcig tu bsdus pa lta bu'i bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po byed thub nga/ sogs kyi mthun 'gyur dgos pa'i 'phrin las gnyer du gtad/ nyin gcig mu le ding gi mtsho gang du yod pa'i ri rtser phebs/ de dus bla mtsho phyed tsam la dar 'grigs stabs yin nam sbas pa'i tshul gyis ma gsungs pa gang yin ma shes kyang / dam pa nyid la mtsho gzigs gtan nas ma byung zhes phebs/ grwa pa gcig bla mcho'i nye 'gram du mngags te bum pa mtshor 'bul brgas byas kyang lam la 'khyag pa chags par brten 'gro ma thub par bum pa lha mo khang du phul/ bla brang nas de ga'i dge 'dun rnams la sku 'gyed/ gsol ja sogs gzab 'bul thog rten gtso khag gi mdun du mchod tshogs kyis bkang bar mdzad/ de nas rgyal lha thog tu g.yag chibs te phebs/ mkha' 'gro snying phug tu grags pa'i tshogs khang du spong ba pa rnams la bsnyen bkur dang / tshe gcig la zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa'i grub chen thar pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi sku brnyan la snyan yal 'bul gnang dang 'brel thugs smon yun ring mdzad/ bod zla bcu pa'i tshes nyer lnga nyin/ rje rin ngo/ ches bsags sbyangs sogs yun ring mdzad nga 'i gnas khyad

84 4skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen wa 'i mjad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa par can 'ol kha chos lung du phebs/ ri khrod kyi 'du khang du spong ba pa rnams tshogs te/dbu mdzad nas bde chen ngang las rang nyid bla ma lha/ /zhes bla mchod kyi dbu bskul ba dang / rin po che 'du khang du phebs pa ma bsgrigs lhun grub kyis dus mtshungs su gyur pa/ nges pa'i don du 'jigs mdzad khro bo gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gar du rol ba ma zad/ thun mong ba'i snang ngor yang rje thams cad mkhyen pa slar yang byon pa dang mtshungs pa'i mdzad pa bzang pos bstan 'gro'i don chen skyong pa'i rtags mtshan lta bur go der sku phyag dang / phyag gi stangs ka dang bcas te maṇ+ḍal phul/ 'du khang chung stabs sgrub sde nas gzim chung gzhan zhig tu gdan drangs par lhod bzhugs kyis ha cang spro nyams mdzad/de nas gdan sa mthil dang / zangs ri khang dmar du phebs/ zhi byed pa'i chos brgyud rgya cher gsal bar mdzad pa po ma gcig lab sgron gyi sku brnyan 1/gas la snyan shal dang 'brel mchod 'bul gnang / de nas rtsed thang du phebs/ lnga mchod grwa tshang gi yang thog tu bzhugs/de nyin 'cham gyi dus mchod 'khel bas 'cham la yang thugs zhib gnang / rim gyis yar lam khra 'brug tu gnas gzigs su phebs/ sgrol ma gsung byon mas dbus rten gtso rnams la gser chab sgron 'bul dang 'brel mchod 'bul mdzad/ bla brang gi 'dzin khongs thos bsam dar rgyas gling grwa tshang nas gdan zhus ltar phebs te nyin shas bzhugs 'jags chodagabasnyen bkur dang / khul de'i ser skya mang tshogs la chos 'brel bka' slob bstsal/ dar rgyas gling du nyin shas bzhugs mus kyi skabs lha ldan rgyal khab tu 'phral la phyir phebs kyis ngos kyi mtshan zhabs gnang dgos tshul rwa sgreng rgyal tshab rin sngo / ches bka' rgya phebs pa ltar lha sar phebs thon gnang zhor du bsam yas gtsug lag khang la yang mchod 'bul dang gnas gzigs mdzad//

7mtshan zhabs dang / sku/ngas 'dzin chung ba'i mtshan khur rim bzhes thogaspyi byer mdo sngags kyi zab chos rgya cher mdzad pa/khe /zhe༄༅༅//phyi lo 940zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gnyis/bod lcags 'brug zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu bzhi nyin/rtse pho brang gi tshoms chen srid zhi'i phun tshogs su ngos 7rgyal mchog sku 'phreng 7bo nga ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gdan khrir 'khod pa'i mdzad sgo'i skabs mtshan zhabs kyi gsar mjal gnang ste mkhan sde che ba rnams kyi gral mgor bzhugs/rgyud pa'i mkhan 1stu) mtshan khur bzhes mus stabs kyis dmigs bsal dgongs zhu gnang dgos rigs las de min drung jar yang rtag phebs gnang /skabs 'gar 7skyabs rje ke'u tshang rin po che dang lhan rgyas/ de min sku rkyang phebs te/ phran la ka kha'i slob khrid dang /chos spyod blo 'dzin sku/gas la ros/sa pa gnang /lha rams pa dang tshogs rams pa'i dge bshes sogs kyi rtsod rgyugs bzhes rgyu/smon lam chen mo'i skabs dge bshes lha rams pa rnams kyi dam bca' legs nyes la zhib 'jug ga/nang rgyu sogs mtshan zhabs kyi phyag las rnams dang /de mtshungs rgyud grwar chodas 'chad nyan sogs mkhan wa'i bgyi ba mtha' dag kyang nyams pa med par gnang /nor gling du mtshan zhabs kyi las shag phul yang / mtshan zhabs kyi las lnga/na yod skabs ma gtogs rgyud stod mkhan po gnang mus la brten sngar rgyun ra che bde gsal rang du bzhugs/'di'i skabs shig la phyag mdzod

86 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa 'phrin las chos 'phel 'das grongs su gyur par blo bzang lung rigs la mdzod pa bsko gzhag gnang / lo 'di'i zla ba brgyad pa'i nang brag yer par rgyud grwar 'char can gsung chodas gnang grub rjes yer pa grwa tshang gi 'du khang du lam rim nyams mgur gyi steng nas byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid dang / de rjes dpa' bo gcig pa'i bka' dbang dang / bskyed rdzogs kyi bka' khrid bcas bstsal zhing / de ni dpa' gcig gi bskyed snyu gas kyi bka' khrid gnang ba'i thog mar mngon/ bod zla bcu pa'i tshes nyer lnga nyin/ rtse pho brang du 'char can rgyud stod grwa tshang gi dgun mjal skabs ngos rang 'cho'i brtan bzhugs 'bul gnang la rin po che nas maṇ+ḍal ljags bshad dang 'brel rten gsum sogs 'bul 'degs gnang ba bdag gir zhus/ mdzad sgo grub rjes yig tshang las khungs brgyud mkhan 46) mtshan 'khur legs par grub pa'i dgongs snyan gnang / nyin shas rjes dgongs zhu'i bka' lan phyir phebs mtshams bla brang nas rgyud sgyu da tshogs yongs la bsnyen bkur gsol ja dang / bzhes tsha 'bras thug legs pa/ spyi 'bul ka ring rnams la gos stag shun gyi ka 'phan dang / dge 'dun rer sku 'gyed srang gsum sgor mo re gnang / 7skyabs rje pha bong kha'i gsung /sdi+ob pa'i bsku+on la thub dbang gnyis pa bzhin/ /lngang rto—ོgas dam chos 'dzin la zla bral ba/ /hūṃ ོma pakhri shīl ba'i 'asdin ོ༷sa sa gsum la/ /dbang bsgyur rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes mtshan sgra tshang ba'i gsol 'debs bla brang nas par bskrun dang 'brel 'grems spel zhus/ zhal 'asnga na dngos gzhi gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang chog yin kyang / gsol ja gnyis pa bzhes rjes 'dus mang nas bla brgyud gsol 'debs hrob 'don skabs rin po che'i mtshan bstod gsar 'jug zhus/ de nas rgyud gzhung gi dbu nas bzung dam tshig

mtshan zhabs dang / yongs 'dzin chung ba'i mtshan khur rim bzhes thog spyi byer mdo sngags 87chen wa'i dkyil 'khor rdul med pa gru bzhir byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ zhes pa'i bar lan gcig de nas/gsal ba de yi ngo bo nyid/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyis kun tu rgyas/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis kun tu khyab/ /'od zer 'phro ba mang po 'khrug /gsal ba la sogs dkyil 'khor ldan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /zhes pa'i bar lan gsum gsungs/ dgung tshigs grol rjes grwa tshang gi las sne/ dge bskos/ byang 'dren chen mo sogs nas gzab 'chor dang 'brel spos snes sngun bsus te/ rin po che chos dwar gdan drangs par/ 'grel pa bzhi sbrags yun mi ring tsam gnang /de nas slar yang grwa tshang yang thog tu 'khyug tsam phebs/ grwa mang dgong ja tshogs zin pa na/ grwa tshang dang / khang tshan so so'i las sne rnams kyis spos sne dang bcas sngar srol ltar chibs thog tu bla brang du phebs/ chibs stegs steng nas bshol ba dang dus mtshungs stabs 'khel gyis phu khang khang tshan gyi dge rgan slo bur du rlung grib lta bus 'das grongs su gyur par thugs smon mdzad/ bla ma dbu mdzad gnang ring sgrig khrims gnon sdom sogs dang / mkhan po lo gsum gnang ring chos 'chad spel mdzad rgyu sogs gang cir gzur gnas rnam dpyod can rnams kyi smon yul du gyur stabs rgyud grwa mang po zhig gzim chung du bcar te legs gso'i mjal dar phul/ skabs shig la rje pha bong kha par/ mi rtag dran bskul snying gi thur ma sogs bla ma de nyid kyi ljags rtsom 'ga' shas kyi khrid gnang grub pa 'es snyan seng mdzad skabs phran bu'i spyan mi bde ba yod tshul phebs par/ 'o na rjes

88 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa su zhu 'thus chog pa zhes zhu gnang skabs/ nga rang gis brtsams par song dka' ngal mi yong gsungs te bka' khrid dgyes bzhin du gnang / 'on kyang /spur dang spur zhes bzang gos kyis btums kyang / /me phung dbus su bsregs dus zhig 'ong ngo / /zhes pa 'di rang re bla ma rnams la lab pa yin zhes bka' gnang ba tsam las/ gsung bshad gzhan gtan nas ma gnang / gcig byas na gsung chos snyan seng gnang skabs gsung 'phangs dma' pos snyan gsan gnang rkyen ji bzhin ma gsan pa e yin zhes kyang gsungs/yang ri khrod bkra shis chos gling du pha bong kha rin po ches stag phu'i dag snang sgrol ma tsistu ma ṇi'i sgrub thabs rtsa gzhung dang / rang rtsom bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid tsishī ma ṇi'i do shal bcas sbrags pa'i steng nas bskyed rdzogs kyi zab khrid/ bde mchog tshe lha dkar po'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar rdor bzlas kyi rlung la brten nas tshe bsring ba'i man ngag sogs kyi khrid lung bcas bstsal bar 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che sogs dang lhan du gsan/ de rjes rje pha bong kha par bde mchog tshe lha dkar wa'i sgo nas mkha' 'gro bsu zlog gi brtan bzhugs tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa 'bul gnang mdzad/bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu skor la dga' ldan khri thog go bzhi pa ser byes lhun grub brtson 'grus nas zhus ngor rje pha bong kha pa lha klur phebs te bde mchog lus dkyil sogs kyi bka' dbang gnang nye'i skabs sngon nas 'di'i skor dbang lung man ngag cha tshang gsan bzhes kyis thugs nyams su bzhes spos kyang / slar yang bka' dbang gsan bzhes ched der phebs te gsung chos snyan seng mdzad par da lam sbyin bdag khri rin po che nas zhu mkhan nyung ba gtsor 'don gnang rgyu yin na da res ma phebs kyang rjes su gsan chog rgyu zhes phebs pa ltar mdzad/ da phan ngos la chos kyi slob ston gtso bo yongs 'dzin stag
