ltar/ 7skyabs rje stag brag rin po che nas/ phyi lo 1941 bod lcags sprul zla ba dang ngo'i tshes gcig nyin srid skyong gi mdzad khur bzhes par brten bka' shag dang / yig tshang thun mong nas srid skyong rin po cher 'char 'bul phyag rtags dgongs don mtshan zhabs rgyud lha da mkhan zur gling rin po che nas yongs 'dzin chung ba'i mtshan khur bzhes dgos tshul rtse mgron gcig lha sa'i bla brang gzim chung du bcar te phyag rtags spyan bstar zhus/ de'i skabs srid skyong stag brag rin po che lha ldan kun bzang pho brang du bzhugs mus ltar de ga'i nyin mor dngos bcar gyis yongs 'dzin mdzad rgyu dka' tshul sogs kyi skor bka' slob zhu gnang mdzad par/ gling sku gong ma blo bzang lung rtogs bstan 'dzin 'phrin las nas 7rgyal mchog bcu gsum pa'i yongs 'dzin sku/ bdun las gnang rgyu ma byung bar brten/ da lan rin po che mchog nas sku gong ma de nyid kyi mdzad pa'i mjug skyong nges par gnang dgos tshul sogs phebs/ de 'o'i tshogs mchod grol rjes rje pha bong kha pa dwags po bshad sgrub gling dang / lto kha khul sogs la phebs nyer lha klur ched phebs mjal bcar gnang ste a ri nas gsar thon gyi sa bzhu gcig phyag rten du 'bul gnang thog zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi bka' mchid lhug por grol rjes pha bong kha rin po che nas yar sku bzhengs gnang ste mjal dar 'bul gnang thog ring min rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin mtshan bzhes gnang rgyu sogs legs po byung zhes dgyes mnyes chen po mdzad/ de lo bod zla drug pa'i tshes gcig nyin 7skyabs rje pha bong kha pa de nyid dgas po khul du mdzad 'phrin bskyangs pa'i dus tshod tha ma de chags te sku mya ngan las 'das tshul gsan skabs thugs khral ci che gnang zhing / gtsug lag khang yas mas sogs la mchod sprin rgya cher spros pa dang chabs cig de nyid kyi zag med thugs dgongs zab mo yongs su rdzogs pa dang /slar yang yang srid 'khrul bral nges rnyed myur du 'byon pa sogs kyi thugs smon mdzad/ jo

90 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa bo jes bla ma brgya dang lnga bcu'i nang nas gser gling pa 'gran gyi do med du bkur bar mdzad pa ltar mtshan nyid kyi gzhung chen khag las/ gzhan pa'i gsung chos gsan yul gtso bo yin pa ma zad/ khong la brten nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa 'i nyams lha gas kyi klong brdol ba'i tshul bzhes pas rje pha bong kha pa nyid rigs kyi bdag wa'i gtso bor mdzad/gzhan la chodas 'chad spel gnang skabs kyang / bla ma de nyid kyi gsung rgyun dang / phyag bzhes gtso bor gnang / spyir chos 'brel gsan yul sa dge bka' rnying gi bla ma rnams kyi mtshan rjen par gtan nas mi gsung zhing / lhag par rje pha thodang kha pa'i mtshan gsung skabs bla ma rdo rje 'chang zhes rtag tu gsung / rgyun du sku mdun du bcar mkhan rnams la yang / bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis 'di dang 'di ltar gnang zhes mdzad pa dang / gsung rgyun skor yang yang gsung zhing / bla ma'i snang ba dang mi 'bral ba'i rtags mtshan shin tu che/pha bong kha sku na dar ma'i skabs kyi sku par chung ngu zhig la de nyid kyi phyag rjes yod pa gser gyi ga'u chung ngu zhig gi nang bzhugs su gasku la te/ sku mya ngan las ma 'das bar gar phebs su 'bral med gdan zhu mdzad/ gzhan yang skar pa ri khrod du pha bong kha'i sku par la dngul gyi par sgrom gser tshags ldan pa zhig gi mthar rig ma bcu drug gi mchod lha rnams bzo ru bcug ste gzim chung du 'jog par mdzad/ lam rim zin bris rnam grol lag bcang gi rtsaba'i zin bris rwa stod brag g.yab gdong kong sprul skus pha bong kha pa'i mdun nas lam rim gsan skabs su btab pa de nyid kyi zhal bshus shig kyang rnam bo/la lag bcang par du ma thon bar gtan bzhugs gnang yul tshang mar gdan zhu gnang /7skyabs rje pha bong kha pa sku mya ngan las 'das tshul bstan pa'i rjes tsam la/ skyabs rje khang sar rdo rje 'chang de sngon nas bsnyun tshul bzhes spos dang / zhabs kyi skrangs pa je zhan du gyur pa gsan 'phral 'bras spungs su sardo rje 'chang de nyid kyi gzim yag tu phebs te sku phyag sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas mjal dar rten dod dang bcas bstan 'gro'i mgon du

mtshan zhabs dang / yongs 'dzin chung ba'i mtshan khur rim bzhes thog spyi byer mdo sngags 91zhabs zung yun du brtan pa'i gsol 'debs nan tan du mdzad par/ skabs der 7skyabs rje khang sar rdo rje 'chang gis ngas de sngon nas yang yang zhus pa ltar/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyun nges par spel bar mdzad dgos tshul sogs bstan 'tho'i don chen mdzad tshul ji snyed cig gi skor lam ston bka' slob dang / rin po che gang nyid kyis kyang thugs smon skyabs 'jug gnang dgos tshul sogs gsungs/ de rjes khang sar rin po che thar pa gling du phebs te bzhugs mus thog bod zla dgu pa'i tshes brgyad nyin dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bzhes pa'i mgyogs bsngo 'asdudar bar de 'phral mchod 'bul thugs smon rgya che mdzad/ de lo yas mas shig la nyid kyi yongs 'dzin rgan lo yag rin po che 'khrungs yul brag g.yab tu phyir phebs mdzad nyer phebs brdzongs sogs dngos 'bul rgya che dang bcas skyabs 'jug zhu gnang mdzad/ gong du bshad zin pa ltar dbu ma'i 'dzin grwar phebs nas lo gnyis par rgan lo yag rin po che yongs 'dzin du bsten te dbu ma'i lhag 'phro dang /'dul ba mtsho ṭika dang / mchims mdzod bcas kyi tshig gcig kyang ma lus par dpe khrid gsan par brten mtshan nyid gsan rjodang gnang yul gyi bla ma'i gtso bo zhig tu ngos 'dzin mdzad cing / khong gi mtshan brjod gnang skabs skyabs su mchi zhes yang yang gsungs thog khong ni thugs bskyed bzang ba dang / gzhung don nges cha che tshul sogs kyi che brjod dang 'brel gsung gi gdangs tshun chad la'ang lad mo mdzad de bka' slob 'di dang 'di ltar gnang zhes yang yang gsungs/ rgan lo yag rin po che nas kyang gling rin po che 'bras spungs su slob gnyer gnang skabs khong rang 'jang dgun chos su phebs nyer de'i shul rnam 'grel le'u gsum pa'i mab thugs 'dzin dgos tshul zhus pa ltar 'jang nas phyir phebs zin 'phral thugs 'dzin rgyugs sprod gnang tshul sogs ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul 'gran zla dang bral ba'i skyes bu dam pa zhig yin tshul khong nas gzhan la yang yang gsungs pa ma zad/ rjes sor khong gis yongs 'dzin rin sngo/ che'i mdun nas

97 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mjad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa chos 'brel gsan yod nges dang / yongs 'dzin rin po che la gus zhabs chen por mdzad cing / bla brang du rgan rin po che phebs skabs rnam gnyis bzhugs gdan mtho dman 'dra mnyam byas nas bzhugs/ phar phyin/ rnam 'grel/ dbu ma bcas gsan yul gyi ༄/ga ma'i mtshan nyid kyi yongs 'dzin nyag re dge bshes phun tshogs dam pa'i 'dra sku bzhengs rtsis gnang yang sku dpar med pas de mur lus/bod zla drug pa'i tshes nyer dgu nyin snga dro nor gling du yongs 'dzin chung ba'i bka' bsgyur mjal dar 'bul gnang mdzad/ de nyin sngar srol zho ston lha mo'i gzigs phud 'khel bar rten 'brel legs pa zhig tu mngon/ tshes grangs zhib cha ma nges kyang / yongs 'dzin khri 'don dngos gzhi'i skabs zhogs pa snga char lha sa'i bla brang du rgyud stod chog grwa dang bcas rwa stod chu dbar sprul sku nas maṇ+ḍal bshad pa/ bkra shis rtags rdzas sogs phul/ bkra shis mnga' gsol gyi bden tshig brjod pa dang bcas brtan bzhugs dang / nang ma'i rten 'brel mdzad sgo grub mtshams bla brang gi zhabs gras rnams dang / rtse sna da gzhung zhabs dang / gzim 'gag bcas chibs rags thog gtsug lag khang gnyis su gnas gzigs la phebs thog jo shāka rnam gnyis kyis dbus rten mchog rnams kyi spyan sngar mchod sprin sna lnga stong tshar dang 'brel thugs smon gnang rjes nor gling skal bzang pho brang du phebs te gzim chung du sku phyag dang 'brel ngos la maṇ+ḍal rten gsum gnang / de 'phral ngos nas kyang maṇ+ḍal rten gsum phul te/ chos 'brel zhig kyang zhus/ de nas nyi 'od du ngos dang /yongs 'dzin che ba srid skyong stag brag rdo rje 'chang bcas par sngar srol gsar mjal rten gsum sku/gas ba355 te yongs 'dzin gyi bzhugs khrir 'khod zin pa na gzhung gnas nas rten 'brel gyi dkar spro'i gsol ston sgrig gshoms dang 'brel legs 'bul mjal dar phul pa dang chabs cig bka' blon bzhi dang / spyi khyab mkhan po sogs rtse shod drung rigs ser skya las tshan pa yan chad kyis mjal dar re phul/ drung ja grol mtshams rtser 'phabs

mtshan zhabs dang / yongs 'dzin chung ba'i mtshan khur rim bzhes thog spyi byer mdo sngags 93pa lha khang sogs su gnas gzigs mchod 'bul grub mtshams lha sa bla brang du phebs/ der gzhung zhabs che phra dang chos sde chen po rnams kyi mkhan po dang / las sne/ bla sprul dge bshes sogs dad ldan brgya phrag mang pos rten 'byung legs 'bul bstar zhing / bkra shis lhun wa'i bla brang nas kyang sku tshab ched gtong thog kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che'i 'khrungs rabs kyi zhal thang rgya nag nas chodan pa'i 'thag drubs ma cha tshang zhig phul/ dgun dus yongs 'dzin rin po che bzhugs yul gzim shag rtse pho brang gi gzim chung 'og de snga yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan 1/gas dam pa du ma yun ring bzhugs te byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzim chung blo bzang mdun sar bzhugs shing / mjal kha zhu mkhan sku/da skabs dang /gsung chos gnang skabs las rgyun du gzim sbug chung ngu grang ngad can pho brang gi byang ngos rdzong rgyab klu khang dang / lha klu/ se ra sogs yul ljongs la zhal phyogs pa'i sge'u khung chung chung zhig yod pa de'i nang bzhugs 'bol dma' gro'i steng btsugs dmar gyi zhal gdan sgron pa zhig tu bzhugs te thugs dam nyams bzhes sogs der mdzad/ dbyar dus nor gling chibs ra mdo'i gzim chung gi yang steng du bzhugs/ rtse pho brang du bzhugs skabs ngos sar phyag dper phebs dus nged rang sdod sa bzhugs sgrom zhig yod pa dang / mdun lcog steng phyag dpe bzhag de'i mdun yongs 'dzin rin po che'i bzhugs gdan rgyab snyes dang / sgrom skyor sogs gang yang med pa zhig yod pa der bzhugs/ phebs 'phral gsol dpon chen mos gsol ja zhal dkar che ba gang re 'char can 'bul gyi 'dug de dus nga lo na chung bar brten rogs zlar gcen sngo/ blo bzang bsam gtan yang nga dang mnyam du dpe cha blta gi yod/ sngar srol yin nam/ gsol gzim tshos gra sgrig byas pa ji yin gang ltar rta lcag sba yu can gcig la si shan dang / gcig la 'breng pa'i rngo byas pa su rug gi dkris pa gcig bcas yod pa rnam kun rtser gzim chung phun tshogs 'dod 'khyil kyi ka ba'i logs dang / nor gling du chab sa'i shel khri byang ma'i ru'i logs su bkal bzhag gi

93 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa 'dug rta lcag gcig nga dang / gcig blo bsam gyi ched du yin stod red/ phyag dpe tshugs skabs rta lcag gcig tshod lnga pa yol tsam bar tshugs kyi yod/ de'i ring la dpe cha blo 'dzin zin pa rnams skyor nas rgyugs 'bul zhus/ dpe 'khrid phran bu gnang / blo 'dzin gsar du byed dgos pa rnams slob khrid gnang gi yod/ skabs re blo bsam nas dpe rgyugs 'phrod min yong skabs bka' bkyon dang / rdzig rdzig gnang zhing / skabs re rta lcag de blo bsam la thug tsam gnang gi 'dug nyin gcig yongs 'dzin rin po che nas blo bsam gzim chung gi phyi rol tu 'khrid pa gnang ste rta lcag gtong gi yin mdog mdog gnang / de'i skabs gsol dpon chen mos dgongs sel zhus/ nga ni gzim chung nang du 'jigs skrag chen wa'i ngang bsdad pa zhig gsal po dran gyi 'dug ngos nas dpe cha 'gro min skabs bka' bkyon 'dra min gnang ba las/ zhal ras nag 16) rigs stu na nas gnang gi med/ de dus rang nyid byis pa bsam med la song bka' baspyodan gnang skabs sems phran bu khyod myong / nor gling du bzhugs skabs mtshams re skor g.yeng la phebs sku/nga / thengs gcig nga mgon po khang gi 'og der star kha zas nas sdod pa'i skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che rtsig zur nas glo bur du phebs pas zhed snang chen po skye ba zhig byung / phyag dpe'i dus tshod gong smos ltar nyin re thengs gnyis re phran sar phebs te chu tshod skar ma re gnyis tsam yang chud zos su ma song bar sgrig bcad kyis dus tshod ma rdzogs par dpe khrid slob ston dngos gzhi kho na las bka' mol gzhan gang yang mi gnang / nor gling du ngos kyi sar phyag dper phebs skabs chibs ru'i nang spre'u chen po zhig dang / rgyan 'jog khang mdun spra chung ngu gcig sku/da par 'char can shing 'bras sogs gsol ras gnang zhing / skabs 'gar spre'u des rin po che'i sku 'bag tu lag pa shing / dbu gdugs chen po zhig gi 'og der rgyun ring bzhugs/ gsol tshigs kyang der gnang ste spro tshul mdzad/phri lo 1942 bod chu rta zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu nyin ngos kyis lha ldan gtsug lag khang du srid skyong yongs 'dzin stag brag rin po che'i drung nas tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa zhu skabs dam pa 'di nyid nas dus go ba mdzad/ zla ba de ga'i tshes bco lnga nyin kun gling rta tshag ho thog thu'i mtshan rtags dang 'brel ngos lha ldan blo na lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur bskyod dgos par/ snga dro gsung chos rwa bar dge 'dun khri phrag tshogs pa'i mdun sar sngon 'gro chos bshad dang 'brel skyes rabs so bzhi pa bshad rgyu sogs 'di dang 'di lta bu bgyid rgyu dang / phyi dro smon lam du bstan 'bar ma dang bde ba can gyi smon lam mthun 'gyur 'asnga na stangs sogs sku/ngas 'dzin rin po ches lo sngon ma nas bka' slob gnang ba ji bzhin sbyong brdar bgyis 'bras legs lam byung bar mdzad sgo grub mtshams yongs 'dzin rin po che'i klog slob dpon rgyud stod phu khang dge ngag dbang lhun grub la gnas skabs cig gi ring khur sang song zhes gsungs 'dug pa ltar na/ de ni phran gyis mang tshogs la chodas bshad bgyis pa'i thog ma yin pas thugs khral chen po byung sku/da tshod/ pha bong kha rin po che nas dbus khul rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang rgyun bzhugs pa ser smad gzhung pa lha btsun rin po che gcig pur song stabs rjes sor khong gi drung nas dbang rgyun de dag gsan gal che tshul brag ri rin po ches yongs 'dzin rin po cher snyan seng gnang ba ltar/lo de'i yas mas shig la kun bde gling rta tshag rin po ches sbyin bdag zhus te lha btsun rin po ches rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang chen bstsal skabs ched gnyer gyis gsan/ de rjes lha btsun rin po che nor gling chibs rur gdan zhu mdzad de khong gis bkra shis 'khyil rdo rams pa sog po dpal ldan bzang po dang / dha khu ral gyi dge bshes blo bzang rta dbyangs

sku 'phreng gong ma ni yongs 'dzin rin po che'i rigs bdag gi gatho dur gyur stabs/ bzhugs gdan gyi 'gor bzhugs su gsol ba sogs rgyun du bkur sti tshad med mdzad par brten rjes su pha bong kha'i phyag mdzod 'phrin las dar rgyas kyis yongs 'dzin po cher snyan seng zhus te rje bde chen snying po ni gang nyid kyi rtsaba'i bla ma yin yang / da lta'i yang srid 'di nyid ni rin po che gang gi drung nas gsol 'debs snyan bskul mdzad/ ngos bsdus grwa sogs la slob sbyong zin rjes rgyan 'jug gi rtsab dang / slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa'i 'grel pa don gsal dang / mngon rtogs rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i rnam bshad 7gong sa lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i blo bzang dgongs rgyan bcas kyi steng nas phar phyin gyi bka' khrid bstsal/ nyin re bzhin shog bu'i phyed tsam slo 'dzin gyis rgyugs 'bul yang zhu dgos/ de rjes dbu ma theg mchog rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings/ drang nges legs bshad snying po/ rnam 'grel rtsa ba/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba/ 'dul sdom bcas par rim pa bzhin yongs 'dzin rin po che mtshan zhabs dang / yongs 'dzin chung ba'i mtshan khur rim bzhes thog spyi byer mdo sngags 99rin po che nas rgyu sbyar te lha ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang gi 'du khang sbug tu rje yab sras gsum gyi snang brnyan thog tshad gnyis tsam gsar bzhengs grub rjes smad rgyud grwa tshang gi dge 'dun rnams nas 'jigs mdzad the rje lha bcu gsum ma'i cad nas rab gnas rgyas pa tshugs skabs sbyin bdag dge bshes dang / grwa tshang thun mong nas gdan zhus ltar snu gas mgon du phebs/tshogs bar la dge bshes nyid sku mdun du bcar te bka' mol yun ring gnang bar yongs 'dzin rin po che nas dge bshes lags da zhal 'don gnang ran gyi med dam zhes gsungs par/ khong gis kha 'don brjed tshar ba red zhus par brten gcig byas na kha 'don byed mi dgos pa'i rtogs pa'i tshad cig la phebs zin pa min nam/ gzhan kha 'don brjed thabs ga nas sku/da ces dang / pha bong kha pas bsam 'grub rin po che rtogs pa mtho gras shig tu cha 'jog gnang ba lta bur snang zhes gzhan la gsungs/phyi lo 1949 lo'i bod zla gsum pa'i nang rgyud stod mkhan po ser byes blo bzang chos 'byor nas gsos ba btab pa bzhin/ rwa mo che'i chos rur rgyud stod tshogs yongs dang / smad rgyud grwa tshang gi mkhan bla gnyis kyis dbus dge 'dun phal che ba dang / gzhan yang gdan sa'i bla sprul dge bshes/ khyim pa pho mo bcas chos zhu ba lha nga phrag kha shas la gsang 'dus 'grel pa bzhi sbrags/ bde mcho)ga cangargyud dang / sbas don kun gsal sbrags pa'i bshad lung / sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe dbang bcas bstsal/ yang rwa stod skyong bla sprul skur rgyal mchog lnga pa'i gsung snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs kyi bshad lung dang / snyan ngag le'u gnyis pa'i skabs 'bras ljongs bla ma o rgyan pas phyogs btus mdzad pa'i dper brjod khams pa snyan 'grel la yang go bsdur bcas mdzad de snyan ngag gi bka' khrid dang / dper brjod kyang rgyugs bzhes mdzad/ khong la gsung 'phros shig gi zhor rwa sgreng khri chen bstan pa rab rgyas kyi gsung / mgon dkar bum sgrub deng sang gi par mar/

mtshan zhabs dang / yongs 'dzin chung ba'i mtshan khur rim bzhes thog spyi byer mdo sngags 101gyi dbang lung khrid gsem sogs chos skor cha tshang bstsal skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che nyid kyang dbang lung zhu bar phebs/ de dus yongs 'dzin srid skyong stag brag rin po che sku na mtho tsam phebs grub pas bka' dbang gsung chos rgyun ring gnang pa'i skabs sku mnyel po gnang gi 'dug skabs shig la stag brag rin po ches gling rin po che ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bla ma yin/ gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa'i dbang chen rigs gling rin po che'i sku mdun nas gsan na yag po yong gi red ces bka' gnang byung ba dang / lo ltar dgun thog rtser sdod skabs 'char can lhag lha gang rigs kyi las rung bsnyen mtshams re byed spos la 'go stod stag brag rin po che mtshams rogs su lhan bzhugs gnang gi yod kyang / rjes su lo ltar yongs 'dzin gling rin po che nas mtshams rogs su lhan bzhugs 'char can bzhin gnang / tsha rong phyag mdzod dngag blo gling grwa tshang thun mong nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ bod zla bdun pa'i nang 'bras blo gling grwa tshang gi 'du khang du gdan sa'i mkhan po las zur/ sde drug ho thog thu dang / stag phu rin po che sogs bla sprul/ dge bshes/ phru ba gnyer ba sogs chos zhu pa stong phrag lnga tsam la myur lam dmar khrid kyi steng nas lam rim gyi nyams khrid bzhi bshad dang bcas pa nyin bco lnga tsam dang / de rjes sems bskyed mchod pa'i mjug tu grub rgyal lugs tshe dpag med lha gcig bum gcig gi tshe dbang bcas bsung5 zhing / sbyin bdag khag nas bla mchod dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs phul ba bdag gir bzhes/ de sngon rgyud pa'i mkhan po gnang skabs a mdo bkra shis 'khyil du ched mngags btang gnang ba'i rgyud grwa nyag re dge bstan pa chos ldan dang / rong pa dge bshes don grub bcas nas bkra shis 'khyil du stod rgyud gsar 'dzugs kyi cho ga phyag len dang / thig rdul tshon sogs slob khrid zin te lha sar phyir 'byor gyis gzim chung du mjal khar bcar bar ha cang gi dgyes nyams dang bcas/ a mdo khul gyi bla ma dang / dbe bshes drag gras rnams kyi gnas

107 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa tshul dang / khong gnyis nas chos rgyun gsar pa ji thob kyi bka' 'dri zhib nan gnang /bstan pa chos ldan nas de'i skabs dbus khul du dpe rgyun dkon rigs dpal mang dkon mchog rgya mtsho dang / zhang bstan pa rgya mtsho sdu/gas kyi gsung 'bum 'bul lam zhus par dgyes bzhes mdzad/ slob ma rnams nas sku chas che chung ji ltar phul yang /de tsam thugs snang mi mdzad par phyag dpe dkon rigs 'bul mkhan byung tshe shin tu dgyes tshor chen ngo mdzad/ dga' byang tsha ba gser bzang sprul sku nas gamo la ba btab ngor nor gling du bla sprul dge bshes mang tsam zhig la thu'u bkan slo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsung 'bum gyi lung / yang skabs gzhan zhig la a khu shes rab rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum gyi lung rgyun gang bzhugs kyi ljags lung / sde khri'i gsung dus 'khor bskyed rim gyi bshad lung bcas bstsal/ skabs shig la ngos nas gasku la ba btab pa ltar nor gling dbu rtse byang chub dga' 'khyil du myur lam dmar khrid dang / 'jam dpal zhal lung gnyis sbrags pa'i steng nas lam rim gyi nyams khrid bstsal/phyi so/ 1949 lor gam bcar rnam rgyal grwa tshang 'dus spyi nas gasku la ba btab don/ rgyud grwa smad stod sku gas kyi dge 'dun dang bcas chos zhu ba stong phrag brgal bar gsang 'dus kyi dbang chen dang / de rjes gsang 'dus bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho dang / rdzogs rim rim lnga gsal sgron gnyis kyi bshad lung shin tu rgyas pa bstsal/ skabs der rwa stod skyong bla rtser gsung chos la bcar chog pa'i snyan seng zhus par/ bstan rgyas gling du dga' ldan khri rin po che lhun grub brtson 'grus nas spyod 'jug chen mo'i bka' khrid bstsal rgyur der nges par 'gro dgos pa'i bka' slob bstsal ba thun mong lam sbyangs gnad che bar 'doms pa thodar ma chag yang khyodang blas chos rgyun de dang de dato/na pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas zhu 'gab che min yang yang bka' 'dri zhus par/ ngas sngar gsung chos zhu stabs nyams len phran bu zhig byed thub na snyam pa ma gdonags cesas gzhan la tshong rgyu'i bsam pas

8dgung grangs zhe bdun thog dga' ldan shar pa chos rje'i khrir phebs pa/da /zher༅༅/ /shar pa chos rje las thog pa ser byes la ba ye shes sku tshe ma zin par brten sngar srol shar pa chos rje'i mtshan bzhes gnang rgyu'i dus mtshams 'khel bas/ phyi lo 1949lor srid skyong rin po che nas 'phral du shar pa chos rje'i mtshan gnas bzhes dgos tshul phebs pa ltar ring por mi thogs par sman rtsis khang gi tshes cha ji legs kyi rtsis 'bras phul don/ bla brang gi tshoms chen du bzhugs khri zhal shar la ༷ gas par zhabs 'khod kyis mdzad sgo dang gsar mjal bcas bskyangs/ shar pa chos rje nas lo re bzhin dge ldan du dbyar gnas skabs lam rim chung ba'i steng nas bshad pa gang 'tshams re gnang dgos kyang / de sngon lam rim chung ba'i bshad khrid gsan bzhes ma grub par brten srid skyong stag brag rin po che'i mdun nas lam rim chung ba'i dbu nas gang 'tshams shig bshad lung gi rgyun gsan/ gzhan yang tshe gling yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi gsung bla mchod khrid yig 'bring po dang / rje rin po che'i gsung gsang 'dus rim lnga gdan rdzogs bcas kyi khrid rgyun srid skyong rin po che nas gnang rogs zhes snyan seng zhu gnang skabs dgyes bzhin zhal bzhes bstsal mod/ mdzad rgya'i stabs kyis nar lus su song / de nas dbyar gnas skabs dga' ldan du phebs te/ lho pa khang tshan gyi yang thog du bzhugs/ shar pa chos rje'i khri 'don dngos gzhi'i nyin lho pa khung tshan nas tshogs chen du phebs skabs phebs

gnang / chig stong dgu brgya lnga bcu nga gnyis/ bod chu 'brug lor/ po ta la'i tshoms chen srid zhi'i phun tshogs su slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga dang / de rjes sa chog gi skor rnams dang / sa'i lha mo lhag gnas sogs sta gon gyi rim pa rnams sngon du song

110 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sdul sdo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i ma dzad rnam rma do tsam/ brjod nga ba'i sgo nas rdul tshon la brten te sku gsung thugs sku ngas su rtsodags pa'i/ dkyil 'khor legs par bzhengs/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid zhugs shing dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa bzhes nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa nyid kyis dang po'i sangs rgyas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur bzhengs te rgyal po zla ba bzang po la sogs pa skal ldan gyi skyes bu rnams la rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi chos 'khor bskor bar mdzad pa nag pa'i nya ba'i dus chen dang bstun nyin gsum ring dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i skor dang / byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ mchog dbang gong ma gsum/ jo rje slob dpon bdag po chen wa'i dbang mtha' rten dang bcas pa rgyud kyi rgyal po chen wa'i 'grel chen dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi dgongs pa/ rgya bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyi 'grel pa'i srol mang du mchis pa la/ dus kyi 'khor lo rang nyid kyis rgyal pri+o zla ba bzang po ltar bsngags par mdzad pa/ rje tsong kha pa chen ngo'i bzhed 1/la thun mong ma yin pa de nyid/ mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi ma dge legs dang la bzang sngo/sa rgyud kyi 'grel chen dang / dkyil 'khor gyi chod ga cha lag dang bcas pa legs par gtan la phab pa bzhin tshad ma gsum gyis rnam par dag paci( bshad pa phra zhib rgyas par mdzad cing / phyag len rnams kyang sla chos su ma song ba zab cing rgyas par gnang bas dbang bde 'phrod pa tsam du ma zad/ ṇ+ḍi nang gzhan gsum gyi dus kyi 'kho ra 'o'i gnad mtha' dag la ma lha gas pa dang / log par rtog pa'i the tshom gyi dri ma ma lus pa bsal te/ dadrodad ldan mkhas pa rnams la rgyud don mtha' chod pa'i go ba yongs su rdzogs pa ster bar mdzad/ sho je slob dpo/na bdag sngo chen ngo'i dbang gi khongs slob dpon gyi dam tshig bstan pa'i rjes/rgyud rnams 'dzin par 'gyur ba yi/ /slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags/ /zhes gtso bo la gsol ba btab pa'i skabs rin po che cung zad thugs skyo nyams lta

dgung grangs zhe bdun thog dga' ldan shar pa chos rje'i khrir phebs nga / 111bu mdzad cing / ngos la yang tshor ba de mtshungs shig byung / rje bde chen snying pos lus dkyil gyi bka' khrid bstsal skabs rje nyid nas btab pa'i zin bris sogs la go bsdur gyis 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che nas bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi rim pa dang po'i zin bris bde chen rgya macen) 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba phyogs bsgrigs grub mtshams yongs 'acirdon rin po cher spyan bstar gyis bka' bcos zhu gnang mdzad pa ltar thugs zhib nan tan gnang /de rjes shig la drung yig blo bzang rdo rjes rje pha bong kha'i gsung 'bum gyi gras su 'jug rgyu'i rgyu mtshan dang sbrags 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi zin bris la bka' bcos zhus par yang khong gi 'thodad pa snyu gas par mdzad/ yang stag brag dza sas nas srid zur rin po che de nyid kyi gsung 'bum par rko zhu rtsis la/ gsan yig skor la thugs zhib chub pa zhes gsol ba btab pa ltar mdzad/ dga' ldan khri zur ser byes lhun grub brtson 'grus nas sku/ngas 'dzin 'di nyid sngonu gyi bka' gdams pa'i bla ma dam pa gong ma rnams lta bu'i skyes chen khyad par 'phags pa zhig yin 'dug gshis/ mkhas grub rje'i gsung gsang 'dus bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho dang / rje'i gsung rdzogs rim rim lnga gsal sgron gnyis kyi bshad lung gnang skabs shig tu gsung chos la bcar codag pa zhes rwa stod skyong bla sprul sku brgyud snyan seng gnang skabs kho bos de lta bu'i mkhas pa chen po la gsung chos ga nas 'bul nus zhes gsungs/ bskyar du zhus skabs dge ldan khri par song gshis tshogs mang dang lhan cig gsung chos gsan bzhes gnang rgyu legs lam ma chags pas zur du sku rkyang la 'bul 'a ma zhus chog ces bka' lan gnang / 'on kyang mdzad brel stabs kyis ༷ nga bi thugs bzhed bzhin gsung chos gnang rgyu ma grub par brten khong nas ser byes mkhan zur thabs mkhas sogs la yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi mdun nas gzhung chen de dag gi bshad lung zhu gal che tshul bka' slob nan tan gnang yod tshod dang / 'di'i skabs sku 'bum mi nyag rin po che lha sar phebs nga khong gsan rgya cho stabs

11྅ 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen wa 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pri sngar ma gsan pa'i chos rgyun kha shas gsan na bstan par phan thogs sku nga min rwa khyodad skyong bla sprul sku gtsug lag khang du jo bo rin sngo che'i mdun zan brtag zhu bar gtong gnang la bzang phebs byung ba ltar de lo'i dgun thog rtse pho brang gi gzim chung blo bzang mdun sar mi nyag rin po che'i drung nas 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che dang / rwa stod skyong bla sprul sku sogs nyung shas dang lhan du thog mar bla mchod khrid yig kha chems rlung bskur gyi lung /de nas 'jug pa'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal/ drang nges legs bshad snying sngo / stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung rje'i bstod pa don ldan ma'i ma'agrel/ hor ston nam mkha' dpal gyi blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer sogs kyi bshad lung / phri lor 'grel pa don gsal dang / a khu shes rab rgya mtsho'i gsung gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed cadags kyi khrid/ dus 'khor margyud bsdus rgyud kyi mchan 'grel yig cha 'ga' shas phyogs bsdus gnang dathodas pa'i lung / blo rdo nga tshigs brgyad ma/ chod sbyong mtshon cha 'khor sbu/ sku gas kyi bka' khrid gsan/ mi nyag rin po che'i thugs bzhed ltar/ bla ma lnga bcu pa dang / sdom pa nyi shu pa sogs kyi bshad lung bstsal zhing / phan tshun thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ rjes sku/ra bkra shis 'khyil nas sgra la mkhas pa zhig lha sar phebs pa khong gi drung nas sngar ma gsan pa'i sgra'i khrid gcig gsan na bstan par phan thogs yong min stodar skyong bla sprul sku jo bo rin po che'i mdun zan sgril zhu ru btang gnang la bzang phebs ma byung / nag shod 'bri ru zhabs drung nas gsol ba btab pa ltar lha sar bzhi sde'i 'du khang du thun drug dang / 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bdag bskyed 'asngo na rgyu'i dam bca' can chos zhu ba stong phrag brgal bar dpa' ྅pe gcig pa'i bka' dbang dang / bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams khrid bcas bstsal//

9dgung grangs nga gcig thog yongs 'dzin che ba'i mtshan bzhes dang /rgya nag tu gzigs skor/ rgya gar dang / bal yul du gnas gzigs gnang ba/da /zher༅༅//de snga 7rgyal mchog bcu gsum pa chen gro'i yongs 'dzin che ba phur lcog sprul sku byams pa rgya mtsho'i mdzad lam ltar/ gling rin po ches yongs 'dzin che ba'i mtshan gnas bzhes dgos tshul phyi lo 953 sku re zla 0 tshes shar du bka' shag dang /drung rtsis kyis snyan gsang zhus don bzhin yongs 'dzin che ba'i gsar mjal gyi rten 'brel mdzad sgo gnang /de nas bzung rtse pho brang du bzhugs skabs sngar srid skyong rin po che'i bzhugs yul shod gzim chung rig gnas kun gsal dang /nor gling du chibs rwa mdo'i gzim chung nas zhabs brtan lha khang gi yang thog tu spo bzhugs bskyangs/rtse dang /nor gling sogs gang du bzhugs yul der rje bdag nyid chen pos mdzad pa'i lam rim che 'bring chung gsum/rje pha bong kha'i gsung gi lam rim zin bris/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi gsung sems dang sems byung gi tshul rnam par bshad pa'i ྅ ma tshig rin po che'i phreng ba dang / sems dang sems byung gi tshul gsal bar ston pa blo gsal mgul rgyan bcas kyi phyag dpe gzigs rtogs gnang ched gdan zhu gnang nas rgyun du thugs zhib yang yang mdzad/ yang skabs re mjal kha zhu mkhan rigs bcar nye'i skabs phyag dpe tshang ma bsdu bar mdzad/rgyun du nor gling gru 'dzin pho brang gi dpe mdzod khang nas phyag dpe

114 4skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa g.yar bzhes skabs phyag dpe g.yar po bzhes 'dzin 'bul gnang dang / phyir 'bul gnang skabs 'dzin ngo phyir bzhes pa/ sogs ha cang dngos gtsang bar mdzad/ lha sa'i bla brang du phyag dpe mang po bzhugs par gzigs rtog ched rtse dang / nor gling gang rung du bzhes dgos skabs zhabs phyi rnams dang / slob ma sogs la bka' mngags gnang dus phyag dpe bzhugs yul/ pod che chung / phyag dpe bsgril ras kyi tshon mdog sogs gsung chog chodag yod cing / phyag dpe rnams la thugs gtsigs shin tu che/ phyag dpe gzigs skabs kyang / dpe ras sam/ glegs shing lta bu gang yang med par gsol lcog steng phyag dpe 'chodag pa sogs nam yang mi mdzad/ spyir bla brang gi las don che phra tshang mar phyag mcho da nas thag gcod bya rgyu las gzhan pa'i thugs khur mi gnang yang / phyag dpe gzhan gyis g.yar po zhu skabs nges par yongs 'dzin rin po che rang la snyan seng zhu dgos/ bde mchos lū i pa'i dbang chen de sngon khang sar rin po che'i mdun nas 'jam dbyangs dkyil gzim shag tu gsan te zin bris kyang mchis mod/ bsnyen pa gnang rgyur brten 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che lha sa gling bla brang du gdan zhu gnang ste bskyar du sta gon dang / dngos gzhi bcas nyin gnyis ring sku rkyang du gsan/ tshig bcad rnams la bshad pa mi dgos kyang / tshig lhug rnams la dbang bshad lam rob gnang rogs zhes zhus kyang / bshad pa phal cher ma gnang / 'on kyang dbang thodab nges yin zhes gsungs/ de nas rtse'i gzim chung rig gnas kun gsal du bcad rgyar bzhugs/ zhogs pa snga por rgyun gyi zhal 'don rnams grub par mdzad/ de rjes chos bzang mthu stobs dang lhan du bde mchog gi bdag bskyed dbu 'dzugs gnang / spyan dmigs rgyun ring gnang stabs bzlas pa'i 'gor phebs pa la chu snurd gsum tsam 'asor/ de nas dbo nga mo chu tshod bdun pa bar thun gcig gnang ste bzlas pa grangs gsog mdzad/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis bdun gsum ring las rung grub/de nas lha sar bla brang du phebs te rgyud stod kyi chog grwa ba rnams dang lhan du kha skong gi zhi

dgung grangs nga gcig thog yongs 'dzin che ba'i mtshan bzhes dang / rgya nag tu gzigs 115ba'i sbyin sreg tshad ldan mdzad/ de rjes phran gyis gsol ba btab pa ltar/ dgun thog cig la rtse pho brang du de sngon stag brag rin po che nas gnang ma grub pa'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje dang / bde mchog lū i pa'i dbang chen/ a khu shes rab rgya mtsho'i yig cha'i steng nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khyodang khrid/ bka' gdams pha chos bu chos kyi lung / 7rgyal mchodag bdun pa'i gsung dga' lha'i khrid yig gi bshad lung bcas bstsal/ yang dbyar thog gcig nor gling gru 'dzin pho brang gi dbu rtser dngul chu'i gsung gi steng nas 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi myong khrid/ byang chub dga' 'khyil du 'jigs byed kyi 'khrul 'khor dang / drug cu ma'i khrid/ zhi khro sbrags sgrub thun mong dang thun min gyi khrid/ dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi mchan bu'i bshad lung bcas zhus bstsal gsal por dran gyi 'dug de min gsung chos gzhan gang 'tshams zhus gnang yod kyang de'i skabs kyi thob yig bod du lus stabs zhib gsal 'bri ma thub/ 'di'i skabs yas mas shig la phyag mdzod lags nas chibs drel rgya mo gzugs byang legs po zhig snyadas 'dug nor gling du gzigs 'bul zhus par dus rgyun dang mi 'dra ba'i ha cang dgyes tshul bzhes pa dang / de'i phyi lo rgya nag tu phebs skabs chibs drel des zhabs zhu 'grub nges kyi las can zhig tu mkhyen par nges/ slob ma'i gras a mdo sbyin pa rgya mtsho sogs mi gsum gyis bla brang nas khyodas rgya che tsam gnang gal che bas gus tshos tshong las sku/gas zhabs zhu bgyi rgyu yin lugs zhus/ phyag mdzod nas kyang thengs gcig tshong pa zhig btang ste chodang las 'go 'dzugs byas na 'gab min bka' 'dri zhus par 'asnga da chung chog shes byed rgyu gal che tshul sogs phebs pa las/ rgyas spros la thugs bzhed gtan nas mi gnang / so/na kyang phyag mdzod nas dus rgyun rta drel sogs nyo rgyur dgag pa mi mdzad kyang / sems can de dag la byams po byed dgos pa'i bka' slob nan tan bcing5/

116 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam ma do tsam brjod nga phyi lo 1954 bod shing rta zla ba dang wa'i tshes brgyad nyin lha sar gzim shag tu brag g.yab ho thog thu sku phreng dgu pa la tshig snga ma dge tshul gyi byedam pa ba355/ gzhan yang ngos nas bsnyen rjodags kyi spyodam pa 'bogs pa'i lo grangs ma zin par lo gnyis ring ris med chos lugs khag gi bla ma/ grwa rkyang sogs mang dze ra dge tshul slong gi sdiwam rgyun bstsal te bstan pa'i gzhi ma dam chos 'dul ba'i bstan par zhabs 'degs phul du phyin pa mdzad kyang / zhib cha 'dir ma khyodas/ dam pa'i chos kyi che ba 'asnga na phyir snga 'o/ nas snyan seng snga ṇ+ḍi thengs gsum phul ba ltar/ gong zla'i tshes bco lnga nyin/ jo bo shākya mu ne'i spyan sngar/ brtan mkhas kyi yon tan zung dang ldan zhing / gangs ri'i khrod kyi 'dul 'dzin kun gyi gtsug rgyan bshes gnyen dam pa gang nas/ da chog nyes med phun tshogs kyi sgo nas kho bo bslab gzhi sku ngas su rdzogasapa'i dge slong gi dasngo sa por sgrub par mdzad pa'i bka' drin byang chub snying po'i bar du gzhal bar dka'/ zla ba de'i nang dpal ldan stod rgyud a mdo sngags rams pa slo bzang nyi mas skyabs zhus ltar/ khri byang rin po ches rje nyid kyi 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal ngo'i snga shal zhes bya ba ljags rtsom mdzad de/ 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs dang / maṇ+ḍal rten gsum bcas 'bul gnang skabs sku tshe zhabs zung yun du brtan pa'i gsol 'debs kyang mdzad/ rwa stod skyong bla sprul skus 'khrungs rabs kyi khungs ji yin 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po cher bka' 'dri zhus par/ gling sku bo nga ma blo bzang lung ho gas bstan 'dzin 'phrin las mchog la 'khrungs rabs de dag gi gzigs snang byung ba ltar/ sgar pa ri khrod kyi bsil yangs ldebs bris su gsal yod lugs gsungs 'dug yang skabs shig la/ dga' shar rdo khang dge bshes blo bzang dkon macodag nas srang lnga bcu re yod pa'i 'thum bzhi 'bul ba dang sbrags 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs shig ljags rtsomayong ba zhes snyan seng zhus par/ de snga na zhal bzhes thog 'bul ba rnams phyir 'khyer dgos tshul gsungs

dgung grangs nga gcig lnga/ga sku/ngas 'dzin che ba'i mtshan bzhes dang / rgya nag tu gzigs 117par/ dge bshes des 'bul ba chung drags na ma gtogs bzhes blo gas gnang zhes zhus par bzhad mo bzhad/ 'on kyang de skabs ljags rtsom ma grub par rgya gar du zhabs 'khod rjes ljags rtsom mdzad skor gsham du gsal/ de lo tshogs mchod grol rjes chab mdo mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi drung yig phun tshogs dbang 'dus kyis skyabs zhus ltar/ bzhi sde'i 'du khang du bdag bskyed rgyas pa 'don rgyu'i dam bca' can chos zhu ba gser skya stong phrag 'gal bar 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bka' dbang sta gon dang bcas pa bstsal/ rgya nag tu mkhrims gtan 'bebs byed rgyu'i rgyalasku ngas tshogs 'du chen sngo ra phran 'gro dgos stabs/ bod zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin lha sa nas thon te dga' ldan du nyin shas 'gor bar de'i skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che nyid kyang lhan du yod/ nyin gcig brag g.yab tshong pa a 'brug nas gser sdong rin po cher bzang gos kyi snam sbyar dang / bka' sdod chos kyi rgyal sngo/ra na bza' gzab 'bul dang 'brel yangs pa can gyi gtsug lag khang du dga' ldan nyag re tshogs yongasanas stong mchod 'bul skabs sbyin bdag nas gdan zhus ltar phebasate thugs smon mdzad/ de rjes dga' ldan nas phebs thon gnang skabs dgon zhol bar chibs thog dang / de nas kong po rba la brgal tsam bar rlangs 'khor/ de nas rlangs 'khor 'gro lam med stabs chibs drel la brten nas phebs/ de lo sngar ma grags pa lta bu'i char zhod ha cang chen po byung bar brten lam kha skyon shor gyis phebs bgrod ma bde ba'i gyen thur gang sar zhabs thang du phebs dgos byung ba dang / chibs drel la skal rma chags pa sogs sku ngal chen po byung song / sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pa goms byang che gshis thugs snang de tsam ma gnang / thod bo spra snu ra 'byor mtshams phyag mdzod blo bzang lung rigs/ gasdu/la dpon thub bstan tshe ring / ma chen blo chos bcas las gzhan zhabs gras byings rnams dang / chibs pa chibs drel sogs lha sar phyir slog gnang / 'di'i skabs sku 'phreng gong ma'i gong ma ngag dpang lung rtogs yon tan rgya mcho de nyid kyi 'khrungs

118 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul ldo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa khang nas yin zer ba'i mi de 'dra mjal khar bcar bar byin rten sogs gsol bstsal gyi dgyes pa'i bdud rtsis dga' bde'i dpal la sbyor bar mdzad/ de nas rlangs 'khor thog chab mdor phebs skabs mtshan nyid grwa tshang du bzhugs/ der zhi ba lha dang / rgya ra sprul sku sogs de sngon thugs 'dris can gyi slob ma rnams dang / gzhan yang dad ldan ser skya mang pos mjal kha zhus/ de nas rim gyis masnga khams yul gru mang po brgyud de rgya nag khrin tur phebs/ de ni phyi rgyal du phebs pa thog ma yin pa dang / bod sa spyod bo spra mo nas bzung nyin ltar mo ṭor thog nyin hril por phebs dgos kyang / sku khams la ma 'phrod pa'i rigs gang yang ma bzhes/ de nas kho thod dang mnyam du khrin tu bo/nga khyer nas gnam gru'i thog shi'i rngan zhes par phebs/ der sngar lha sa'i jo bo rin po che bzhugs yul gyi lha khang dang / bzhugs khri bcas la mjal kha zhus/ chab mdo khul nas gsol mar phul ba rnams der mchod 'bul gnang / shi'i rngan nas me 'khor thog pe cing du phebs te phran sdod yul g.yu kha ja'o zhes pa der bzhugs/ tshogs 'du khag dang / bzo grwa khag glog brnyan sogs la phran dang mnyam phebs gnang ba las/ gzhan khrom gzigs sogs la gtan nas ma phebs/kun gzigs chos kyi nyi ma'i drung nas dus 'kho ra dbang chen zhu myong ba'i rgya mi yang tha kon sogs rgya rigs 'ga' shas la gsang thabs kyis 'dod mos ltar snodas 'brel bstsal/ dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho yang yang bcar skabs bkur sti dang bcas thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i rig gnas kyi skor la bgro gleng gnang / khong gis 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che phran gyi slob mar gtogs kyang / yongs 'dzin gling rin po ches phran nas chos 'brel gsan myong med mod/ 'di lta bu'i bkur bzos gnang zhing / bla ma ha cang gi zhi dul bag yod can zhig 'dug ces gzhan la gsung tshul thos/ nyin gcig ma'o tse tung phran ngos 'phrad du phebs skabs rin po che yang chibs zhabs gzhan rnams dang lhan du bzhugs par ma'o la phyag gtong skabs rin po che dbu zhwa bzhes mi 'dug ces sku rtsed zhus song /

dgung grangs nga gcig thog yongs 'dzin che ba'i mtshan bzhes dang / rgya nag tu gzigs 119sku gzhon nu'i skabs sgo nga bzhes rkyen gyis bsnyun par brten de nas bzung bla brang nas nya phag sgong gsum 'dres pa'i gsol tshigs gtan nas ma phul zhing / bya sha ni sems can chung ngu 'di lta bu zhig rang re mi'i zas kyi don du bsad pa ma legs zhes gsungs nas mnyes po med/ gsol zhib dang / gsol dkrum skam po/ bod ja/ dgun khar bod du rtsam thug bzhes mog shing tog tsha lu ma dang / kham bu sogs la mnyes po gnang ba las/ rgya mi'i gsol tshigs gang byung la mnyes po med khar/ skabs der gab tshad kyi snyun gzhi dang / mgul glo bzhes te gsol tshigs de tsam mchod ma thub/ 'on kyang rgya zas rigs mchod ma thub pa'i gnas tshul rgya mis shes tshe sku gzugs la brtag dpyad zhu ched sman khang du gdan 'dren zhu srid pas thugs bsun byung dogs kyis rgya mi'i gsol tshigs phul ba de nas gang 'tshams shig ma byan blo chos sogs la gnang / rin po che rang nas zhogs par bod nas bsnams pa'i gsol zhib bzhes/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis rgya nag tu bzhugs ring sku sha skam zhing thugs bag phebs po gtan nas byung ma song / bla sman pa'i drung nas bod sman bzhes kyang de tsam gyis dwangs bskyed ma bzhes/ rgya nag tu phebs 'phral bod du bla brang la phyag bris gnang ste/ yongs 'dzin rin po che'i klog slob pa'i slob dpon rgyud stod phu khang dge ngag dbang lhun grub la thugs mkho sogs gang dgos 'bul dgos bka' mngags gnang yang / khong ring por ma thogs par zhi bar gshegs/ gzhan yang lha sar bla brang gi chibs drel rgya mo legs pa de dang / chibs chen legs pa gcig glo bur shi ba sogs de lo rta lor 'khel gshis bgegs 'tshub chen po yod tshul bla brang gi zhabs gras nas gleng / pe cing du bzhugs ring ngos rang las seng dus tshod phran bu yod skabs lam rim chen mo'i lhag mthong chen mo nas bshad khrid thengs 'ga' shas zhus kyang / cha tshang zhu thub pa ma byung / rgya nag khul du gzigs skor mdzad sgo rnams grub ste phran tsho sku 'bum du 'byor stabs rgya mis bzhugs bsgrigs zhus pa ltar rin po che dgon

120 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul ldo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa/ pa'i nye 'gram zhig la bzhugs/ gser sdong rin po che'i mdun mchod sprin sna lnga stong tshar dang 'brel gnas gzigs gnang / mi shig rin po che de khyodan nas phan tshun chos 'brel gsan pa'i bla mar song gshis/ mjal 'phrad dang / phyag rtags sku/gas 'bul res gnang /de nas bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku 'phreng drug pa dang /grwa gachodan gzhan dag la dge tshul gyi 〉wam pa bstsal/ de ga'i rgyud rdo da grwa tshang nas gsol ba btab pa ltar sku na tan gzhir gyur ma'i bka' khrid dang / gzhan yang mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi mtshan snyan nyin re bzhin 'phel bas nyin ltar mjal kha zhu mkhan shin tu mang zhing / chos 'brel sogs kyang 'dod bstun a masnga dang / khams khul tshang mar sku ngal 'dzems med du bstsal/ de nas rim phebs kyis/ rta'u/ tre+e hor nye tsho dgon/ be ri dgon/ dar rgyas dgon/ dkar mdzes mtshan nyid dang sngags pa grwa tshang / sde dgo chab mdo mtshan nyid grwa tshang sogs su phebs bzhugs gnang yul khag tu 6)sa 'brel zhu mos ltar bstsal zhing / 'bul da1ras rnams skabs sku/ sor phyir slog bstsal/ phebs lam 'khel min la ma ltos par ris med dgon khag che chung tshang mar mchodad 'bul gnang / rgya ra sprul sku nas gdan zhus ltar dru gu dgon du phebs te nyin shas bzhugs ring chos 'brel sogs kyang 'dod bstun ltar bstsal bar rgya ra bla brang nas 'bul ba rda sgor do bcu dang /gos sna 25gas/ rgya ra sgrol ma zhes gser zangs las grub pa'i sbru la ma nyer gcig cha tshang bcas 'bul lam zhus par rda cadar sogs 'bul ba gzhan rnams ma bzhes par sgrol ma'i sku rnams dgyeso mnyes chen pos bzhes te lha sar phebs rjes sgar pa ri khrod du rten gyi gras su baX/gas gsal gnang /phyi lo 1955 zla 6 tshes 30 nyin/ phran tsho lha ldan rgyal khab tu phyir 'drodar rjes sgar pa ri khrod du phebs te bdun 'ga' shas ring sku ngal gsos te bzhugs/ rgya nag tu phebs shul lha sdod bla brang bi zhabs phyi rnams nas ri khrod kyi rgyab ngos su spro khang chung

dgung grangs nga gcig thog yongs 'dzin che ba'i mtshan bzhes dang / rgya nag tu gzigs 121ngu zhig gsar bskrun bgyis par mnyes tshor dang 'brel nyin mo der spro bzhugs mdzad/ de'i skabs tsam du ma zad/ ri khrod der ha cang gi mnyes po mdzad cing / ri khrod du slebs dus kha 'don byed rgyu'am/ dpe cha blta rgyu sogs cosas mthun gyi bya ba kho nar brtson rgyu'i go skabs legs tshul gzhan la bka' gnang 'dug rgya nag tu bzhugs skabs dang / lha ldan rgyal khab tu phebs 'byor zin rjes rgya mis yongs 'dzin rin po che nyid kyis chos don las khungs kyi gtso 'dzin gyi mtshan bzhes dgos tshul yang yang snyan bsun zhus par/ phran chung dus nas chos phyogs la sbyangs pa byas stabs de'i skor phran bu shes pa las de min deng skabs kyi shes yon med stabs ming tsam 'dzin pa la phan thogs gtan nas med lugs gsungs te lo mang ring zhal bzhes ma gnang / 'on kyang rjes su 'bum thang drung yig chen mos chos don las khungs kyi gtso 'dzin gyi mtshan tsam ma bzhes na rgya mis malnga/nga phyogs chen po byed tshul yang yang zhus par/ rgya gar la snga sa ༷ la du ma phebs kyi sngon tsam la chos don las khungs kyi dbu khrid kyi mtshan tsam bzhes dgos byung / rgya mi'i dpon rigs mjal bcar skabs kyang gus zhabs dang bcas mthun lam tsam gyi bka' mol las/ ngas chab srid skor gang yang shes kyi med ces mtha' gcig tu dam bca' gtsang mar mdzad/ yang rgyun du slob gnyer ba don gnyer can mjal bcar skabs de dag gi re 'dod ltar bka' khra ba dgyes bzhin bstsal/ gzhan bla chen mi chen sogs la gus zhabs dang bcas thad ka thad ga'i bka' mol gnang dbo/sa rigs las/ bka' mol mang po gtan nas mi gsung bar bya nyung don nyung job du bka' gdams pa'i dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar bdag gir bzhes/phyi lo 1956 lo'i dbyar stod tsam la brag lha klu sgug tu bzhugs pa'i bya btang ba nyag re dge bshes dge 'dun bkra yis nas lo mang nan bstud kyis gsol ba btab don bzhin/ bzhi sde dga' ldan bsam gtan gling bi 'du khang du chab mdo 'phags pa lda ho thog thu dang / brag g.yab ho thog thu/ skyabs rje gser kong rin po che sogs bla sprul/

121 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sbrul ldo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa dge bshes/ gdan sa gsum dang rgyud grwa stodad smad sogs kyi dge 'dun/ sman rtsis khang gi bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu dang / slob dge sku/gas 'ga' zhig gzhan yang khyim pa pho mo bcas stong phrag brgal bar mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pri 'i gsung 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim chen mo/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i gsung gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi zin bris bcas kyi bshad khrid shin tu rgyas pa nyin bstud nas bstsal/ de lo bod zla brgyad pa'i nang kho bo rwa sgreng dge 'phel gling du bskyod skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che mchog kyang lhan du phebs te/ srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan masnu ga gi yang sprul rin po cher ngos nas dge tshul gyi rjodam pa 'bul skabs sku ngas 'dzin rin thod che nas las gral thugs khur bzhes/ yang dgon ri khrod ces pa sngar dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i nang rje bdag nyid chen pos 'gran zla dang bral ba'i legs bshad byang chub lam gyi rim pa chen mo ljags rtsom gnang yul der kho bo cag dang lhan du lam rim chen sdu'i shog bu kha shas ljags klog dang 'brel thugs smon gnang / rwa sgreng 'di nyid bka' gdams bstan pa'i chu mgo'i gnas khyad par can du song gshis mchod 'bul yang rgya cher mdzad/ tshur lam stod lung phu chu mig lung du gsang chen bstan pa'i mdzod 'dzin dpal ldan smad rgyud pa'i dge 'dun rnams dbyar phri ma'i zhal bzhes dang 'brel bzhugs spos su lta thod cag dang lhan du phebs/ tshogs yongs la sku 'gyed mang ja dang / dad can rnams la mjal kha dang / chos 'brel sku gas kyis re ba ji bzhin du bskangs/ lo der rgya gar gzhung dang / rgya gar byang chub chen wa'i snu sa tshogs bcas nas gnas brtan sde pa'i lugs ltar na/ 'tshe med zhi bde'i lam ston chen po bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can de nyid sku mya ngan las 'das te lo nyis stong lnga brgya 'khor ba'i dran gaskutsware dus chen khyad par can gyi dmigs bsal mdzad sgor sku nga dgos zhes ngos la mabo na 'bod byung ba ltar/ phyi lo 1956 zla 11 tshes 19 nyin phran lha ldan rgyal

dgung grangs nga gcig thog yongs 'dzin che ba'i mtshan bzhes dang / rgya nag tu gzigs 123khab nas thon skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che yang lhan du phebs/ bkra shis lhun por bzhugs zhag thog phyi nyin kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mjal 'phrad grub rjes pha lha'i sgos gzhis rgyal rtse dpal 'byor lhun por gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar phebs 'byor gyis der lhod bzhugs gnang / de nas mo khor thog gro mo shar gsing ma dang / de nas 'bras ljongs kyi rgyal sa sgang tog bar chibs thog phebs/ phyi nyin sgang tog nas rgya gar grong khyer shi li gu ri bar phebs sa ra dang / de nas mkha' lam brgyud rgyal sa ldi li gsar par phran sdod yul he ḍar tha ta ha'o si zhes pa'i gzhung gi mgron khang du rgya gar gzhung nas phebs sgrig zhus pa ltar bzhugs/ de nas rim gyis chodas 〉rgags kyi mdzad sgo rnams dang / gnas chen khag grong khyer dang / bsgo grwa lag bcas la nged cag lhan du phebs/ rgya gar nas bod du phyir phebs ma gnang gong yongs 'dzin rin po che sku 'khor gnas gzigs mchod 'bul bcas kyi ched bal yul du phebs/ bal yul mchod rten rnam gsum sogs kyi drung mchod 'bul rgya che dang 'brel bstan pa rgyas pa dang / 'gro kun bde ba sogs kyi thugs smon mdzad/ de nas ka sbug tu phebs te zhwa sgab pa'i shag tu bzhugs/ rgya bal du bzhugs ring nyin re bzhin skye bo mang por mjal kha dang / chos 'brel bcas bstsal/ yar lam 'bras ljongs su phran rnams nyin grangs bcu sko ra bzhugs rjes/ phyi lo 1957 zla 2tshes 14 nyin sgang tog nas phran tsho lhan du phebs thon gyis rgyal rtser 'byor skabs ri lding grwa tshang yang thog tu bzhugs/ nyin re bzhin mi stong phrag mang po mjal bcar gyis sku ngal gyi rnam pa cung zhig bzhes/ de ga'i grwa tshang zhig gis gdan zhus ltar snu gas yongs la chos 'brel bstsal/ phyag mdzod blo bzang lung rigs tshad rims lta bu'i nyin shas bde min byung bar/ khong gi 'khris su yang yang phebs te nad gzhi'i skor la bka' 'dri dang / gal srid 'phral 'phral drag skyes ma byung tshe/ rwa stod skyong bla sprul sku phyag mdzod lags kyi rogs zla lta bur lha sar sngon du 'gro dgos tshul gsungs/ gzhis ka

124 4skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling ji la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rme dzad rnam mdo tsam brjod nga rtser phebs skabs bsam 'grub rtse'irdzong gi gzim chung zhig tu bzhugs nga der ma dzad brgya dpag bsam 'khri shing gi thang ka bkrams pa/ sngon gyi 'i rgyus dang / rnam thar spo gas la thugs rgyus shin tu che bas/ mdzad pa so sku gra thang mtshan byang med kyang rwa stod skyong bla sprul skur ston pa'i 'khrungs rabs rnams 'di dang 'di zhes ngo sprod mdzad/ bzhis rtse rdzong bi tshoms chen du bzhung khu+ongs gtsang khul rdzong khag bcu gsu ma gyi lha sde mi sde thun mong nas ngos ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel ched brtan bzhugs 'bul skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che nas maṇ+ḍal ljags bshad mdzad/ yang phran bkras lhu na du sdod ring yongs 'dzin rin po che bkras lhun lo chen rin cad che'i gzim shas tu bkras lhun bla brang nas phebs sgrig zhus pa der bzhugs/ yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis lhan du kun gzigs pa ṇa chen rin po che'i mjal khar phebs/ de nas snar thang sogs phran gar bskyod sar lha na phebs kyis sngo da zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nyin lha sa nor gling du phyir phebs gnang / de gro'i bod zla lnga nga/'i nang mtshur phu /rma pa rin po che'i thugs bzhed ltar ngos mtshur phur bskyod stabs yongs 'dzin rin sngo che yang lhan du phebs/ rgya nag tu rā bas skabs nas bzung sharma pa dang thugs 'dris che ba'i stabs kyis yang yang mja' 'phrad thob phan tshun nang ma'i bka' mchid lcug par grol/ mtshur phu'i rten skam chen mo rnams 'al dbye'i skabs dang / gu ru mtshan brgyad la sogs pa'i dbyar 'cham rnams la kho bo cas dang ldan du dgyes gzigs mdzad/ de rjes gnas nang dpa' bo rin po che'i dason par sadan zhus lta ra phran dang lhan du phebs te zhag gcig bzhugs rjes lda sar phebs/ de rjes rlogasku gling zhabs brtan lha khang gi gzim chung du brag g.yab rin sngo che sogs bla sprul chos zhu ba 'kha' zhis la zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi rtsa tshig dang/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad grwa sku 'phreng dang po sa mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ bcas sbrags te bka' khrid gnang / kha gya dbe ba'es dkon dar gyi zin bris steng nas 'jam dbyangs phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sku gsung thugs dkyus gcis tu sbrags te sgrub pa'i

be'u bum bcas kyi lja gas lung bstsal/ bod zla brgyad nga/'i nang khu+o bo brag yer nga/ nas lha sar phyir 'o ga skabs sku ngas 'dzin rin rjo che nas slar rba ri khrod du yong dgos pa/'i bka' nan phebs pri ltar bcar stabs ri ༷nga kyi ngan slong rnams nas phebs lam du ser sbreng dang / mdza'i bla ma mchos khyi rol tu bdus ne rtse/ri ngarā/ma sa te bzhugs 'dug nga mja' / tshom sa chen du sasol ja bzhes 'bras/ dang 'bri' ren rngo tshe nas maṇ+ḍal rten gsu ma/ bstsal nyin phyi mar spong ba pa rnams dang ñtsa na du sdun lī choreng 'cho'i dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga mdzad cing yo ngas 'dzin rin pri+o che mchadag nas ma ṇ+ḍa ra phyag tu bsnam sa te 'phags pa spyan ras gzisas kyi thugs ji lta ra bskyed chu ra / sku phreng rnams nas 'gro bcir don mdzad tshul/ se mas can nyam thas tshul 14gas ljags bzhud yin tu rgyas pa dang 'brel ring 'tsha'i gzhin bskul gnang bar lnga sa rang yid dbang med du gasku sa ching /mig nas mchi ma 'khrug nga/ dang bcas calaba'i bla ma 'i thus/sa bzhed bzhin ring sngo /ra 'tsho ba dang / bstan 'bo'i ngon chen 'grwab nga so tsos kyi sas kru/ 'debs sning nas zhus/ nyin gcig phyag ma rjod sku bas bla brang si las/ byed rnams la bla rma 'i 'bas phyi tshul bzhin bgyis pa'i phan yon so bas kyi bshad nga dang bcas da mu sa/ ba'in bla ma swā rje 'chang gi zhabs/ 'degs tshul bzhin sgrub dathodas pa'i bslab bya byas/ ngos ri khrod du zhag bzhi bsdad rjes
