dgos/ chul gyi brda mdzad/ nyin gcis 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che sku 'khror gling khang tshan gzim bag tu gsol cinags la gdan zhu gnang ste rnam gonyes nang ma 'i bka' mchid la dgyes rma ra rol/ de nas ngos se rar bskyod skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che ri rgya bla brang du phebs sgrig zhus pa lta ra bzhugs/ pha bong kha mchog sprul rin po che'i bla brang du ched gnyer gyis mjal 'phrad dang / lha btsun rin po che yang phan tshun chodas 'brel gsan pa'i bla mar song gshis mjal 'phrad mdzad/ chodabs chen dang / tre+e ce ra khang tshan sogs thob khongs tshang mar sku 'gyed bsnyen bkur bstsal/ grwa bskor dasngo sa gzhi'i mdzad sgo'i skabs byes smad gnyis kyi mkhan ngo dam bcar bzhugs pa la/ kho ྅/sa dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi mchodad brjod/ gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad drangs te/ rten 'byung 'gag sogs brgyad dang bral ba'i tshul las brtsams te barbal brtags zhus shing / chu tshod phyed tsam gyi rjes cengaba'i bla ma mchog nas mtshams 'alnga ga gi brda mdzad/ bod zla brgyad nga 'i nang phran gdan sa chen ngo dge ldan du grwa bskor bskyod skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che sngar bzhin lho pa khang tshan gyi yang thog tu bzhusas/ tshogs chen rdo gcal chen mor gdan sa de ga'i sa ba gnyer ba bzang gras sogs nas rigs lam bgro gling zin rjes/ shar byang mkhan po rnam gnyis dam bcar bzhugs pa la ma17da cangab/bden gsum malnga/nga na tshul khrims dang / /chodas la shes nas dad pa thob/ ces pa las brtsams te rtags gsal 'phen par tshigs bkra legs pa zhig gi skabs sngar bzhin sku/ngas 'dzin gling rin po ches phyag gnyis thal mo rjodar ba dang bcas te mtshams 'jog gi brda mdzad pa ltar zhus/ rje bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i gdung rten sogs rten mchog rnams la kho 13 cag nas lhag gnas kyi cho ga bgyis skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che yang phebs te dam ye dbyer med du bsre bar mdzad/ de nas dasa' ldan dbang bskur rir phran tsho lha bsangs

dgung grangs nga gcig thos yo/ngas 'dzin che ba'i ma/tshan bzhes dang / rgo+o nag tu gzigs 129gtong bar bskyod skabs rin po che yang g.yag chibs te lhan phebs dang 'brel ha cang dgyes pa'i nyams mdzad/ spyi bye'i legs tshogs 'phel ba'i thugs smon mdzad par gor ma chag gdan sa gsum du grwa bskor gyi mdzad sgo rnams legs grub rjes sgar pa ri khrod du phebs/ri khrod nyams gso legs grub rul ha cang dgyes mnyes thog rab gnas rta jo ga ma zhig mdzad / de nas bdun gnyis tsam gyi rjes brag yer par phebs/ de ga'i grwa tshang gis sngon nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ yer pa grwa tshang gi 'du khang du skya ser chos zhu ba mang 'dus la myur lam dmar khrid kyi steng nas theg chen thun mo nga dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rim pa'i bka' khrid rgyas par bstsal/ codas zhu ba'i gras bshan pa zhig rgis kyang las kyi rnam ba'ag lam tsam go ṅge+ogs thub ste/ kho rang bi 'tsho thabs ched sasod la nye ba'i ra lus nyos zin pa rnams ldo rje 'chang chen por phul/ phyin chad sdudag gcod btan nas mi byed pa'i dam bca' gtsang mar phul 'dug pa nongs pa la chodangs par ngo shes nas bshags sdom byed thub pa/ra bsngags par 'os pa'i gnas su 'khums/ ra lug rnams bla brang gi sgar pa gzhis khar brdzongs 'jog dang / der bla brang nas snga phyir tshe thar btang ba'i ra lug bzhi brgya tsam yod 'dug gzim chung du tshe lha rnam gsum gyi sku thang dang /bla khre bcas rgyun du bkram mus kyang / de lo ri khrod nas phebs khar gnas skabs sku thang dang / bla bre bcas rul skyon mi 'byung ba'i ched bsdu dgos tshul bka' phebs pa de ni/ sku 'phreng 'di pas slar ri khrod du zhabs kyis mi gcags pa'i brda mdzad pa lta bu zhig tu snang / phyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 1 bod sa phag zla ba dang wa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin/phran cho 'phrul smon lam chen motsware grwa bskor rab 'byams pa'i mdzad 〉tsware skabs zhogs tshogs mang ja/ gsung chos ru ba'i dam bca'/ gung tshigs mang ja/ nyin gung dam bca'/ smon lam gung ja/ dgong dro'i dam bca' chen mo/ bshad chung dam bca' sosas tshang mar phebs te lung rigs smra ba'i khyu mchog rnams kyis kho bor zab pa dang rgya che ba'i

130 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa gzhung dag gi dka' gnad las brtsams pa'i brgal brtag mdzad skabs thugs zhib nan tan dang 'brel dam bca' grub rjes kho bor dgyes pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsis rab dga'i lang tsho mchodag tu brtas par mdzad/ bka' shag nas zur khang zhabs pad sngo bcar gyis da phan ngos kyi slob gnyer sku gas kyi skor la thugs khur che bzhes gnang bar yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis la legs 'bul sngar lam 'bul srol ltar gzhung nas yongs 'dzin gling rin po cher thod dkar gzhis kha zhes pa gzhi rgya chen po zhig gtan 'bul zhu rgyu yin tshul zhus par/ ji tsam byung na yang ngoms pa'i mtha' med tshul dang sbrags sngon bstsal kha reg lcags bam gzhis kha las gzhan gsar zhu ma dgos gsungs par/ 'on kyang mtshan rtags mdzad lharware legs 'bul la gcig ma bzhes na mi 'grigs tshul nan zhus skabs/ gzhis tshab tu bla brang 'dzin khongs 'bri gung mang ra dgon pa dang / de'i le lag rgyal steng dgon pa gnyis la nyams gso gnang sngagags zhu rgyu yin tshul phebs kyang / slar yang gzhis kha zhig dgyes bzhes dbo/sa tshul nan zhus kyis kha reg gzhis ma'i nye 'dabs gla sku da gzhis ka sa rgya chung ngu zhig yod tshod de dag 'bul rgyu dang / thugs bzhed ltar dgon pa khag gnyis kyi gtsug lag khang la nyams gasku gzhung gnas nas gnang rgyu dang / ar wa'i snga dam pa zur du mi dgos par phyag mdzod blo bzang lung rigs nas 'gan len dgos tshul bcas zhus/ smon lam grol rjes sngar srol ltar chibs rag rgyas pa dang bcas kho bo nor gling du phyir log skabs rin po che yang nor gling zhabs brtan lha khang du zhabs sor 'khod//dngarig tsho ri

10phyi lo 1959 lo rgya gar la btsan drodal du phebs rjes la dwags dang / ḍal har/ sbag sa/ wār khā+e/jo ra gdan bcas par phebs pa/mas zhe ra༅༅/ /ngos kyis bris pa'i ngos kyi yul dang ngos kyi mi mang zhes pa'i deb tu bkod zin pa ltar smon lam grol nas nyin shas rjes rgya the/da 'gal zla je cher gyur pa na/ nyin gcig phyi dro glo bur du nor stod gling kha nas lha sar rgya mi'i mo ṭor phon che bskyod par tshang mas phal cher rgya mi nor gling du yong bzo gleng / skabs der dza drag nyen 'gan che ba'i gnas su gyur stabs 'ga' zhig gis gsang thabs kyis re zhig bros byol du phebs gal che tshul zhus pa sku gas la brten/ gsol ja mchod bzhes kyi bzhes chas shig bsnams te phebs chog ang sar mdzad/ yin na yang de nyin phebs dgos ma byung ba dang / de rjes phyi zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bdun dgong mo ngos lha sa nor gling pho brang nas bros byol du ma bskyod mthu med kyi gnas tshul dza drag can zhig tu gyur stabs yongs 'dzin rin po che yang lhan phebs dbo sa rgyu'i bka' mo la zhus pa ltar zhabs brtan lha khang gi gzim chung du na bza' brjes te sku phreng gong ma'i dbyi lpags kyi sha 'jug gcig dang / phyag mdzod lags kyi gyon pa 'thod snam rgya smug gi phyu pa dang / wa lpags kyi zhwa mo zhig bzhes/ 7skyabs rje pha bong kha'i sku par phyag rjes can de dang / thugs dam gyi rten sog sngo dharmas ched du brkos pa'i ba so'i 'jigs byed kyi sku chung ngu zhig bcas gzhugs pa'i gser gyi ga'u chung chung

132 4skyabs rje yongs 'dzim gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen wa 'i ma jad rnam mdo tsa'i brjod ri de dag sku 'bag tu bsnams/ zhal 'don phyag dpe'i gras nas 'ga' zhig dbye 'byed kyis bsnams/ dase slong chos bzang ma thu stobs la bothemakhyi sgrol ma zer bar byams skyong dgos tshul bka' mngags gnang / phyag mjo da nas der sdod zhabs phyi gzhan rnams la rin po che nyin shas ri khrod du phebs rgyu yin pas gnas tshul phyir gyar med pa'i gsang rgya bsdams/mtshan mo chu tshod bcu par nor gling skal bzang pho brang gi dbu g.yab gsang sgo'i 'gram du do po 'or 'dren byed mkhan gyi rlangs 'khor chen wa'i steng ras kyis g.yogs pa zhig gi nang yongs 'dzin rin po che dang phyag gsol gnyis/ skyabs rje khri byang rin po che sku 'khor/ bka' blo na zur khang dang / shan kha/ sne shar/ ngos kyi gam bcar gsol gzim mchod gsum bcas dang lhan du phebs/ chab 'go zam par rlangs 'khor nas bsnanal te ra ma sgang gi gru kha bar zhabs thang dang / gru thon nas chibs thog la phebs/ 'u shang zhes pa dus rabs dgu pa'i nang gi mnga' bdag khri ral pa can zhes chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi nang tshan snyan grags can de'i gtsug lag khang du gsol tsha zhig gnang ste phebs/sang nub skyid gsongs ra ba smad grwa tshang du bzhugs/ de nas rim gyis 'phyongs rgyas ri bo bde chen dang / rgod dkar la brgyud de bla brang gi 'dzin bongs yar lung chos sde gong thos bas ma dar rgyas gling du sngon la phebs bskyod thog phran dar rgyas gling dgon du 'byor skabs bla ma sna rngo 'chang nas spos sne dang bcas bsu ba mdzad/ gzim chung du 'byor 'phral rten gsum ba455/ de nub phran dang mnyam yod gzhung zhabs sku 'khor yongs rdzogs la dgon pa nas phebs sgrib sogs kyi sne len shin tu gzab/ phri zla gsum pa'i tshes nyer drug nyin bya yul gong ma bstan 'dzin nor bu dang / mi dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje'i pho brang g.yul rgyal lhun rtse rdzong du gnas skabs bod kyi rgyal sa lta bu srid gzhung gsar 'dzugs kyi yongs khyab gsal bsgrags kyi rten 'brel mdzad sgo'i skabs rin po che nas maṇ+ḍal bshad 'bul bka' drin bskyangs/ de skabs bros byol du sku nga mus stabs tshang mas skya chas gyon

phyi lo 1959 lo rgya gar smu btsan byol du phebs rjes lī dwags dang / ḍal hor/ sbag sa/ 133par brten skabs der rin po ches de ring nga tshos bo dong pa don dgos byung song zhes sku rtsed kyang gnang / de nas rim phebs kyis mtsho snar 'byor nye'i skabs slo bur du gnam gru zhig shar lho'i phyogs nas nub byang du 'phur bskyod byas song ba rgya mi'i so nyul ba yin tshe 'bom 'phen mi yong ngam snyam pa'i thugs khral byung tshul gzhan la gsungs/ chibs thog tu zhal 'don kho na gsung zhing / dgong mor sku gzim lhod por gnang / phyi zla gsum pa'i tshes so gcig nyin/ jo/da dang rgya gar gyi sa mtshams chu dngas mor phebs par rgya mi'i btsan gnon dang nyen kha'i 'og nas grol zin stabs ha cang thugs ltod por gyur/ de nas rim phebs kyis mon rta dbang du dgon zhol grong khyim zhig tu bzhugs/ der mtsho sna dgon rtse rin po che nas thugs mabo sogs phul ba dang / sa khul der ri khrod chung ngu zhig 'dug par gdan zhus lhod bzhugs kyis phan tshun nang ma'i bka' mchid lhug par grol/ dgon rtse sprul sku de nyid sngon gdan sa 'bras spungs su slob gnyer gnang skabs dang / rjes sor pha bong kha rin ༷ che sogs kyi gsung chos khag sgra'i bka' khrid kyang lhan du gsan pa'i chos grogs shig yin gshis rjes sor yang phyag dpe khag 'bul ba dang / phyag bris 'bul res sogs mdzad/ rjes sor khong gis pha bong kha rin po che'i drung nas 'jam dbyangs zhi kho sbrags sgrub kyi bka' khrid gsan skabs kyi zin bris gras nas tshe sgrub mdzad tshul zhig kyang phul te yongs 'dzin 〉 rjo 'chang sku tshe yun brtan dgos pa'i gsol 'debs zhus/ mtsho sna nas rim bzhin mon rta dbang brgyud phebs te nyin bzhi'i rjes 'bum sde lar bzhugs zhag gnang skabs 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po ches yongs 'dzin gling rin po che sku tshe zhabs pad yun brtan gyi gasku/la 'debs ched mgur ma sngo la byung du bstsal ba zhal bshus mdzad/spang rjen khul phebs skabs ma byan blo chos kyi bzhon rta g.yang sar lhung ste glo bur shi ba de nub dgong mo blo chos nas mchod me 'bul ba dang 'brel zhabs zhu a mthod rgan sbyin pa rgya mtshor smon lam rnam lnga yongs rdzogs 'don du 'jug par ma zad/ khri byang rin po che

134 4skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul sdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa dang lhan du yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gis kyang zhal 'don smon lam gsungs shing / thugs smon nan tan mdzad 'dug pa ltar na dud 'gro de nyid las can zhig tu mngon/ 'bum sde lar phebs bzhugs skabs de snga mon rta dbang dgon pa phyag 'debs pa po me rab bla ma blo cadas rgya mcho'i yang srid gu ru rin po ches ji ltar ga1/la 'debs zhus ngor khong la khu skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang gis lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid lung zhig bstsal/ skabs der bod nas khrid phebs pa'i bla brang gi rta drel dang chibs dpon rta sga yo chas sogs gu ru rin lnga cher bcol sngo zhus/ gu ru rin po ches kyang gling rin po che'i chibs pa chibs drel la mcher brtsis te gang ci'i gso skyong yag po gnang yod 'dug 'bum sde la nasa.a sam te dzi pur dang de nas rim bzhin/ me 'kho ra brgyud phyi zla bzhi pa'i zla dkyil tsam la rgya gar byang phyogs ma su rir ngos cag lhan du bde 'byor ltar sbir la ha'o si zhes pa'i khang kho ngas phran gyi nye 'gram zhig tu rgya gar gzhung gis phebs sgrig gnang ba der bzhugs/ de'i skabs re zhig mjal kha zhu mkhan sogs bcar mkhan nyung bas thugs dam 'phel/ mdzod pa nas bla brang gi sku chas phran tsam yang 'khyer ma thub pa zhes sems khral byed skabs da res gtso che 7gong sa chen po mchog gis dbus nga tsho tshang ma bde gro'i ngang bros byol du yong thub pa red/ 7gong sa chen po'i bka' drin gyis nga tsho rang dbang 'phags yul du bde bar slebs pa red/ gal te bod du lhag pa yin na nga tsho tshang ma rgya mis kha bral du btang thogabasgu na bcug 'thab 'dzings kyi mnar gcod codag tshud na gang 'dra zhig sku/nga ba 'dug de bzhin bsam blo nges par du btang ste/ sems khral byed rgyu phar bzhag rang sku ga thar bar dga' sgom chog shes byed dgos/ rgyu nor dngos po ci tsam yod rung / snga phyi ma ltos par tshang ma bzhag dgos pa shes gsal dang / da res dngul dngos bzhag pa phran bu snga tsam byung ba las/ sngon gyi lan chags dbang gis bu 'o/na sprod dbo sa pa yin tshe/ da lta yod thog 'dir sprod thub pa yag po red ces bka' slob bstsal/ phyi zla bzhi pa'i tshes

phyi lo 1959 lo rgya gar la btsan byol du phebs rjes la dwags dang / ḍal hor/ sbag sa/ 135nyer gsum nyin/ yongs 'dzin rin po che nas phran dang / khri byang rin po che bcas lhan du 'dzam gling gi yul gru spyi dang / bye brag bsil ldan gangs kyi rwa bas bskor ba'i ljongs su 'khrug rtsod sogs dus kyi rgyud pa myur du zhi ba'i ched 7rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung bar dam bcas pa'i chos skyodang rnams kyi thugs dam bskul ba'i chod ga mdzad/ de'i phyi nyin rgya gar srid blon paṇ+ḍita ne+e ru (28bsku1 sakhukhyi(5)mchog ngos thug 'phrad ched ldi li nas phebs 'byor skabs bod kyi gzhung zhabs gzhan rnams dang lhan du yongs 'dzin rin po ches kyang gus 'dud bstar sgrig gis srid slon niha rur mjal dar 'bul bzhes dang / de rjes srid blon phyir phebs skabs kyang gong bzhin phebs skyel zhu gnang mdzad/ phyi zla lnga pa'i tshes gnyis nyin/ thodad zla gsum pa'i tshes lnga 'khel bas phran tshos bla ma mchod pa bde lho nga dbyer med dang 'brel ba'i tshogs 'khor gzab rgyas thog bar lam bod du dus zing gi rkyen pas 'jig rten phyi ma'i lam sngo cher zhugs pa rnams kyi ched sgyu na lam gang mang 'don skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che gdan zhus ltar tshe 'das rnams gtan bde'i lam bzang la myur du reg pa'i thugs smon bka' drin bskyangs/ phyi zla lnga pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin/sa zla'i dus chen 'khel bas phran sdod yul gyi mdun spang ljongs steng 'dzam gling nang pa'i chodas byed khag nas bstan pa'i snying por nyams bzhes gnang dbo/sa tshul sogs zhib bshad bgyis mtshams phran dang sku/ngas 'dzin rnam gnyis sku gas nas skyabs 'bo/ khrus gasku/la sgyu na lam shis brjod dang bcas zhal 'don khag gsung zin rjes ma su ri khul du gtan sdod bod rigs dang / phyi rgyal ba bcas mi grangs chig lha nga skor la ngos nas 'phags pa thugs rje chen wa'i snying po yig drug ma ṇi'i bzlas lung bgyis skabs rin po che nas kyang gsan bzhes bskyangs/ de'i nyin rjes mar sne shan spyi khyab sku zhabs me cadan (5000ba)nasaphran dang / yongs 'dzin rin po che mo gas phan tshun chos kyi bgro gleng mdzad bzhin bzhugs skabs sku par sgron bzhes gnang / phyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin bka' shag gis

136 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sbul ldo lnge 'chang chen ngo 'a mdzad rna'i ma ngo tsam brjod ri mtshon gzhung zhabs ser skya s+t+ri mgrin nas bla mchod dang 'brel phran ring 'tsho'i cho sa bgyis stabs chog grwa'i dbu bzhugs mdzad de thugs smon bka' drin bskyangs pa mi jigs sro sa gi zungs su smin/ la dgas nang pa/'i chos tshogs nas de phyogos su ma/tshan nyid dzā ba grwa bsar 'dzugs kyi sgo dbye'i rten 'brel stabs ngos yong dbos 'bod skul/ byung ya nga /skabs der cadad mi skyabs bcol ba mang po gas ra du 'byor bzhin nga/ sogs kyi rkyen nga sa gnas tshul dza drag la brten sngo sa rang 'gro ma thub par yongs 'dzin jo rngo 'chang chen sngo phobs rogs zhus nga ra phyi zla dgu pri 'i tshes gsum nyin ma su ri nas mo ṭor thob phebs thon gyis nga ṭan ko ṭa dang / de nas la bi mir grong khrer si ri nā gar bar gnam gyur phe bas/ mnga' sde'i chos tshobs nas so sgri sa zhus pa ltar si ri nā gar nyirme lnga tsam/ bzhugs reng la dwags rgyal sras ba ku la rin po che nas de khul gzigs skor du gdan zhu gnang / stabs/ der ka shi mir mnga' sde'i dbu khrid lhag shi sgu lam mahwa ma ḍa dang /(222361 65/ma sa/ji/ba'ibakab 'i7) rgyal po ka rān sing (57120 51226)bcas kyis gsol jar gdan drangs/ grong khyer si ri nā gar bod nas btsan cadal du 'byor pa la dwags khu che khyim tshang na// gdan zhus ltar kho nga tshos spro snang chen wa'i sgo nas phebs bsu sne len dang gsol tshigs zab rgyas phul/ de nas phyi tshes bcu gcig nyin mkha' lam brgyud la dwags sle'i sanam thang du phebs 'byor skabs/ la dgas kyi dgre+on sde khag si mkhan bla las sne dang / yul mi 'go bying / rgya gar gyi dmag da14na bcas kyis phebs bsu zab rgyas zhus/ gnam thang nas chibs thog dpe thub dbo/na du phebs bzhugs gnang / phyi nyin bsam dkar dgon du chibs chodag sadan zhus ltar mtshan nyid slob grwa gsar du sgo 'byed mdzad lha dang dam bca' brtsi bzhag gnang / de nas sle'i grong du chos zhu ba stong phrag bzhi tsam zhig la 'jigs byed lha bcu sasum ma'i dbang chen sta gon dang bcas nga bstsal/ nyin shas rjes khul de 'i mang tshogs kyis zhu bsku ra ltar thugs rje chen wa'i dbang chen zhig bstsal/ gzhan yang

phri ro 1959 'o/ rgya gar la btsan khyodal du phebs rjes la dwags dang / shel hor/ sbag sa / 137khrigs se dgon pa dang / klu 'khyil dgon/ ri rdzong dgon/ he mi dbon/ stag sna dgon sogs kyis gdan zhus ltar chibs bsgyur sanang ste se/ra skya mi mang rnams la so so'i re 'dod bzhin/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang / yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i bsad lung / nā ro mkha' spu+od ma'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs / tshe dbang / ma ḍi'i ljags lung sobs bstsal/ ris med dbon khag rnams la mang ja/ sku 'gyed sogs bsnyen bkur zhu gnang dang 'brel spyi sbos bstan 'gro'i don du thugs smon mdzad/ khul de'i yas mas la chibs lnga ga ya stag phebs kyang / bod nas phebs grub tsam la song gshis sku mnyel ba'i tshul gtan nas ma bzhes/ la dwags khul du bstan 'gror sman pa'i mdzad 'phrin legs par bskyangs grub rjes phyi zla bcu bcig pa'i tshes lnga nyin sle nas gnam thos brgyud ka shi smir phyir phebs bskyangs/ de nas mo ṭor thog sku 'bor rnams 'jam spo grong byer du ba ku la rin po che'i gzim khang du mtshan bcig sku bzhugs dang / tshe dbang bi ce sa 'brel zhig kyang gnang /de'i phri nyin ma su rir phyir phebs mdzad rjes ngos sar phebs te bar lam la dgas khrul gyi gnas lugs dang / bstan 'gror sman pa'i mdzad 'phrin bskyangs tshul stodar zhib cha bka' bstsal/ nyin gnyis kyi rjes sngoras nas bla mchod tshogs 'khor dang 'brel yongs 'odzin rin po che zhabs pad yun du brtan pa'i gresol 'debs zhus/ bar lam ྅ped nas skyabs bcol du gsar 'byor gdan sa'i bla sprul dge 'dun dang mi mang gang 'tsham ḍal la ha'o si dang / sbag sa bcas par 'phral sel gzhis chags su 'kho da pa rnams dang / lhag par ris med chos byed dge 'dun pa so/gas/ la 'tshams 'dri dang 'phral yun byed sgo'i slob ston gnang bar phran gyi thor tshab tu yongs 'dzin rin po che macesag phebs gnang yong ba zhus pa ltar/ phyag gsol gnyis dang / pha lha mgron che/ gsung bsgyur phur bsam so gas lhan du mo ṭar thog spyi zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bzhi nyin/ ḍa' hor du phebs skabs/ rgya sar gzhung si phebs sgrig zhus/ nga 'i ma/gron khang du bzhugs/ de'i nyin rjes ma ra khul de'i

138 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa thang chen zhig tu rgyud grwa rnam gnyis dang / mang cadas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa tre+e hor skyor dpon/ spang nang sprul sku sogs skya ser 'du 'dzoms chen por 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bka' dbang / thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang chen/ spyan ras gzigs ngan song kun grol gyi rjes gnang / tshe dbang sogs 'dod bstun chos 'brel dang / blang dor byed sgo'i skor bka' slob gnang / yang skabs der shel thodar du gdan sa gsum gyi dge 'dun pa bzhugs yul mārgags khang du gnas gzigs bskyangs/de'i phyi nyin khams sprul bstan pa'i nyi ma rin po che bkra shis rdzongs nas ḍal hor du ched phebs kyis 7skyabs rje rin po che khong gi bzhugs yul dang / rten gso khang du gdan zhu gnang thog khams sprul rin po che rang nyid kyis phyag bstar ma'i bzhengs grub gnang pa'i rje btsun sgrol dkar gyi sku thang zhig dang mjal dar rten gsum 'bul gnang dang 'brel sku tshe zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs gnang / bdun phrag gcig gi ring khul der chodas 'brel 'tshams 'dri gzigs lha ra sku gas grub rjes sku 'kho ra rnam pa pa ṭan bo ṭar phebs/ bod nas btsan byol du phebs pa'i ris med bla sprul dge 'dun pa 'phral sel bzhugs yul sbag sa chos sgar du 'tshams 'dri gnang ched khul der slo bur phebs dgos kyi rkyen pas me 'kho ra.ang rim dang gnyis kyi lag 'khyer ma thob par brten bzhugs yul ha cang gi gu dog pa dang / tsha ba sogs kyi sku ngal chen po byung yang / gzhan don du 'gyur na dka' ngal ci yang bajo da pa'i ngang tshul bdag gir bzhes/ sbag sar bzhugs yul rgya gar gzhung nas phebs sgrig zhus/ der rnam grwa 'ga' shas kyis skyabs zhus ltar/ bdag bskyed dang / bzlas pa khas len zhu mkhan rnams la rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dang / ris med dge 'dun stong phrag brgal ba'i cadag ser skya mang tshogs rnams la 'phags maco ga thugs rje'i gter chen bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang chen dang / tshe dbang bcas bstsal/ skabs der dge 'dun pa bod nas phebs mkhan khongs dus zing gi rkyen pas dge tshul slong gi sdom

phyi lo 1959 lo rgya gar la btsan drodal du phebs rjes la dgas dang / shel rtsodar/ sbag sa/ 139pa phyir 'bul dgos byung ba mang po zhig la bskyar du thog mar dge tshul dang / de nas dge slong gi sdom pa 'bogs par mdzad/ dge 'dun rnams tshogs dang / chos rur phebs te 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi la gnas pa'i ngang tshul lhur bzhes par dgyes mnyes chen po mdzad/ 'ga' zhig nas 'jigs byed dpa' gcig gi dbang chen gnang rogs zhes zhus kyang thugs khom ma gyur/ der bzhugs ris med dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas mdzad/ skya ser mi mang 'du 'dzoms sar ḍal hor dang / sbag sar gsung chos gnang zhor bod du gnas tshul ngan pa 'di dag byung ba spyi sgos bstan 'tho'i bgegs dbang lta bu dang / gtso bor rang cag rnams kyis las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bur gdon mi za bas/ dgra bo la yang khong kho'i bsam pa gtan nas ma bskyed par byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas de dag this brnag par dka' ba'i ngan 'gro'i rgyu sgrub pa 'di dag mtshams gcod thub pa'i thugs smon bden tshig gnang gal che ba dang / chos byed dge 'dun rnams nas rang rang gis khas blangs pa'i dam sdom mig gi 'bras bu ltar srung ba gzhir bzhag ste/ grub mtha' so 16) rang gzhung la thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral ba gnang dathodas pa/ sa dge bka' rnying sogs bod kyi chos lugs khag rnams kyang ston pa gcig gi rjes su 'brangs pa'i chos lugs tshad ldan sha stag yin gshis/ tshudags ris spangs te dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab pa dgos gal che lugs sogs bka' slob bstsal/de nas phyi 'o/ 1960 zla 1 tshes 1 nyin me 'khor thog gnas chen sā ra nā thar phebs/ sngon nas gra sgrig zhus pa ltar gsol dkrum bzhes mi chog pa'i rgya gar ba'i khang khongs shig tu bzhugs/ rim bzhin chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten rin po che'i mdun du stong mchod dang / bzhan yang bdas cag bi ston pa thugs rje can de nyid kyis bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i gnas drang srong lhung ba ri dbas kyi nags sogs su yang yang phebs te 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam ston 'dren mchog dam pa de

140 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sbrul rdo rje 'chang chen pa 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pri nyid kyi lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa dar rgyas yun du gnas pa'i thugs smon bskyangs/skabs der phran yang sā ra nā thar slebs zin pas tshes bcu'i snga dro chu tshod bcu gcig thog phran sdod yul du phebs te bar lam ḍa la ha'o si dang / sbag sar yod pa'i bod rigs skyabs bsnyu la ba ser skya rnams kyi gnas tshul dang / khong tshor gsung chos/ bka' slob ji bstsal gyi gnad don rnams zhib par gsungs/ tshes bcu gsum gyi snga dro'i chu tshod lnga dang phyed shar phran la theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom pa zhu mos ltar bstsal/ tshes 15 nyin snga ༷'i chu tshod dgu par/ bod dgon gnas 'dzin thub bstan 'byung gnas nas rgyu sbyar te sngo sa la bla mchod dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga bgyis skabs rdo rje 'chang nas chog grwa'i dbu bzhugs gnang ba tshe bsod 'phel ba'i dpal du smin/ tshes bco brgyad nyin yongs 'dzin rin po che phran sar gdan zhus kyis nyin gung gasku/la tshigs 'bul bzhes sar don dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid lhug par bo la/ nyin gung yol nas mi grangs bco brgyad la dge tshul gyi sdom pa bstsal/ tshes bcu dgu nyin 7rgyal mchodag na rim gyi mdzad pa dang mthun par phran nas bstan pa'i rtsa ba so thar gyi sgyu ma rgyun dang por spel bar/ de khyodan nas 'dul 'dzin thodang ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes khag zhib cha bka' lho ba bka' drin che byung ba ma zad/ de nyin brag g.yab rin po che sku gas bsgrub bya bco lnga la ngos nas mkhan wa'i bgyi ba byed khul gyis da chog nyes med phun tshogs kyi lha nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa sbyin par yongs 'dzin rin po che nas las kyi sli ba dasngo na mdzad de phyag len che phra mtha' dag mig ston lta bur mdzad/ tshes nyer bzhi'i dgong dro chu tshod gcig gi thog phran nas mdo sngags kyi stodar la dri ba 'ga' shas zhus pa rnams la gsung lan zhib par balcal te blo spo/sa kyi lus stobs rgyas par mdzad/ chu tshod bzhi pa'i thog kho thod cag dang lhan du sā ra nā tha'i lha khang du gnas gzigs dang 'brel rten 'brel bstod pa gsung ste ston pa thugs rje can de nyid kyis stong pa rten 'byung gi don du 'doms pa'i tshul las brtsams te bka' drin dran

phyi lo 1959 lo rgya gar la btsan byol du phebs rjes la dwags dang / shel hor/ sbas sa/ 141par mdzad/ phyi zla gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis nyin me 'khor thog sku 'khor rnams rdo rje gdan du phebs sngo na gnang / phyi tshes gsum nyin rdor gdan bod dgon dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling du chol gsurme ser skya spyi nas ngos ring 'cho'i brtan bzhugs phul skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che nas bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi mthun 'gyur sogs bcing5 ba mi shigs srog gi dwangs mar smin/ phyi tshes bzhi nyin snga dro chu tshod dgu par mchod rten rin po che'i gtsang khang du phran nas bsgrub bya sum cu so gcig la dge stsodang gi sdom pa 'bog skabs rin po ches las kyi slob dpon mdzad cing / dgong dro mchod rten rin po che'i spyan sngar bod rigs ser skya spyi nas rgyu sbyar te bla mchodad tshogs 'khor dang 'brel sras bcas 7rgyal ba'i spyan sngar mchodad sprin spro skabs rin sngo che yang lhan phebs kyis thugs smon bskyangs/ phyi tshes bcu gnyis nyin snga dro chu tshod dgu par byang chub chen po'i shing drung du kho bo cag dang lhan du dus 'brel gso sbyong dang / dgong dro'i chu tshod lnga dang phyed shar bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dang 'brel skyabs yul rnams tshogs kyi 'kho ra los mnyes par mdzad/ phyi tshes nyer gcig nyin me 'khor thog sku 'khor rnams ma su rir phyir phebs mdzad/ phri tshes nyer bdun bod lcags byi gnam lo gsar tshes nyin sngar srol ltar lha mo gsung byon pa'i sku thang la thugs smon snyan shal dang / phran la yang maṇ+ḍal rten dod bcas bstsal te dgyes ston la rol/ phyi tshes nyer dgu/ bod zla dang po'i tshes gsum nyin sngar srol ltar 'dod khams bdag 66) gzab gsol skabs lhan phebs kyis yangs pa'i yul gru kun tu nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi zhing / lus can kun kyang chos 'byor bde skyid kyi dpal la 'tsho ba'i ched gang la gang 'dul gyi las bzhi'i 'phrin las g.yel med sgrub dgos pa'i bka' rtags rdo rje'i cod pan spyi bor bcings/ phyi zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum nyin rtsis dpon zhwa skab pa dbang phyug bde ldan gyis gresol ba btab pa lta ra/ khong be+e skyes ma de nyid kyis gyotsos 'brel thog tshe las 'das tshad rnams kyi sdig ltung ci mchis byang zhing dag nas/ ring min sku bzhi

142 〉skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gleng sprul ldo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa ye shes lnga ldan gyi rgyal sar reg pa'i thugs smon bskyangs/ phyi tshes bcu'i nyin ngos sdod yul gyi mdun ngos gdengs char bod rang dbang sber langs kyis rgya dmar la ngo 6wal 'thab 'dzings kyi las 'gul byas nas lo gcig 'khor ba'i dran gso'i dus chen skabs lhan phebs gnang / phyi tshes bcu gsum/ bod zla dang wa'i tshes bco lnga nyin mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de nyid kyis yang dag pa'i lam nas phyi rol tu gyur pa'i ston pa drug 'khor dang bcas pa rdzu 'phrul gyi sgo nas pham par mdzad pa'i dus chen 'khel gshis/ phran gyi sprodad yul du 'dren pa bla na med pa de nyid la mchod cing gsol 'debs bgyis skabs lhan phebs kyis lha na pa tshad mas bstan pa'i lam bzang 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir yun du gnas pa sogs kyi thugs dmigs bskyangs/ phyi tshes bco lnga nas bzung nyin gsum ring bstan srid bde thabs slad/ mgon sngo / snu sa rgyal/ lha mo bcas kyi bskang bshags grangs gsog bgyis skabs bshags yul dang / bshags bya/ bshags pa po bcas te 'khe ra gsum bden par med par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi rtsis zin pa'i sgo nas thugs smon zab/ phyi zla 4 tshes bcu dgu nyin bstan srid bde thabs slad 'phar ma'i bskang bshags bgyis skabs rin po che lhan phebs kyis thugs smon bskyangs//

11ma su ri nas dha sar spo shugs gnang rjes kyi mdzad pa'i skor/ne /zhe༄༅༅/ /phyi lo 1961 zla 4 tshes 30 nyin ngos ston 'khor ma su ri nas/ hi ma cal par sde shi mnga' sde'i khongs rda ram sa lar gnas spos thog cob ra ha'o si zhes pa'i khang pa rgya gar gzhung gis phebs sgrig zhus pa der lo shas ring khang pa de'i shar rgyud du rgya gar gzhung gis bzhugs sgar du ched btsugs sku tshab sne shan dang / nub rgyud du yongs 'dzin rin po che sku 'kho ra lhan bzhugs mdzad/ rjes sor sne shan khang pa gzhan du spos rjes cob ra ha'o si bzhugs khang der blo bzang snu sa kyi skyed tshal zhes ming 'dogs mdzad pa dang mthun par yab rje 7rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i snying sngo/ra thugs dam nyams bzhes dang 'brel 'chad spel sdudags kyi dus 'da' bar mdzad pa'i 'o/ rgyus rnams gsham du rim gyis gsal/ phyi zla lnga pa'i tshes gsum nyin gdan sa gsum dang / rgyud grwa stod smad dang bcas pa'i ris med chos byed dge 'dun spyi dang / gzhung zhabs/ mi mang bcas nas phran ring 'chorware cho ga bgyis skabs cho ga'i dbu bzhugs gnang / phyi tshes bzhi/ bod zla gsum pa'i tshes brgyad nyin/ sngar lam brgyad gtor mdzad chen sarba ma 'chol tsam slad/kho bo cag dang lhan du 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas ldo rje gur gyi mgon po dang / lha bas 'phrog dbang po dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa sogs krasi gathodas chos srung khag gi bskang gso mdzad/ bar stabs rin po che sku khams phran bu ma bde ba'i

144 4skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sbrul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa tshul bzhes par brten phyi zla drug pa'i tshes gcig nyin ḍal hor nas em rje ye shes don ldan 'byor pa ltar/ snga dro chu tshod bdun bar sku chab dang / phyag rtsa bcas par brtag dpyad zhus te gsol sman phul/ tshes bzhi nyin rang gzhung bka' shag nas rgyu sbyar te dz+nya sar bzhugs pa'i ris med bla sprul dge bshes sogs dge 'dun rnams gzim chung du 'du 'dzoms kyis bla mchod dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs phul te/ yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang chen po thun mong snang ngor sku tshe 'gal rkyen las grol te/ zhabs zung yun du brtan pa'i gsol 'debs nan tan zhus/ de'i nyin rjes mar srid tshab zur pa bde mkhar ba nas rgyu sbyar te phran la ring 'tsho'i cho ga bgyis skabs rdo rje 'chang masnu ga cho ga'i dbu bzhugs su phebs te thugs smon gnang / tshes bcu dgu nyin/ rwa stod skyong bla sprul skus zhus ngor don gnyer can gyi ser skya lnga bcu skor la gzim chung du 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang chen sta gon dang bcas pa balcal/ phran nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ phyi zla bcu pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang gi sta gon dang / bcu dgu nyin dngos gzhi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa bka' drin bstsal/ tshes nyer bzhi nyin gling bla brang gi zhabs 'bring rnams nas yongs 'dzin rin po cher brtan bzhugs 'bul skabs chos sde chen sngo gsum gyi bla spyi dang / rgyud grwa stod smad/ rnam rgyal grwa tshang bcas nas kyang zhabs pad yun du brtan pa'i gasku la 'debs zhus/ tshes nyer dgu nyin/ bka' blon shan kha ba 'gyur med sdodabs rgyal nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ bdag bskyed dang /gzungs sngags bzla rgyu'i khas len can mi grangs bzhi bcu skor la sa dge mkhas grub gong ma'i phyag rjes phra mo tsam yang ma nyams par phyi nang gsang ba'i swā) rje btsun mo/ ngo 'phrod nges kyi rdo rje rnal 'acadar ma'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs bstsal/ phyi zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun nyin/ kho bo'i ngag bkod ltar sku sger yig tshang nas r+ha sar yod pa'i chos byed dge 'dun rnams gdan drangs te yongs 'dzin rin po cher brtan bzhugs phul ba dgyes ba'es mdzad/

ma su ri nas dha sar spro shugs gnang rjes kyi mdzad nga 'i stor/ 145tshes bco lnga nyin la dwags pa grwa brgyad la dge tshul gyi sdom pa bstsal/ sngon nas sku khams phran bu bde min sku da mus la brten ring min ka tar sman khang du phebs rgyur tshes bcu bdun nyin phran sar thon mjal du phebs te spyod mjal thog gsol sman 'phrod bzhes gnang rgyu sogs lhod med kyis bstan 'gro'i don du sku tshe yun brtan yong ba'i gsol 'debs zhus/ tshes bco brgyad nyin nang srid bka' blon pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan dang / phyi 'brel bka' blon sne shar thub bstan thar pa sogs dad ldan slob ma phal cher mjal bcar gyi bstan pa'i nyin byed chen ngo'i zhabs zung bstan 'tho'i mthodan du yun sring brtan pa'i gsol 'debs zhus/ tshes bcu dgu nyin/ cob ra ha'o si nas phebs thon gnang ste meg 'o/ra lhan jir bka' khrodan rnams dang / gzhung zhabs las byed sogs nas mjal bcar zhus/pa kun ko ṭi bar phebs ṭor dang / de nas me 'khor thog phebs te ka tar bka' blon zur khang nas phebs sgrig zhus pa ltar mabo na khang zhig tu bzhugs/ nyin shas rjes 'u ḍā lan 9sgar sing hom zhes pa'i sman khang du 'jar man gyi em rje snyan grags can ḍog ṭar han ṭar (21 55ba khu1)zhes pa nas sku gzugs la brtags dpyad kyis mgul lba dang / sku snying gi snyun gzhi yin tshul zhus/ rin po che'i yum la mgul lba yod pa ma zad/ phyi lo 1950 lo gro mor zla drug tsam bzhugs skabs shing chu bzhes pa'i stabs kyis mgul lba che ru song ba red dgongs te thugs snang de tsam ma gnang / 'on kyang ḍog ṭar nas gnas skabs sman khang du bzhugs pa legs tshul dang / snyun gzhi ha cang lod po 'dug ces zhus par khong gi brjod don bzhin 'u ḍā lan ḍā nar sing hom zhes pa'i sman khang du mu mthud bzhugs/ nyin re bzhin gsol sman khag mang tsam phul bar mchod bzhes bskyangs/ sman khang gi gsol tshigs de tsam bzhes ma thub par brten bzhugs yul gzim shag nas gsol tshigs bzhings te 'bul lam zhu rtsis zhus kyang / sman khang gi las byed pa sogs ma dga' ba'i rgyur yong dogs kyis dgongs babs ma gyur cing / der brten nyin re bzhin sku gzugs

146 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sngul sdo rje 'chang chen pa 'a mdzad rnam mdo cam brjod nga je zhan du phebs par phyag mdzod lags nas ga zem shag tu gdan 'dren zhu rgyu'i thabs shes zhus par sman nga/sa 'gan blos bzod min gyi mos mthun ma byas/ skabs der gsung sgyur phyag rogs zhu bar tsha rong rim bzhi yod par khong gis legs nyes ci byung yang nga tshos 'gan len zhu rgyu yin tshul nan che bshad rjes sman khang nas phebs na 'grigs rgyu'i em rjes mos mthun byas/ gyen thur dang phebs skas sogs la phebs rgyu gnas skabs ngang 'then gnang dgos kyi slob ston lta ra phebs bskyod bde ched bzhugs yul 'og shas cig tu phebs sgrig zhus te sman khang nas tshur gdan 'dren zhus/ gsol sman mchod mus steng bod lugs kyi gsol tshigs phul bar 'phrod bzhes che bar brten sku khams cung dngas bskyed bzhes/ stabs der mtshur phu /rma pa rin po che yang yongs 'dzin rin po che'i bzhugs yul du ched phebs kyis sku tshe zhabs pad yun du brtan pa'i gsol 'debs mdzad/ kho bos sman bang du phyag sne dang sbrags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang chen po sku tshe yun brtan gyi sasol 'debs dang / rdor gling khul du bzhugs na sa bsil zhing / bod rigs mang stabs thugs bag phebs pa yong rgyu'i bsam 'char zhu yig phul ba ltar rdor gling du phebs rgyur thugs thag bcad de de don sman dri ra gsungs bi ra/ khong gis gnam thog phebs rgyu dang /rdor gling sa mtho bas 'grigs min zhus kyang / nga tsho bod sa mthor skyes par brten skyon de tsam mi yong gsung ste ka ta nas mkha' lam brgyud sbas ḍo ra dang / de nas phebs 'khor thog rdor gling gum dgon bsam gtan chos gling du phebs/ sman pa'i slob ston ltar phebs skas thog phebs ma chog par brten dgon pas gsang sgo gsar du bzos te dgon nga 'i rgyab nas shing zam brgyud phan tshun phebs bde ba sogs sku'i snyun babs dang bstun nga/'i 'phrod bsten mthun 'gyur bzhugs sgrig gzab gzengs zhus/ sman pa yang rdor gling du ldan bcar gyis bdun gcig song mtshams brtag dpyad zhus par snyun gzhi ha cang dngas bskyed bzhes par shin tu ya mtshan skyes/ khong ka tar phyir log stabs rdor gling du gtan sdod bod rigs

gcig khri byang rin po che yang gum dgon du ched phebs kyis yongs 'dzin jo rngo 'chang chen po sku tshe brtan pa sogs kyi gsol 'debs mdzad/ 'bras blo gling rgya ra sprul sku ched bcar gyis ma codangs pa na 7skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar zhig 'khod thub na bstan pa dang / sems can la phan thogs chen po 'byung nges la mdzad rnam gyi sa bon zhig bka' bstsal thugs rje che ba zhes zhus par/ bshad rgyu med ces bka' bstsal bas yang bskyar zhu ma nus/ lha bla khag gi lung brtag dgongs don/ bla brang nas rgyu sbyar te ka sbug thar chos dgon gyi dge 'dun rnams nas bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sgo nas a ru ra'i stong mchod/ gum dathodan du rgya ra sprul sku dbu bzhugs kyis lcags mkhar/ gzhan yang sbag sa chos sde sogs ris med dge 'dun gyi sder sku phywa'i zhabs rim rgya che smin sgrubaganang / gum dgon/ blo gling grwa tshang / lha sa nas gsar 'byor shel sgo tshong khang gi bal sngo sogs spyi sger mang pos brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga dang 'brel zhabs pad yun du brtan pa'i gsol 'debs zhus 'bras bcas la brten rim gyis sku khams dngas bskyed bzhes/ phyi zla dgu pa'i tshes sum cu nyin/ gum dathodan bsam gtan chos gling rang nas skyabs zhus ltar rdor gling dang ka spug khul gyi ser skya mi mang stong phrag brgal pa 'du 'dzoms sar phyag rdor drag po gsum bsgril gyi rjes gnang bcingab/ phyi zla 10 tshes 25 nyin gum dgon nas khar shang du phebs te phyi nyin de khul mi mang spyi nas gsol ba

148 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa btab pa ltar bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe dbang bstsal/ rdor gling khul du dbyar thog gcig ring sman bcos 'phrod bzhes legs par grub ste phyi tshes so gcig nyin me 'khor brgyud shi li ku ri nas r+ha sar phyir phebs bskyangs/ rda steng meg 'o/ra lhan ji nas bla brang bar de skabs mo sa ra phebs lam med rkyen bka' tshab shan kha ba bsod nams lha bas rgyal nas gra sgrig zhus te chibs thog phebs/ phyi zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gnyis nyin gdan sa gsum dang / rgyud grwa khyodad smad bcas nas brtan bzhugs phul/yang tshes nyeragacig nyin srid tshab zur pa bde mkhar bas brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul bzhes bskyangs/ phyi zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes dgu nyin dga' gdong chos skyong shing bya can rten gzhir spyan drangs te slad phyin sku gzugs la gsol sman sku gas 'phrod bsten gnang phyogs ji 'gab bka' 'dri gnang bar zhu lan dang 'brel zhabs pad yun brtan gyi gsol 'debs zhus/ nyin gsum gyi rjesa'aphan po nā lan+d+ra gzim 'og rin po che'i mdun du ched phebs kyi tshe dbang zhig zhu gnang mdzad/ sa dge'i bstan 'dzin chen po rnam gnyis gcig gis gcig la bstan 'tho'i don du sku tshe zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs zhu res mdzad/phyi nyin phran sar thon mjal du phebs/ dgun chodag sā ra nā thar bzhugs rgyu'i skor sogs bka' bstsal bar/ phran nas kyang sku gzugs la 'phrod bzhes thugs zab gnang skyong dang /zhabs pad yun du brtan pa'i gsol 'debs zhus/ nyin gsum gyi rjes r+ha sa nas pa ṭan ko ṭa brgyud me 'khor thog swā ra nā thar phebs te/ byang chub chos tshogs kyi mgron khang du bzhugs/phyi 'o/ 1962 zla 1 tshes 30 nyin ser smad grwa bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ chos zhu ba brgyad cu skor la 'jigs byed kyi bka' dbang dang /phyi nyin rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs bcas bstsal/ de sngon phyi zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang thon mjal la phebs skabs sku tshe yun du brtan pa'i gsol 'debs nan tan zhus mod/ sku ngas

ma su ri nas d+dha sar spo shugs gnang rjes kyi mdzad pa'i sgor/ 149'dzin rdo rje 'chang chen sngo gser zhal 'tsho bzhugs ma gnang tshe kho bos da dung rgyal bstan spyi dang / bye brag 'jam mgon snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa ji snyed cig zhu rgyur bsdad pa dang /bstan srid nyag phra 'di 'dra'i skabs kho bo lo na phra zhing / byi'u phrug thang bskyur lta bu'i gnas su gyur dogs sogs kun rtog gi ri mo sna tshogs pa zhig shar bar brten de 'phral de don ltar gyi zhu yig dang / dngos su snyan gsol zhu dgos lugs slob ston bgyis te ched mngags zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin brag g.yab rin po che sā ra nā tha'i bzhugs yul du bcar te de bzhin snyan gsol zhus/ tshes bcu dgu nyin rbe hor skyor dasngo na rin po che dang / gang gi phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong rnams gdan zhus dang 'brel dgongs bstun brag g.yabarin ༄ chos cho sa'i dbu ngazhusas mdzad de zang lam gla ma mchod pa'i cho ga'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs phul/ brag g.yab rin po che phyir 'khor gdong kho tho'i zhu yig gi bka' lan du/ gus pa sku so'i skye bo tha mal par song gshis/ skye 'chi la rang dbang bral yang / ring 'tsho'i thog bgo skal gyi sri zhu ji bzhin 'grub pa'i gsol 'debs zhu mus ltar/ mgon po thugs rje'i gter chen khyed nas kyang de don ltar skyabs 'jug zhar yang 'dor ba med pa zhes sogs 'khod pa zhig bstsal/ de nas phyi zla gsum pa'i tshes bdun nyin wā ra khā+e si nas me 'kho ra thog pa ṭan ko ṭa dang / de nas bod gzhung gi phebs bsu'i mo ṭar thog cob ra ha'o sir zhabs 'khod/ phyi tshes dgu nyin kho tho'i sar phebs te/ zla shas wā ra khā+e sir bzhugs ring sku khams 'phrod bzhes sku/gas kyi gnas tshul rnams bka' bstsal/ phyi zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu nyin bod rang dbang sger langs kyis rgya mir ngo rgol gyi las 'gul byas nas so/ gsum 'kho ra ba'i dran ga16) dus chen skabs kho bo cag dang lhan du phebs te thugs smon bskyangs/ ṇ+ḍi zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu bdun nyin chol gsum bod mi spyi mgrin nas kho bor bla mchod tshogs 'khror dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs bstar 'bul skabs tshogs dbur phebs/ phyi zla bzhi pa'i tshes nyer bzhi nas bzung nyin bcu gsum

150 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul ldo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa gyi ring brag g.yab rin po che dang / gling yid dga' sprul sku gnyis la mdzad brel dang bstun dag yig ngag sgron gyi bka' khrid gang 'gro zhig bstsal te/ mjug skyong drug cu re bzhi sku ra mdzad/ ṇ+ḍi zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin brgyad gtor dus chen 'khel bar kho bor mjal dar bstsal zhing / de nyin dgong dro'i chu tshod lnga dang phyed bar don dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid kyi ngang du 'byams/ phyi zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin gser kong mtshan zhabs rin sngo/ che dbu bzhugs kyis gzhung zhabs spyi nas sku ngas 'dzin rin po cher brtan bzhugs phul/ gzhan yang 'di dag gi skabs nas bzung 'o/ re bzhin dgon khag bla sprul/bod mi lam bgan ba/ dang blangs dmag mi sogs skya ser ches mang po zhig nas yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang chen 14ra brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul lam zhus pa sogs 'ga' zhig tsam las re re bzhin 'dir 'god pa'i ngal ba ma bsten zhing / dgon sde khag nas phul ba'i rten dod mjal dar tsam las 'bul dngos gtan nas ma bzhes/ ṇ+ḍi zla lnga pa'i tshes nyer lngar sgang tog khul gnas sdod btsan byol bod mi'i spyi 'thus nas rgyu sbyar te kho bor brtan bzhugs bstar 'bul skabs rdo rje 'chang chen pos chog grwa'i dbu bzhugs rdo rje slob dpon mdzad/ phyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer lnga nyin dge tshul nga gcig la bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa bstsal/ phyi zla dgu pa'i tshes gsum nas bzung nyin bstud de kho bor rje bdag nyid chen pos mdzad pa'i sngags rim chen mo'i bshad lung mdzub khrid kyi tshul du dgyes bstsal skal bzang chodab/ 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs dad pa'i chu gter 'phel ba'i zla ba zhes bya ba ljags rtsom mdzad de phyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin gangs skyid khri byang bla brang du phebs thog 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs kyi phyag dpe dang / rten dod mjal dar dang sbrags/ sku tshe yun du brtan pa'i thugs bzhed dgos tshul zhu gnang mdzad cing / khri byang rin po che nas kyang 'khrungs rabs ga14la 'debs kyi ljags lung gsan/ 'khrungs rabs kyi gras su bla ma dri ma med pa bkod pa'i khungs ni/

ma su ri nas dz+nya sar hro shugs gnang rjes kyi mdzad pa 'i sle+or/ 151stag phu rin po cher gzigs snang de ltar byung tshul skyong blar bka' bstsal/ de'i rjes gdan sa'i dge bshes bcu drug nas khyi zla bcu pa'i tshes nyer drug nas bzung nyin drug gi ring sngags kyi rtsod rgyugs phul bar rdo rje 'chang chen po yang kho bo cag dang lhan du rtsod pa'i dpang por phebs/ sbag sa nang bstan shes rig 'dzin skyong slob gnyer khang thos bsam thar 'dod gling gi mkhan po brgyad nas de sku dbyar zhal bzhes grol ba'i ljongs rgyu'i mjal kha dang sbrags rnam grwa snu/gas yongs dang lhan du phyi zla bcu pa'i tshes sum cu nyin kho bor bla mchod tshogs 'khor dang 'brel brtan bzhugs bstar 'bul skabs rdo rje 'chang chen po cho ga'i dbu bzhugs su phebs/ 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che dang / gong gsal mkhan po brgyad/ rtsod rgyugs 'bul mkhan dge bshes bcu drug dha sar gtan bzhugs bla sprul dge bshes/ rnam grwa 〉rgags yongs bcas nas kho bo cag dang lhan du pho brang gi gzim chung du zab lam bla ma23da dang 'brel 'bum tshogs grangs gsog bgyisapar yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang yang gdan zhus ltar phebs te rgyal bstan chab srid kyi ched du sras bcas 7rgyal bar thugs rje bskul bar mdzad/ phyi zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gcig nyin kho bos ngag bkod ltar gnas chung sku rten dang / dga' gdong sku rten gnyis kyi lus bcang byed rgyur 'phrin las rgyal po gtso bor byas pa'i sku lnga'i srog 'khor dang / yon tan rgyal po gtso bor byas pa'i sku ga 'khor gsar bris la khri byang rin po che dang lhan du 'khor 'o'i sgrub chog mdzad de bstsal/ yang de nyin lnga mchod kyi dus chen 'khel bar brten kho bo dang / rnam grwa gsung zhabs bcas nas bla mchod tshogs 'bul dang / gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ dus 'khor bcas kyi smon lam shis brjod dang bcas par ldan du phebs/ yang saṃ skrita'i slob grwar yod pa'i bod rigs bla sprul dge bshes sku/gas tshang mas gus bsu dang bcas chig stong dgu brgya drug cu re gsum zla ba dang po'i tshes bdun nyin wā ṇar phebs/ tshes bcu nyin chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis ba'engs pa'i mchod rten rin po che'i mdun stong ma chod

151 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul sdo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa rgyas pa zhig dang / gzhan yang de phyogs kyi gnas rten rnams kyi mdun ched phebs kyis thugs smon bskyangs/ nyin gcig khri byang rin po che nas gdan zhu gnang ste mchod rten rin po che'i mdun stong mchod chosags 'bul du phebs/ 'bras go bo dge bshes mkhyen rab bzod pa nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ tshes nyer lnga nyin dpa' gcig gi dbang gi sta gon dang / phyi nyin dngos gzhi/ mjug tu tshe dbang bcas bstsal/ de nas rdo rje gdan dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling grwa tshang nas gdan zhus ltar/ phyi zla gnyis pa'i tshes gsum nyin rdor gdan du phebs te dgon pa'i yang steng du bzhugs/ tshes drug nyin de ga'i dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur dang / mchod rten chen snumare mdun stong mchod bcas 'bul gnang mdzad/ a she'i dbyangs skyid dang / phag ri gser khang nang mi bcas kyis gsol ba btab pa ltar/ tshes dgu nas bzung nyin gsum gyi ring skya ser mi mang bzhi brgya skor la mchod rten chen mo'i mdun sems bskyed kyi sdom pa 'bog chog thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang gi sta gon dang / dngos gzhi bcas rim bzhin bstsal zhing / de mjug phyi tshes nyer gcig nyin sbyin bdag rnams dang bod gzhung chos don lhan khang bcas nas brtan bzhugs phul/ phyi zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum nyin de gar spyodan tshogs la bsnyen bkur/ stong tshogs bcas 'bul gnang dang 'brel tshogs dbur phebs/ phyi nyin sā nur phyir phebs kyis chab masnga rgya ra sprul sku nas gasku/la ba btab pa ltar/ tshes bcu nyin chos zhu ba sum cu skor la bla ma mabon po dbyer med kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ nyin bzhi'i rjes sā ra nā tha nas r+ha sar phyir phebs mdzad rjes phran la bstan 'gro'i snga na bzang mdzad tshul gyi gnas tshul rnams dngos su bka' ba༄sgrub/ phyi zla bzhi pa'i tshes bzhi nyin la dwags byang thang khul gnas sdod btsan byol bod mi ser skya spyi nas rgyu yon sbyar te rnam grwa tshogs yongs dang / dz+nya sar gtan sdod bla sprul dge bshes bcas nas phran ring 'tsho'i cho ga spel bar khri byang rin po che dang lhan du phebs te thugs smon bka' drin bskyangs/ nyin gnyis kyi

ma su ri nas d+dha sar spo shugs gnang rjes kyi mdzad pa'i slor/ 153rjes kho bo dang / rnam grwa chodags yongs bcas nas dgong dro'i chu tshod gnyis pa nas chu tshod brgyad pa bar spyi sgos bstan pa srung bar dam bcas pa'i mthu ldan dam can rgya mtshor gzab gsol bskang 'phrin bgyis skabs sku ngas 'dzin rnam pa gnyis ka ched phebs kyis thugs smon bskyangs/ shag lha ra mkhan rin po che rgan nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang / brag g.yab rin po che thun mong nas zhus ngor/ lung rigs smra ba du mar tshes dgu nas bzung tshes nyi shu bar 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba'i bshad lung bstsal zhing / nang srid dang / chos don las khrungs bcas nas kyang chos zhu ba rnams la bsnyen bkur gsol ja sku 'gyed bcas phul/tshes nyer dgu nas bzung nyin bdun gyi ring don gnyer ba mang 'dus la 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams khrid/ phyi zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin/ gling yid dga' sprul skus zhus sngo ra/ khong dang shag skor mkhan rin po che/ brag g.yab rin po che gsum la sku lnga'i srog gtad kyi bka' dbang bstsal/ de'i phyi nyin nas bzung nyin gnyis ring kho bo dang lhan du rnam grwa'i dus 'khor sgrub mchod kyi tshogs mgon du phebs/tshes bcu bdun nyin dha sa'i bu gasku khang 'go tshugs nas lo gsum 'khor ba'i dran gso'i dus chen nyin bu gso khang du gdan zhus ltar/ kho bo dang / khri byang rin po che bcas dang lhan du gsol tshigs gnang / tshes sum cu nas/ phyi zla drug pa'i tshes nyer bdun bar kho bor las brel dang bstun 'dul ba mdo maba'i bshad lung dang / them skas bco brgyad kyi ljags lung / mdo sdud pa/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ 'grel pa don gsal bcas sbrags pa'i bshad khrid zab rgyas bka' drin bskyangs/ phyi zla drug pa'i tshes bdun gyi dgong dro 'phan po nā len+d+ra gzim 'og rin po che byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin mchog nyid dag pa mkha' spyod du gshegs nga ra/ kho bo cag dang lhan du bla mchod kyi tshogs 'khor dang /bzang spyod bcas gsungs te dam pa de nyid kyi bstan 'gro'i don chen thugs bzhed ltar 'grub pa'i sasku la 'debs nan tan gnang / srid tshab zur pa bde mkhar ba nas zhus ngor

pa'i rtsa tshig gi steng nas bka' khrid bstsal/ gdan sa'i slob gnyer ba bco brgyad nas dge bshes ce da rgyugs 'bul bzhes skabs phyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes bzhi nyin kho bo cag dang lhan du phebs te legs nyes kyi shan 'byed par mdzad/ 'di'i skabs shig la kho bor rje'i drang nges legs bshad snying po dang / mkhas grub rje'i gsung stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed bcas kyi bshad lung bka' drin bskyangs/ phyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga'i snga dro chu tshod bzhi pa'i thog kho thod cag dge tshul slong go bdun nas dbyar snga ma zhal bzhes mdzad cing / gnas dga'i bka' lung du dbyar zla gsum ring nya stong brgyad gsum nam shar dang / dgu pa lha babs dus chen bcas par dbyar gnas pa'i dbe 'dun pa rnams nas lha ldan jo shāg rnam gnyis dang / 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po rang byung lnga ldan gyis mtshon rten mchog rnams la mi dang mi min 'byung sngotsware gcadad 'tshe nyen bzlog ched rab gnas rta thog ma dang / rgyang mchod gnad smin 'bul dgos phebs pa ltar/ 'di nyin chos don khang nas mchod sprin 'bul bshams thog kho bo dang yongs 'aci(na gling rin po che nas dge 'dun rnams dang lhan du 'jigs byed kyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas sras bcas 7rgyal ba rnams la spyan 'dren khrus gasku/la/ rab gnas rta thog ma/ 'phags bstod/ rten 'brel bstod pa/ sgrol bstod/ bden tshig spyodan lam bcas zhal 'don rnams snga dro chu tshod dgu nas bcu gnyis bar gsungs/ tshes bcu dgu nyin dbu btsugs te bar seng dang stabs bstun brag g.yab rin po cher gsang 'dus bdag bskyed kyi steng nas dmigs rim ji ltar bya tshul gyi bka' khrid nyin shas bskyangs shing / de'i ṇ+ḍi lor mjug bsgril bskyangs/phyi tshes nyer gcig nyin/ kho bos rnam grwa tshogs yongs dang lhan du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen wa'i slo nas bsil ldan gangs kyi rwa bas bskor bo'i ljongs su gdul bya'i bsod nams kyilden du bzhugs pa'i rten mchog rnams la rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga dge legs rgya

ma su ri nas dha sar sgo shugs gnang rjes kyi mdzad pa'i skor/ 155mtsho'i char 'bebs bgyis par yongs 'dzin rin po che gdan zhus ltar phebs/ tshes nyer brgyad nyin gnas dga'i lung don ltar/ bla sprul dge bshes rnam grwa gsung zhabs bcas nas bla mchod snu gas 'khor dang 'brel kho thodar mkha' 'gro bsu bzlog gi brtan bzhugs bgyis par yongs 'dzin rin po che nas rdor slob gnang ste rdzas brgyad kyi mthun 'gyur bskyangs/ phri zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin yongs 'dzin rin po che dang / kho bo cag sogs r+ha sar bzhugs pa'i chos byed dge 'dun tshang mas lho bi kri nam du 'khod pa'i ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyi bden don ji bzhin 'grub pa'i ched ma6)ga gsum rgyal ba rgya mtshor gsol 'debs shugs drag tu bgyis/ phyi zla bcu pa'i tshes bdun nas bzung nyin nyi shu'i ring kho bor bstan bcos chen po dbu ma la 'jug pa dang / rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal sbrags te bshad khrid bstsal pa'i skal bzang dga' lha na la rol/ phyi zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu drug nyin dbu 'dzugs kyis brag g.yab rin po ches zhus ngor/ gser kong mtshan zhabs rin po che sogs nyung shas shig la drang nges legs bshad snying wa'i bshad khrid gnang /chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sar 'byung ba'i gnod 'tshe bzlog ched klu chog dang 'brel ba'i klu bum sba chog dang / klu gtor zab nan dgos lugs gnas dga' gnyis nas lung bskul byung don ltar/ dbyar gnas ring klu thebs nam yod la klu gtor klu bsangs bcas rgyun du sgrub spos steng tshes nyer gnyis nas bzung nyin lnga'i ring bzang drug sogs klu rdzas 'dzoms pa'i bum sgrub kyi cho ga kho bo cag nas bgyis par yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis kyang rtag phebs kyis thugs smon bskyangs/ gnas chung gi lung don ltar/ bod mi'i sdod sgar khag nas zhal 'debs phul 'byor steng gzhung nas mthun rkyen sbyar te/ kho bo dang / ris med chos lugs khag gi bla ma mkhan po sogs dge 'dun brgya phrag brgal ba dang / las khungs khag gi las byed pa res 'khor bcas nas bla mchod dang 'brel ba'i tshogs 'bum/bsam lhun/ bar chad lam sel/ 'phags bstod/ bden tshis smon lam bcas nyin

156 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul ldo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa bcu gcig ring grangs gsog bgyis skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che tshogs su phebs te spyi sgos bstan 'gro'i dge mtshan bla mthor spel bar mdzad/ ṇ+ḍi zla bcu pa'i tshes drug dang / bdun so sor ḍi ra dun bod rigs dmag don slob sbyong ba rnams dang / a mdo spyi nas rgyu sbyar te phran ring 'tsho'i cho ga bgyis skabs rdo rje 'chang nas rdor slob mdzad/ phyi zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes dgu nyin sa dge bka' rnying bon bcas bod kyi ris med chos lugs khag gi chos tshogs tshugs skabs 'khon rigs bstan pa'i gsal byed sa skya bdag khri rin po che dang / bdud 'joms rin po che sogs tshogs mi ngo grangs lnga bcu nga bdun dang lhan du phebs te gral la 'khod mtshams rnam grwa gsung zhabs dang bcas pas zhabs brtan smon tshig sogs zhal 'asngo na gyi rim pa rnams gsungs/ de rjes kho bos chos lugs phan tshun bar mthun sgril dam zab dgos lugs stodar cadab ston bgyis skabs dgyes bzhin du gsan/phyi nyin bdag khri rin po che sogs bla sprul bcu gnyis nas gsung bshad gnang skabs yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang nas bstan 'gro'i dge mtshan gyi dpal du smin nges kyi dgongs 'char bstsal/ tshes bcu gcig gi snga sngo ra phran sar phebs te chodas kyi bka' slob bstsal zhing /nyin gung sa skya bdag khri rin po che dang / /rma pa rin po che/ bdud 'joms rin po che/bde chen chos mgon rin sngo che/ sku ngas 'dzin rnam gnyis/ kho bo bcas gasku la tshigs lhan du 'bul bzhes sar bod kyi chos lugs 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi skor la dgongs 'char lhug par grol/ de rjes /rma rin po che cob ra ha'o sir yongs 'dzin rin po che'i mjal dgung grangs re gsum la dga' ldan khri thog go bdun pa'i mtshan khur bzhes te 167zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig nyin chos don bka' chodan las rogs dam pa blo gros nas gsol ba btab pa ltar mo ṭi ma ho'i thang steng du dz+nya sa'i ser skya mi mang rnams la snga dro theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom pa bstsal/ phyi zla dgu pa'i tshes gnyis nyin dge rgan 'os sbyong skabs gnyis pa'i slob grwar gdan zhus ltar dge slob tshor blang dor byed sgo'i skor bka' slob snying po can bstsal/ tshes bcu gsum nyin ring nas bsten pa'i srung ma'i gatho bo gnas dga' gnyis rten gzhir spyan drangs te 'char can sku phywa'i zhabs rim sogs kyi skor bka' 'dri bskyangs/ gsang 'dus kyi ljags bsnyen nyin bcu grangs tsam las phal cher grub nye'i skabs lo der pa ki si than dang rgya gar gnyis dbar dmag 'khrug langs te pa ki si than gyis gnam thog nas d+dha shod yol dmag sgar nye 'gram du 'bom mdel 'phangs te mi gnyis la srog skyon dang / 'ga' shas la rmas skyon byung ba sogs gnas tshul dza drag tu gyur stabs rgya gar gzhung nas ngos re zhig nyen g.yol ched rda sa nas rgyal sa ldi li gsar par gnas spos bya dgos tshul gsungs par yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis kyang lhan du gdan 'dren zhus/gnas chung nas kyang 7skyabs rje rnam gnyis la chos rgyal chen wa'i phyag shan de 'bul gnang mdzad/ yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis ldi li bod khang du bzhugs yul gra sgrig zhus pa ltar bzhugs/ yul gru gnyis kyi dbar dmag 'khrug nyen tshab je cher song tshe skye bo mang por srog skyon 'gro nyer brten thugs khral ci che byung mod/ ldi lir phebs rjes nyin shas song ba na dmag 'khrug re zhig mtshams 'jog byas tshul gsan par thugs bag phebs pa'i dgyes tshul bzhes/ 7skyabs rje rnam pa gnyis ka bod khang du bzhugs par brten yang yang mjal 'phrad kyis nyin gcig rnam gnyis lhan bzhugs skabs khri byang rin po ches/legs smon pad dkar 'dab ma khri phrag tu bzhad kyang / /don med rang gar 'phyan pa'i gzhan dbang be+e ba mos/ /

168 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa blu+ong chub snying gro'i sbrang rtsi'i bcud bzang de bcom pas/ /rmongs rgan gnyis med seṅge'i zhu don 'dir dgongs shig /sdib dbang bstun pa'i snying po blo bzang gi zhal lū+ong / /dri med tshul bzhin t+t+wo+oṃgs nas /ma mang gi gdul byar/ /rgyu+ol ba'i lam mchog 'asnga mas pa'i 'ayinan bzang gi rgyang glu/ /bskal pa'i mtha' ༷sa 'das par lhang lhang du sgrogs mdzod/ /rgol bas mi sdi+ob rjes bstun sding rigs kyi lam nas/ /'phags bzhi'i mngon hū+o+oṃgs gsal ba'i /ma thar gyi bto/da pa/ /rgyul kun ngo mtshar rdzogs pa'i mdzad 'asdi+on gyi 'od dkar/ /cis mthun na/na pa 0/sa rgyal lam lam du spros shig /zhes mgur du bzhes te/ yongs 'dzin khri chen rdo rje 'chang chen po mchog sku tshe brtan cing / zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo yun ring du bskor ba'i gsol 'debs mdzad/de rjes mdzod pa blo bzang lung rigs la/nyo+o gros mdzangs la dkyil che'i grogs po khyed gson dang / /nor bsdung gachodan nu'i rnam thar da spos bzhin bzung nas/ /mi phyed dad pa'i a lū+ong snying dbus su bcangs na/ /rdi+ogs gsum thugs rje'i lcags kyus 'dor med du los 'dzin/ /blo sems rtse gcig bsgril nas drin can gyi bla ma/ /brnyim sbyor badz+wong pos ngal med tshul bzhin du bsten dang / /la lū+ong gzhan 'tshol ma dgos yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ /rang gi lag tu mchis so rdi+ogs bzang gi skyes bu/ /

dgung grangs re gsum la dga' ldan khri cadag bo bdun pa'i mtshan khur bzhes te 169zhes rdo rje 'chang chen 46) zhabs zhu da spos bzhin tshul bzhin du sgrub pa gal che bar gdams/ ldi lir bzhugs ring bod khang du 'byor ba'i zhal thang dang / rten rnying gang 'tshams mo da pa nas sngor ma 'a'o/da pa rnams spyan bstar zhus par/ 'di dang 'di zhes ngo spyod bka' stsodab bstsal/ nyin gcig la dgas bla ma blo bzang nas gdan zhus ltar/ khri byang rin po che dang lhan du la dwags nang pa'i gtsug lag khang du phebs bskyod kyis rten dang brten pa bcas par rab gnas dang / de rjes la dgas cadab phrug tshos yul lugs kyi bro dang / glu gzhas kyi gzigs mo phul bar dgyes gzigs mdzad/ yang skabs der pha bong kha'i sprul sku nas gsol ba btab pa ltar rtsodan gnyer can mang 'dzoms la tshes bcu gsum nas nyin bco lnga'i ring sngags rim chen mo'i bshad khrid bstsal/ phri zla bcu pa'i tshes nyer lnga nyin bod khang gi sgo dbye rten 'brel mdzad sgo'i skabs kho bo cag dang lhan du shis brjod sogs gnang / phyi zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nyin/ gnas macesag sā ra nā thar phebs thon gnang / tshes brgyad nyin dge sbyin pa rgya mtsho nas gsol ba btab pa ltar ser skya brgya phrag du mar lam gathorware bka' khrid dang / de'i nyin rjes mar sog po bla mas gsol btab pa ltar sku na tan gzhi gyur ma'i bka' khrid bstsal zhing / tshes bcu gnyis nyin la dwags ri rdzong sprul sku nas zhus ngor gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyi bka' khrid dbu 'dzugs gnang / de nas gnas chen rdo rje gdan du chibs bsgyur gyis ṇ+ḍi tshes nyer lnga nyin rdor gdan bod dgon dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur dang 'brel mchod rten rin sngo che'i spyan sngar mchod sprin sna lnga stong tshar 'bul gshoms mdzad de ston pa bla na med pa de nyid kyis spel ba'i 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam bzang rgya mtsho'i bo sa can gyi khyon du brdal ba'i thugs spyodan bskyangs/ gong du gsal ba ltar la dgas ri rdzong rin po cher gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyi bka' 'khrid 'phro skyong gnang / tshes nyer drug nyi bo bo rdor gdan bod dgon dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling du 'aX ra 'phral yongs 'dzin khri rin po che nas dathodan pa'i maṇ+ḍal rten

sgrig gnang ba bod kyi ches mtho'i gtsug lag rig gzhung slob gnyeng khang gi slob tshan rgya gzhung khag la zhib dpyad gnang ba'i gnas ༷/gas ba37pa/ tshes so gcig nyin bstan srid spyi rim du dmigs te mchod rten chen mo'i drung du gzhung nas rdo nga mchod rgyas pa phul skabs khe bo cag dang lhan du thugs dmigs bskyangs/phyi lo 1966 zla 1 tshes 15 nyin gnas mchog der ser skya du mar rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang / phyi nyin khu nu dang / la dwags pa brgyad la dge tshul dang /de rjes dge tshul bco lnga la dge slong gi sdom pa bstsal/ phyi zla gnyis pa'i tshes lnga nyin rnam grwa mchod g.yog nas zhus ngor/ mi mang khyon cher theg chen gasku sbyong gi khyodam pa bstsal/tshes bcu drug nyin rdor gdan nas dz+nya sar phebs 'drodar skabs yar lam khri byang rin po che mjal 'phrad du phebs/ phri nyin phran sar phebs te rdor gdan du bzhugs ring bstan 'gro'i don chen mdzad pa'i gnas tshul rnams gsungs/ de rjes nyin gcig khri byang rin po che gling bla brang du phebs te dngul gyi sgrol dkar sku brnyan zhig 'bul gnang dang 'brel yongs 'dzin khri rin po che zhabs pad yun brtan gyi thugs bzhed bskyed dgos pa'i gsol 'debs mdzad/ tshes nyer gnyis nyin nas bzung bdun gcig ring byes 'byor bod wā ra khā+e sir drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen khyad par can thodad zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi 'khel bar chos don lhan khang nas gsol bo gcig pa'i dbang chen sta gon dang bcas pa bstsal/ yang phyi zla dang wa'i tshes gcig nyin gong gsal rnams la sgrol dkar gyi tshe dbang bstsal/ 'di'i skabs shig la kho thodar sngags rim chen mo'i bshad pa mdzub 'khrid lta bu lhod lhod kyis bstsal te bka' drin bla na med pa thob/ phyi zla bdun pa'i tshes drug nyin kho wa'i skyes skar dus chen 'khel bar mdzad sgor ched phebs kyis rten 'byung mjal dar bstsal/ tshes bcu gcig nyin lha sa ba pad+ma bde chen sogs la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i rnal 'byor ji ltar nyams su len tshul gyi bka' khrid bstsal/ phyi zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer bzhi nas bzung kho bor las brel de tsam med pa'i skabs dang bstun gsang 'dus 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi bka' khrid zhus bstsal skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che'i gsung bshad gzhan dang mi 'dra ba dang / lhag par du gleng gzhi'i yi ge bzhi bcu'i 'grel bshad de grub pa'i mtshams su spyir gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud la dad pa dang / yang lha sa dpal ldan zla ba grags pa de dngos gnas mkhas grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa
