gser zangs kyi gu ru snang srid zil gnon gyi sku brnyan bcas la phyi zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin gzungs 'bul zhu rgyur snga dro'i chu tshod dgu par kho bo cag dang lhan du phebs te gzungs sgrub gnang / dgun thog ring rdor gdan du bzhugs rgyur chu tshod gnyis par pho brang nas phebs thon gnang ste tshes bcu gnyis nyin rdor gdan bod dbo/na du zhabs sor 'khod/ sog po bla mas gsol ba btab pa ltar gser kong mtshan zhabs rin po che sogs bla sprul dge bshes ser skya mi grangs brgyad brgya skor 'dus pa la tshes bcu bdun nyin byang chub lam rim chen 66) bshad khrid dbu 'dzugs gnang / lam rim chen mo'i dbu nas snyan pa'i grags pa kun tu byas so zhes gro lung pa chen pos gsung sngo zhes pa'i bar thugs thog nas tshar gsum gsungs rjes gser kong rin po ches yar thengs gcig thugs thog nas skyor gnang dang / de rjes dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /ces sogs kyi tshigs bcad drangs par mdzad de sngon 'bo'i chodas bshad shin tu rgyas pa zhig gnang ba bcas bshad lung dasngo sa gzhi dbu 'dzugs mdzad/ phyi nyin nas bzung snga dro dang phyi dro gsung chos chos thun gnyis re bstsal zhing / bdun re'i thog chos mtshams re 'jo ga gnang mdzad/ tshes nyi shu nyin blo gling grwa tshang dang / phyi zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin dga' ldan bla spyi/ de'i nyin phyi mar cha phreng chodas mdzad bcas nas 'dus tshogs su bsnyen bkur dang 'brel brtan bzhugs bstar 'bul zhus/ yang dge slong zhig nas zhus ngor lam rim gsung chos kyi

sus si dang / 'jar ma ni/ dbyin yul/ pha ran si bcas par phebs te 'gro don 197zhor la dwags po blo bzang sbyin pa'i gsung lam rim shar sgom gyi ljags lung zhig kyang bstsal/ cha phreng blo bzang rgyal mtshan nas gasku la ba btab pa ltar/ chig rdo nga dgu brgya bdun cu zla ba dang wa'i tshes bdun gyi zhogs pa lag ris gsal min tsam la rdor gdan grwa tshang 'du khang du chos zhu ba tshang 'dzoms sar theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom pa bstsal/ phyi nyin kho bos ngag bkod ltar sku sger yig tshang nas yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang chen por brtan bzhugs phul bar dgyes bzhes bka' drin bskyangs/ tshes bcu nyin lam rim gsung chos grub ste sems bskyed mchodad pa mdzad/ tshes bcu gcig nyin lam rim sbyin bdag nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ mi grangs chig stong skor la sgrol dkar tshe dbang dang / tsha ba rong pa a chen nas zhus sngo ra/ spyan ras gzigs ngan song kun grol gyi rjes gnang / de'i phyi nyin bsgrub bya brgyad la dge tshul gyi sdom pa/ tshes nyer bdun nyin mon rta dbang mkhan 'dzin ri rgya sprul sku ngo 'khor rnams la drag po gsum bsgril gyi rjes gnang dang tshe dbang bcas ba3por/1970 phyi zla gnyis pa'i tshes bdun nyin/ bod lcags khyi zla ba dang ngo'i tshes gcig 'khel bar dgung gsar rten 'brel skabs 7skyabs rje mchog rdor gdan bod dgon gyi tshogs mgon du gdan zhus kyis gsol ja bzhes 'bras sogs rim phul rjes bla brang dang /mang thos sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa khu nu bla ma rin po che bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan mchodag grwa tshang 'dus mang bcas nas rten gsum mjal dar 'bul lam zhus rjes der yod bod mi gnas skor ba sku gas ser skya sku ngas rdzogs nas mjal khra zhus/ tshes drug nas bzung smon lam ring skyes rabs so bzhi'i gsung chos gnang rgyu dang /skam tshogs su phebs rgyu sogs 'char can ltar gnang / tshes nyer drug nyin rdor gdan grwa tshang dang / gling bla brang thun mong nas brtan bzhugs phul/ tshes nyer gcig la pha ran si'i ma rgan i wa la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bstsal/ phyi zla gsum pa'i tshes drug nyin rdor

198 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pri gdan nas phebs thon gyi r+ha sar phebs 'byor skabs yar lam gangs can skyid gshongs su khri byang rin po che dang mjal 'phrad zhu gnang thog lo gsar rten 'byung gi mjal dar 'bul res dang / bar skabs kyi gsar byung gnas tshul gyi skor la phan tshun bka' mo la zhib par mdzad/ tshes dgu nyin chu tshod gnyis par kho tho'i sar ched phebs kyis bar lam rdo gdan du lam rim chen mo 'chad spel gnang tshul sogs kyi gnas lugs dang 'brel gnam lo gsar tshes kyi rten 'byung mjal dar rten dod bcas bstsal/ nyin brgyad kyi rjes don gnyer can so bzhi la dge tshul gyi sdom pa dang / btsun ma dgu la dge tshul gyi sdom pa/ gdan sa'i grwa grangs lnga bcu nga gnyis la dge slong gi sdom pa bcas rim bzhin bstsal/theg chen chos gling du kho bos dus 'khor dbang chen bgyis pa'i mjug tshes nyer lnga nyin/tshong thub bstan dang / a mdo sbyin pa rgya mtsho bcas kyis zhus ngor chos zhu ba rnams la spyan ras gzigs ngan song kun grol gyi rjes gnang bstsal/ sgang tog khul sdod bod rigs snu la gsum mi mang spyi nas kho thodar brtan bzhugs phul skabs chortags mgon du gdan zhus ltar rdor slob mdzad/ de'i phyi nyin gong gsal mi mang gi 'thus mi rnams bla brang du bcar te bstan 'gro'i don du sku tshe zhabs pad yun du brtan pa'i gsol 'debs zhus par de don bzhin mchog gsum la gsol 'debs gnang 'thus zhes phebs/ tshes bcu bdun nyin don gnyer can bco brgyad la dge tshul gyi sdom pa bstsal/ tshes nyer gnyis nyin rgyud stod phyag zur sogs nas smyung gnas lha khang du khri byang rin po che dang lhan du gdan zhus kyis brtan bzhugs phul ba dgyes bzhes gnang / yang lha khang de rang du chab mdo kun rdor sprul sku nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ ṇ+ḍi zla lnga pa'i tshes gcig nyin bdag bskyed 'don rgyu'i khas len can ser skya sum brgya brgyad cu skor la 'jigs byed dpa' gcig gi dbang chen gyi sta gon dang / phyi nyin dngos gzhi bcas bstsal/ tshes bdun nyin lha sar gnas 'khod chol gsum mi mang spyi 'thus rnams ched bcar gyis kho tho'i ched du tshe sgrub skyabs 'jug

sus si dang / 'jar ma ni/ dbyin yul/ pha ran si bcas par phebs te 'gro don 199snyan seng zhagu par dgyes mnyes chen pos zhal bzhes gnang / phyi tshes nyer gcig nyin sa zla'i tshes bco lnga 'khel bar mi chung ri'i btsun ma 'ga' zhig nas gasku la ba btab pa ltar smyung gnas lha khang du ser skya lnga brgya skor la theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom pa bstsal/ phyi zla lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga nas bzung kho bor bde mchog margyud dang / sbas don kun gsal sbrags pa'i bshad khrid bka' drin bskyangs te tshes nyer lnga nyin legs par grub/ 'di skabs chos zhur gser kong rin po che dang / rnam grwa mkhan po/ bla ti rin po che/ dge bshes rab brtan bcas yod/ yang skabs re yongs 'dzin rin po ches tshur yang dogs gcod dri ba 'dra mdzad/ rnam grwa mkhan po ni thad ka thad gar dogs gcod dang / dri ba zhu thub mkhan zhig yin pas/ yongs 'dzin rin po che ni da lta grwa sa 'grims bzhin pa lta bu'i rtags gsal gtong gnang mdzad par ha las pa'i ngo mtshar chen po skyes byung zhes gsungs/de rjes tshes bcu gcig nyin gangs can skyid gshongs su dpe mdzod khang gsar bskrun bya rgyur sa 'du'/ lta bur lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pas rgyud bsdams pa'i dge 'dun rnams tshogs pa'i mdun sar kho bos sku/ thar gyi mdo bsgrags pa dang 'brel bkra shis gso rjodang bgyis skabs gdan zhus ltar phebs/ phyi zla bdun pa'i tshes bzhi nyin dgas po baṃ chos sprul sku pha ran sir phyir phebs gnang khar mjal bcar gyi sku tshe yun du brtan pa'i gasku/la 'debs skyabs bskul zhus/ phyi nyin gnas dga' gnyis rten gzhir spyan drangs te lung zhu mdzad/ de'i nyin rjes mar kho bo bgrang bya so drug tu slebs pa'i skyes skar 'khel bar rnam kun ltar chu tshod bcu gcig thog mjal dar bstsal zhing / de rjes rdo rje 'chang chen po mchog dang / skyabs rje khri byang rin po che/ a ma lags/ kho bo bcas dang lhan du nyin gung gi gsol tshigs phul ba dgyes bzhin bzhes/ phyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes dus nyin dge tshul dgu dang / dge bsnyen gcig la bslab sdom bstsal/ rgyud sde gnyis pa spyod rgyud kyi gtso bo rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang rgyun shin tu dkon gshis/ las rung zhig

200 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa gnang ste bka' dbang yang gnang grub pa zhes nan tan gyis zhus 1rar/ gsung zhabs chab mdo dge bshes dge legs blo bzang dang lhan du yi dam de nyid kyi las rung dbu 'dzugs gnang ba phyi zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin grub ste kha skong gi sbyin sreg mdzad/ lha sar rgyud grwa stod smad kyi dge 'dun bsnyen mtshams la zhugs mkhan bzhi dang / bla kau rin po che bcas la tshes bcu dgu nas bzung 'jigs byed bsnyen chen gyi bka' khrid bstsal/ phyi zla bcu pa'i tshes lnga nyin tshu tshod bcu gnyis dang phyed shar gdan zhus ltar kho bos chos kyi bka' slob dogs gcod 'ga' zhig zhus par chob ngags yongs su sel ba'i gsung lan bstsal/bar zhi phun tshogs dbang rgyal sogs nas zhus sngorar gzim chung du tshes bcu bzhi nyin cadal dkar gyi tshe dbang / tshes nyer bdun nyin a mdo 'jigs me da kyi 'dod mos ltar drag po gsum bsgril gyi rjes gnang bstsal te 'dod chodas kyi re ba bskong bar mdzad/ yang nyin gcig rang gzhung nang srid bka' blon ched bcar gyis kho wa'i ched du tshe sgrub gnang skyong yod pa zhes snyan seng zhus/ phyi zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes dgu nyin kho bor theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang gi dbu rtser sta gon dang / phyi nyin dngos gzhi dang bcas rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang chen bstsal zhing / dgong dro chu tshod lnga par gsung chos grub rjes kho bo dang lhan du zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi gsung mol lhag por bka' drin bskyangs/ de'i skabs dbang gral du 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che dang / rnam grwa mkhan slob/ grwa shings rgan gras lnga bcu skor yod/ tshes bcu bdun nas bzung kho tho/ra 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams khrid sog po dpal ldan bzang po'i drung nas gsan rgyun sku/da pa de zhib par bstsal/ dgun thog ring rdor gdan du bzhugs rgyur tshes nyer bdun nyin dha sa nas phebs thon mdzad/ phyi zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes lnga nyin rdor gdan dathodan pa'i 'du khang du dge 'dun tshang 'dzoms la bla brang nas rgyu sbyar te 7skyabs rje khri byang rdo rje 'chang chen por bla mchodad tshogs 'khor dang 'brel brtan bzhugs phul te

sus si dang / 'jar ma ni/ dbyin yul/ pha ran si bcas pa ra phebs te 'gro don 201bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi mthun 'gyur sogs mdzad de zhabs pad yun du brtan rgyu'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ de'i phri nyin nas bzung nyin bcu gcig ring khri byang rin po che sku rkyang la rje'i gsung sngags rim chen mo'i bshad lung chos thun re 'bul gnang mdzad/ tshes bcu gnyis nyin bla brang nas mchodad rten rin sngo/ che'i mdun khyodang mchod rgyas pa 'bul bshams dang 'brel yid can spyi dang / lhag par 'das gasku na 'brel thogs rnams la 'phral yun kun tu dge ba'i mchog gsum bden bskul gyi smon tshig gi char chen phab/ de rjes nyin gcig la skyabs rje khri byang rin po che nas mchod rten chen mo'i drung stong mchod rgyas pa 'bul gnang skabs gdan zhus ltar tshogs mgon du phebs/ bskyar du las rung gnang rtsis kyis 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che'i mdun nas bod dgon bka' 'gyur lha khang du tshes bco lnga nyin 'jigs mdzad rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa'i sta gon dang / dbang chen/ nyin gnyis par 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bka' dbang bcas gsan/ rjes sku ra yi dam 'di gnyis kyi ljags bsnyen gnang skabs bla brgyud gsol 'debs su chodag ma'i gsan yul 7skyabs rje bde chen snying wa'i mtshan gyi mjug tu khri byang rin po che'i mtshan bstod gsol 'debs shig ljags rtsom mdzad de gsungs pa phyag bstar ma'i zin bris nang du gsal/ tshes bcu bdun nyin khri byang rin po che nas yongs 'dzin rin po che dgon pa'i 'du khang du gdan drangs te dge 'dun pa rnams dang lhan du bla mchod tshogs 'khor dang 'brel zhabs zung srid mthar brling ba'i gsol 'debs mdzad cing / rdzas brgyad kyi mthun 'gyur sogs rgyu sbyor ba skyabs rje khri byang rin po ches mdzad/ rdor gdan dge 'dun rnams la chos 'brel lta bur dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang / yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i bshad lung zhig stsol gnang yong ba zhes zhu bskul mdzad pa ltar/ tshes bco brgyad nyin khri byang rin po che nas 'du khang du de don gsung chos bstsal/ la dwags ba ku la rin sngo che nas ldi lir la dgas dha ram sa lar dga' ldan lnga mchod mdzad sgor sngon nas gdan zhus ltar/ tshes nyi shu gcis/ nyin

201 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sbrul sdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa rdor gdan nas phebs thon gyis ldi li bod khang du phebs bzhugs dang / tshes nyi shu lnga nyin la dwags dha ram sa lar lnga mchod mdzad sgor rje tsong kha pa chen wa'i mdzad rnam dang 'brel ba'i gsung bshad dang mchod 'bul skabs dbu bzhugs gnang / de'i phyi nyin rdor gdan du phyir phebs mdzad/ phyi sku 1971 zla 1 tshes 2 nyin 'bras ljongs chos rgyal mjal bcar gyi 'di sku keg thog 'khel bas tshe lhas don ldan yong ba'i thugs spyodan zhus/ bal yul du gnas sgyu da byams pa bzod pa nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ sngo na gnyer can ser skya sum brgya skor la tshes bdun nas bzung tshes nyi shu bar 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang dang /bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams khrid bcas rim bzhin bstsal/ tshes nyer gnyis nyin rbe hor tshong dpon rab brtan nas zhus ngor ser skya bdun brgya stodar la tshe dbang bstsal/ nyin gsum gyi rjes don gnyer can bco lnga la dge tshul gyi sdom pa 'bogs par mdzad/ phyi zla gnyis pa'i tshes drug nyin bcom ldan 'das kyis so/ drug dka' ba spyad pa'i gnas su thodad dgon nas gdan zhus ltar zhabs kyis bcags/ tshes bcu nyin don gnyer can sum brgya lha ra la theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom pa bstsal/ nyin gsum gyi rjes chab mdo rgya ra sprul sku nas zhus ngor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i bshad lung dang / tshes nyer drug nyin bod lcags phag gnam lo gsar tshes 'khel bar snga dro rdor gdan bod dbo na 'du khang du tshogs mgon la gdan zhus ltar/ bla brang / grwa tshang bcas nas gsol ja bzhes 'bras rten gsum bcas phul zin rjes de skabs rdor gdan du yod pa'i skya ser mang tshogs rnams mjal bcar la phyag dbang srung mdud bcas bstsal/ phyi zla gsum pa'i tshes bzhi nyin sngo ra gdan bod dgon dang / bla brang thun mong nas bla mchod tshogs 'khor dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs 'bul lam/ zhus shing / smon lam chortags phebs sogs kyang 'char can ltar mdzad/ tshes nyer lnga nyin rdor gdan nas phebs thon gyis tshes nyer bdun nyin d+dha sar phebs 'byor ltar/ yar

sus si dang / 'jar ma ni/ dbyin yul/ pha ran si bcas nga ra phebs te 'gro don 203lam 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che'i gzim shag tu phebs te phan tshun lo gsar gyi rten 'byung mjal dar 'bul res dang sbrags sku lhod bzhugs mdzad/ de'i phyi nyin kho tho'i sar ched du phebs te dgun thog ring bstan pa 'dzin skyong la sman pa'i mdzad 'phrin ji ltar bskyangs tshul skor gsung mol gnang / tshes bcu bzhi nyin kho the sa tshogs gsog ched 7skyabs rje mchog la lo gsum phyogs gsum ring zla rer tshes dgu/ bcu dgu/ nyer dgu bcas la gsol tshigs rgyas pa re 'bul rgyu'i gsol dod phul ba dgyes bzhes mdzad/ 'di 'o/ kho bo bgrang bya so bdun gyi keg thog tu slebs par brten dge ldan lugs bzang rig gzhung gces skyong tshogs pa nas rgyu sbyar te rnam grwa tshogs yongs nas grub rgyal lugs tshe dpag med kyi sgo nas sgrub pa nyin gsum bgyis rjes phyi tshes nyer brgyad nyin bla mchod tshogs 'khor dang 'brel bar grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe 6)ga chabs cig tu brtan bzhugs 'bul skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che dbu bzhugs thog maṇ+ḍal ljags bshad dang / rdzas brgyad mthun 'gyur sogs gser kong mtshan zhabs rin sngo ches gnang / yongs 'dzin khri byang rin tho/ che nas maṇ+ḍal rten gsum bstsal te zhal 'don gyi dbu tshugs pa sku/gas rten 'brel gyi la nye mchog tu bzang / dge ldan lugs bzang rig gzhung tshogs pa nas phyi zla lnga pa'i tshes gsum nyin 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin rin po che rnam gnyis lhan 'dzoms sar bla mchod tshogs 'khor dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs phul ba dgyes bzhes mdzad/ tshes bcu bdun nyin r+ha sa bu gso khang tshugs nas lo bcu gcig song ba'i dus dran dang / byis pa'i 'o 'thung gasku/ skyong khang dang / bu khyim brgyad pa sgo 'byed bcas zin rjes dbu gur du nyin gang kho bo dang lhan du chos kyi bka' mchid la rol/ tshes nyer bdun nyin ka sbug rdo rje sogs mi grangs bco lnga la tshe dbang dang / mon pa rdo leb sprul sku nas zhus ngor/ phyi zla drug pa'i tshes gcig nyin mi mang la theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom pa bstsal/ de'i phyi nyin bod mi mang spyi 'thus lhan tshogs nas kho tho'i ched du tshe sgrub mdzad dgos kyi snyan seng zhus ngor/ dgyes

204 4skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen wa 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa spro chen gro'i sgo nas zhal bzhes mdzad/ de'i nyin gnyis par sa skya bdag khri rin po che cob ra hacod sir rdo rje 'chang chen wa'i mjal khar phebs par gus pa chen pos phebs bsu dang / rnam gnyis phan tshun bar chos kyi gsung mchid 'phel bar mdzad/ phyi zla bdun pa'i tshes drug nyin kho bos tshe 'di'i srid pa bzung nas lo grangs so bdun la slebs pa'i skyes skar dus chen nyin/ nyin gung chu tshod bcu gnyis par khri byang rin po che dang lhan phebs kyis rten 'byung mjal dar bstsal zhing / dam pa'i chos kyi bgro gleng gis mgu bar mdzad/ tshes bcu dgu nyin 'char can gnas dga' gnyis lo gsol rten gzhir spyan drangs/phyi zla bdun pa'i tshes sku gcig nas bzung phyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer drug bar nyin gnangs chags su kho bor ra sngo da dang / 'jigs byed kyi 'phrul 'khor khag gi lung / zhwa lu'i drug cu ma'i mtshig gi lung bcas bstsal/ 'di skabs mtshan zhabs gser kong rin po che chos zhur lhan du yod/ de rjes dpa' gcig gi sku mtshams shig gnang ste phyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin kha skong gi sbyin sreg mdzad/ kho bos gasku la ba btab pa ltar rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bka' dbang stsol rgyur brten phyi zla dgu pa'i tshes nyi shu nyin theg chen chos gling gi gtsug lag khang du snga dro sa chog la phebs/nyin gung kho ༷/sa gdan zhus kyis dgung tshigs kyis bsnyen bkur/ kho bo dang / rgyud grwa stod smad gnyis gtsor gyur dge 'dun bzhi brgya skor/ khyim pa pho mo bzhi bcu skor/a ri ba na gzhon gnyis bcas la tshes nyer gsum nyin dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang gi sngon 'gro sta gon/ phyi nyin dbang dang po bum dbang / de'i nyin rjes mar dbang gong ma gsang dbang dang / sher dbang / tshig dbang bcas bstsal zhing / mjug tu gtang rag tshogs bstsal/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang gi skabs ltar byang sdom len pa'i tshul gcig dang / yang spyod 'jug las/ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /zhes sogs kyi tshig dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas smon 'jug gcig car du len pa zhes pa'i tha snyad byed srol bcas kyang mchis mod/ gcig car du len pa zhes pa'i tshig der dpyad dgos pa zhig snang ba ma zad/ rje bdag nyid chen mo'i lam rim che 'bring gnyis /ra smon sems cho gas bzung ba'i tshul gsungs pa las/ byang sdom len pa'i tshul/ byang sa'i tshul khrims le'u'i rnam bshad byang chub gzhung lam du zhal 'phangs gnang ba ltar/ cho ga de'i steng nas byang sdom 'dzin cing 'bogs pa'i rgyun lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje sogs kyi sku dus bar bzhugs kyang / bar lam dbus gtsang khul de tsam grags mi che bar brten phyag len nyams pa slar gso ba'i ched kho tho/sa dha sa nas byang chub gzhung lam gyi phyag dpe zhig 'bul lam zhus pa dang chabs cig de'i thog nas sdom rgyun zhig bstsal rogs zhus pa ltar dgyes brtse chen wa'i sgo nas zhal gyis bzhes/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma ma rnyed na rten gyi drung nas byang sdom blangs na skye bar gzhung lugs tshad ldan du ma'i dgongs pa bzhin phyi tshes bcu nyin sngo na du yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang rang nyid kyis mchod rten chen mo'i gtsang khang thub dbang rin ho che'i mdun nas sdom bzhes gnang / de nas kho cad dang / gser kong mtshan zhabs rin po che gnyis la bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis byang chub gzhung lam yongs nas bla mchod dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs 'bul bzhes sar skyabs rje khri byang rdo rje 'chang chen pos bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyis mthun 'gyur sogs mdzad de gsung chog grol rjes khri byang bla brang du zhabs 'khod kyis gzim shag gsar pa'i zhal bo'i rten 'brel mjal dar sogs 'bul bzhes dang 'brel 7skyabs rje rnam gnyis lhan du lhod bzhugs kyis nang ma'i gsung mchid la rol/ de rjes gling bla brang nas rgyu sbyar te khri byang rdo the 'chang chen 1/ mchog blo gling chos rur gdan zhus kyis brtan bzhugs 'bul bzhes skabs yongs 'dzin khri rin po che nyid kyis rdzas brgyad kyi mthun 'gyur dang 'brel sku tshe zhabs zung yun du brtan pa'i gsol 'debs mdzad/ khri byang rin po che sku 'khor gling bla brang du gdan zhus kyis gsol ston gzab 'bul mdzad skabs khri byang rin po che nas kyang snga lor gling bla brang gi gzim shag gsar bskrun zin pa'i rten 'byung ched mjal dar rten gsum 'bul bzhes gnang / phyi zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gcig nyin mon gho 'dod rgu gling gi gzhis khag khongs dga' 'bras gnyis/ sa skya dang / rnying ma grwa tshang / mi mang spyi mgrin thun mong bcas nas rgyu sbyar te blo gling chos rur yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis lhan rgyas la brtan bzhugs phul ba dgyes bzhes mdzad/ tshes bcu dgu nyin sems bskyed mchod pa dang / de

224 4skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa rjes tshe dbang bcas ba375/ chos zhu ba sbyin bdag rnams nas mkha' 'gro brtan bzhugs 'bul bzhes skabs 'bras spungs bla spyi/ sgo mang grwa tshang / bshad 'phel gling / mtho lding / sa dgon bcas kyi dbu 'dzin rnams nas rten gsum phul te zhabs pad yun brtan gyi gasku la 'debs zhus/ tshes sku gcig nyin lam rim sbyin bdag gnyis nas blo gling chos rur skyabs rje rnam gnyis lhan rgyas la brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan phul/phyi lo 1975 lo'i zla dang khro'i tshes lnga nyin dga' ldan tshogs chen 'du khang du de ga'i bla spyi nas snga sngo skyabs rje rnam gnyis la mdo lugs kyi sgo nas brtan bzhugs phul/phyi dro khri byang rin po che dang lhan du tshogs chen 'du khang rten dang brten par bcas la rab gnas rta thog ma'i sgo nas lhag gnas kyi me dodag 'thor bar mdzad/ tshes dgu nyin lo chen sprul sku nas 'bras spungs tshogs chen gyi tshogs mgon du gdan zhus ltar re ba skong bar mdzad/ tshes bcu gsum nyin dge ldan rig gzhung gces skyong tshogs pa nas gdan zhus kyis dga' ldan snu gas chen 'du khang du zhabs sor 'khod par gdan sa gsum gyis dbus dge 'dun 'dus pa'i dbus su blo gling zam gdong sprul skus tshogs 'du'i sgo dbye dang /rnam grwa mkhan po nas ngo sprod gsung bshad zin rjes yongs 'dzin khri rin po cher dge bshes lha rams pa'i phyag 'khyer dang / gser gyi rtags ma/ mjal dar nang mdzod bcas phul/de rjes khri byang rin po cher yang phyag 'khyer dang gser gyi rtags ma sogs phyogs mtshungs 'bul bzhes mdzad/ de sngon lha sa dang / rjes sor rgya gar bcas par lha rams dam bca' zin pa dang / sngags kyi dam bca' zin pa'i dge bshes rnams la lag 'khyer/ me tog phreng ba sogs 'grems spel byed sku/la yod pa ltar chortags spyi dang / gzhis chags mi mang spyi 'thus bcas nas yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis la rten 'byung legs skyes phul ba bdag gir bzhes/ tshes bco lnga nyin slar yang dga' ldan tshogs chen du dge ldan rig gzhung gces skyong tshogs pa nas skyabs rje rnam pa gnyis la mdo lugs dang 'brel zhabs brtan

sus si dang / 'jar ma ni/ dbyin yul/ pha ran si bcas par phebs te 'gro don 225phul ba dgyes bzhes mdzad/ de'i phyi nyin slo gling chos rur don gnyer can nyi shu skor la dge tshul gyi sdom pa dang / btsun ma bdun la dge tshul ma'i sdom pa bka' drin bstsal/tshes nyi shu'i snga dror sgo mang grwa tshang du phebs te khri byang rin po che dang lhan du 'du khang rten dang brten pa bcas la rab gnas mdzad/ phyi 1spro mon lharware gzhis chags khongs zlos gar tshogs pa nas pho brang gi mdun spang lngongs steng chu tshod gnyis tsam ring chos rgyal nor bzang gi rtogs brjod las brtsams pa'i zlos gar 'khrab ston zhus par skye bo dag gi yid kyi re 'dod dang mthun par dgyes gzigs mdzad/ tshes nyer gsum nyin blo gling chos rur gling bla brang nas rgyu sbyar te der yod dge 'dun rnams kyis sku'i tshe sgrub sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas skyabs rje mchog la mkha' 'gro brtan bzhugs phul/ tshes bco brgyad nyin snga dro mon gho nas 'bel sgam bar mo ṭor dang / de nas gnam gru'i thog ldi lir zhabs sor 'khe da de bzhugs zhag gsum gnang rjes ldi li nas phebs thon gyis phyi zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nyin gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du zhabs 'khod mtshams bod dgon las sne grwa mang rnams kyis mjal bcar zhus/ phyi tshes bcu gcig nyin bod shing sku/sa gnam lo gsar tshes kyi mdzad lha dang / tshes bco lnga nyin grwa tshang dang / bla brang thun mong nas brtan bzhugs 'bul bzhes dang / de nyin nas smon lam tshogs mgon du phebs pa sku/gas 'char can gyi mjad sgo bskyangs/ dgun thog ring gnas chen der zla shas spro bzhugs rjes/ phyi zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin me 'khor brgyud pa ṭan ko ṭi dang / snu ṭor thog tshes lnga nyin r+ha sar phebs 'byor skabs yar lam khri byang rin po che'i gzim shag tu phebs te lo gsar rten 'byung mjal dar 'bul res mdzad/ nyin gnyis par kho wa'i sar phebs te bar lam 'bras spungs chos sgar du sa gsum gyi sgron me gcig pu byang chub lam gyi rim pa chen mo'i bshad lung bstsal tshul sogs kyi gnas tshul zhib par gsungs/ phyi zla lnga pa'i tshes gsum nas bzung kho bor theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong snyan brgyud chen mo'i rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer

226 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen ro 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa gyi bka' khrid dang / tshes bcu gcig nyin gtor ma brgya rtsa'i bka' khrid bstsal/ de nas skyabs rje khri byang rin po che'i sku sdi'i ched du tshe sgrub nyin bdun mdzad de tshes bco brgyad nyin bkra shis rab brtan du ched phebs kyis khri byang rin po cher tshe rdzas 'bul gnang mdzad/tshes nyer lnga nyin bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga 'khel bar phyi rgyal mi rigs nang chos la thos bsam sgom gsum don gnyer can rnams nas gdan zhus ltar gangs skyid dpe mdzod khang du phebs te bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs 'khor lhan du 'bul gnang mdzad cing / zhor du 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che'i gzim shag tu phebs te skyabs rje rnam gnyis mjal 'dzoms thog zab pa dang rgya che ba'i cadar gyi bka' mchid la rol/ tshes bcu dgu nyin phyi bod mi rigs bco brgyad la 'jigs byed kyi dbang chen sta gon dang bcas pa stabs bde zhig bstsal/ phyi zla drug pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin theg chen chos gling du bstan srid bde thabs ched gu ru rin sngo cher 'bum tshogs phul skabs tshogs mgon du phebs te bstan pa rgyas pa dang / 'gro ba bde ba/ lhag par gangs can pa rnams kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'asnga da don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i thugs smon bskyangs/ de'i phri nyin ring nas bsten pa'i srung ma'i gtso thod gnas dga' gnyis rten gzhir spyan drangs te lung 'dri sogs mdzad/de rjes phyi rgyal ba rab byung gnyis la drug cu ma'i bka' khrid bstsal/ tshes ba༄ brgyad nyin 'bri gung tshe tshang rin po che mjal bcar du phebs par gsan bsam 'dzin spel sogs grub chen gong ma dag gi rjes su bsnyegs pa'i rnam thar lhur bzhes dgos tshul gyi bka' slob bstsal/ de'i phyi nyin sus si'i btsun ma bstan 'dzin blo 'phel nas skyabs zhus ltar tshe dbang / phyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes gsum nyin phyi rgyal ba rab byung lnga la bka' sdod chos kyi rgyal ngo'i rjes gnang bstsal te zhu ba po rnams kyi re 'dod skong bar mdzad/ bar lam 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i sku mtshams su bzhugs te tshes bcu bzhi nyin kha skong zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mdzad/ phyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin kho bor sku lnga'i skor rgyal po byes

sus si dang / 'jar ma ni/ dbyin yul/ pha ran si bcas nga ra phebs te 'gro don 227chas kyi chotra/ skor zhig dang / tshes nyer lnga nyin sta gon sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma/ de'i phyi nyin 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor bcas kyi dbang chen dam pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes ma nyams par bstsal/ phri zla dgu pa'i tshes gsum nyin bu gso khang gi las byed pho sna gsum la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa/ phyi zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum nyin btsun ma gsum la dge tshul ma'i sdom pa'i skal ba dang ldan par mdzad/tshes bco brgyad nyin khri byang rin po che cob ra haso/ sir ched phebs bskyangs te chu chodad kha shas ring lhod bzhugs kyis rnam gnyis bka' mchid la dgyes par phro la/ phyi zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu nyin kho bo'i sar phebs te dgun thog ring rdo rje gdan du phebs bzhugs gnang chog pa zhes bka' ba455 zhing / de nyin ldan ma blo chos sprul ྅/ sogs la tshe dbang bstsal/ phyi nyin gangs can skyid gasna ngas su phebs te khri byang rin po che dang lhod mjal mdzad/ de rjes nyin gnyis par gser kong rin po cher 'dod chos 'ga' zhig dang / de'i phyi nyin pha ran si'i ma rgan bde skyid ces par dge bsnyen gyi sdom pas rgyud gtams par mdzad/ tshes nyer gsum nyin gnas masnu ga rdor gdan thodad dgon du phebs 'khyodar skabs de ga'i grwa mang nas phebs bsu dang mjal kha zhus/ ka sgug bde khang lcam nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ phyi zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes sum cu nyin nas bzungs nyin brgyad kyi ring ser skya brgyad brgya skor la blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi bshad khrid ba35pa/phyi lo 1976 zla 1 tshes 5 nas bzung tshes bcu bdun bar srid tshab bde mkhar ba'i btsun ma nas gasku la ba btab pa ltar dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' thod gcig pa'i dbang chen sta gon dang bcas pa/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams khrid sogs rim bzhin bstsal/ tshes bcu bzhi nyin chodas zhu ba tshogs yongs su bsnyen bkur dang 'brel chod gling grwa tshang nas brtan bzhugs phul/ tshes bco brgyad nyin bde khang lcam dang / tre+e rtsodar chodang rab brtan

228 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa bcas nas skyabs zhus ltar tshe dbang dang / spyan ras gzigs ngan sku nga kun grol gyi rjes gnang bstsal/ tshes nyer bzhi nyin don gnyer can bcu dgur dge tshul gyi sdom pa bstsal/phri zla gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin kho tho'i ngag bkod ltar gser kong mtshan zhabs rin po che rdor gdan du ched phebs kyis rdor gdan cadad dgon snurags yongs nas bla mchodad gsol tshogs stong tshar 'bul gshoms dang 'brel yongs 'dzin khri rin sngo cher brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul bzhes bka' drin bskyangs/ phyi zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig bod me 'brug sku gsar gyi rten 'brel mdzad sgo sngar bzhin bskyangs/ rdor gdan du nam phebs mtshams mchod rten rin po che'i spyan sngar mchod sprin sna lnga stong tshar dang 'brel dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur/ de bzhin smon lam skabs kyang rten mchog spyan sngar mchod sprin dang /dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshor bsnyen bkur 'char can mdzad/ kho bo'i ngag bkod ltar gser kong mtshan zhabs rin po che dang / bya bral dge bshes rig 'dzin bstan pa rin 14 che sogs mi grangs sum cu skor nas slar yang bcom ldan 'das sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas sku ngas 'dzin khri rin po cher brtan bzhugs phul ba dgyes bzhes mdzad cing / de'i skabs gling bla brang nas chog grwa sku 'khor rnams la gsol ston gzab rgyas phul/ tshes bdun nyin bla brang dang / jo ra gdan grwa tshang thun mo/nga nas brtan bzhugs 'bul bzhes dang / de nyin nas bzung smon lam tshogs dbur phebs rgyu sku gas 'char can ltar bskyangs/ tshes bcu nyin dz+nya sar phebs thon gyis tshes bcu gsum nyin kho 46re sar phebs te gzim chung dbu rtser ltod mjal zhus/ de rjes khri byang rin po che mchog dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ tshes btwa lnga nyin theg chen chos gling du smon lam tshogs mgon du gdan zhus ltar snga dro skyes rabs kyi gsung chos su phebs shing / de'i phyi nyin dgung tshigs kyi tshogs mgon dang / dgong dro smon lam bcas par chibs bsgyur bskyangs/ gtsug lag khang gi dbu rtser yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang chen po rnam gnyis lhan du gdan zhus kyis kho

sus si dang / 'jar ma ni/ dbyin yul/ pha ran si bcas par phebs te 'gro don 229bos dgung tshigs kyis bsnyen bkur/ tshes nyer gsum nyin yongs 'dzin khri rin po che mchog dang khri byang rin po che lhan du kho tho'i sar phebs te da lam bka' shag gis mtshon/spyi 'thus dang / las bsgyu mas tshogs mi spyi mgrin nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ kho tho/ bstan 'gro'i dpal du ring 'tsho'i 'dun pa bskyed dgos tshul phebs par da lam gnas chung chos rgyal chen wa'i lung don/ dpal ldan lha mo'i thugs dgongs 'khrugs rkyen byung lugs 'di bzhin bod mi sku/ngas kyi bsam brjod kyi yul las 'das pa'i gnas tshul la brten phyi nyin lha mo dang / sku lnga bcas par bskang 'phrin tshogs 'khor gnad smin dang bcas gnas chung spyan 'dren zhus te lha mor zhu bshags gsol 'debs dang / rang res 'gal nongs ci byung bka' gsal sku/nga ba zhes gnas chung la zhu bskul byas legs lha/gas kyi bka' bsdur zhus/ de'i phyi nyin bod rigs ser skya yongs nas rgyu sbyar te theg chen chos gling du gnyug mar gnas pa dang / blo bur ba'i dge 'dun rnams dang bcas pas skyabs rje rnam gnyis la brtan bzhugs phul/ de'i nyin rjes mar yongs 'dzin the rje 'chang chen po mchog nas/khri byang rin po che/ gser bo nga mtshan zhabs/ rnam grwa dang / gnas chung dge 'dun yongs rdzogs dang lhan du lha mo dang / sku lnga'i bskang 'phrin tshogs 'khor dang sbrags gnas chung rten gzhir spyan drangs te blang dor lam ston lhug por gnang dgos pa'i lung zhu mdzad par chos skyong nas ma gcig 'dod khams bdag mo thugs dgongs sel ched ris med chos byed rnams nas blang dor 'dzol med dgos lugs sogs phebs/ tshes nyer dgu nyin kho bor 'jigs byed dbang chen bstsal/ phyi zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu bzhi nyin gangs can skyid galha ngas dpe mdzod khang gi tshogs mgon du gdan zhus ltar phebs te phyi bod chos byed pa rnams dang lhan du rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes pa bskyed pa'i mchod sprin 10sa/ phri zla lnga pa'i tshes bdun nyin dad ldan lnga la dge tshul ma'i sdom pa'i skal ba dang ldan par mdzad/tshes nyer bdun nyin chab mdo dge bshes dang lhan du las rung zhig gi dbu 'dzugs gnang /

230 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sbrul ldo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod di phyi zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin gnas chung lcog tu chibs bsgyur bskyangs te chos skyong chen po gzugs can gyi rten gzhir spyan drangs te lung 'dri gnang / phyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyi shu nyin snga dro chu tshod brgyad dang phyed tsam la kho bo lam zhor du mtshan zhabs gser kong rin po che'i bzhugs yul du khyug tsam bskyod de gsar du bzhengs pa'i na bza' 'bul ba dang sbrags cob ra ha'o sir yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mjal khar bcar te sku tshe zhabs pad yun du brtan pa'i gsol 'debs zhus/ 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che mchog nas yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang chen wa'i sku phyar ched dmigs tshe sgrub 'phar ma gnang ste tshes nyer bzhi nyin gling bla brang du tshe rdzas 'bul gnang dang 'brel bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du zhabs pad yun brtan gyi thugs bzhed mi lha da pa dgos tshul snyan seng gnang / bar lam lhag lha'i ljags bsnyen gnang ba les/sa grub kyis ṇ+ḍi zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer drug nyin kha skong sbyin sreg gnang / de'i phri nyin bco brgyad khri chen rin po che chos don gyi phyag las gnang skabs shig la yongs 'dzin rin po che nas dpa' gcig bskyed rdzogs kyi bka' khrid gnang gi yod pa gsan nas bka' khrid la bcar 6)ga pa'i snyan seng gnang bar/ yongs 'dzin rin po che nas de sngon dpa' gcig gi dbang gsan yod med bka' 'dri gnang bar/dge ldan phyogs nas zhu ma myong yang / rgyud sde kun btus nang sku da pa de thob tshul zhus gnang skabs/ de'i cho ga gang yin skor bka' 'dri gnang bar lcang skya'i cho ga yin lugs zhus par/ dbang de gas 'thus lugs phebs par brten bka' khrid la bcar ba yin gsungs/bco brgyad khri chen rin po che'i gzigs snang la/ yongs 'dzin rin po che'i dbu dang / shangs sogs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i gzi brjid che ba'i thog snyan gyi rgyab nas dbu rwa chung chung 'od sngon po 'phro ba/ de la'ang lce lhe rgyan cha lta bu yod pa zhig mjal byung ba da phan su la'ang lab rgyu ma byung zhes bco brgyad khri chen rin sngo che nas phyis su kho bor gsung gi 'dug pa de ni bla ma gnyis ga'i thun mong ma yin pa'i sku/na tan ngo mtshar chen po red snyam pa byung /

sus si dang / 'jar ma ni/ dbyin yul/ pha ran si bcas par phebs te 'gro don 231bco brgyad khri chen rin po che yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang yang yang mjal bcar skabs chos dang 'brel ba'i gsung mol 'phel/ phyi zla dgu pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin phyi rgyal mtshams pa ba rnams nas tu shi ta chos tshogs su gdan zhus ltar phebs te bla mchod bde stong dbyer med dang 'brel ba'i chodags kyi 'khor los sras bcas rgyal ba mnyes par mdzad/ tshes nyer bdun nyin chu stod bcu gnyis dang phyed shar kho bo'i sar phebs te ring min ku lu khul du phebs rgyu yin tshul bka' phebs par stabs 'grigs na bka' dbang rnams rdul 〉rgan gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel bar mdzad na legs pa'i bsam tshul zhus shing / dgong dro'i chu tshod gsum dang phyed bar masnga sngags kyi dka' gnad las brtsams pa'i bka' 'dri zhus khag la thugs dgyes brtse chen wa'i sgo nas blo dogs kyi dra ba mtha' dag gcod par mdzad/ de rjes khri byang rin po che'i gzim shag tu phebs te rnam gnyis kyis bar lam mdzad 'phrin ji bzhes skor phan tshun gnas tshul gsung res mdzad/ phyi zla bcu pa'i tshes gcig nyin rbe hor rdza rong tshang nas rnam grwa tshogs yongs la mchod 'bul bsnyen bkur zhu skabs sbyin bdag gis zhu mos ltar tshogs mgon du phebs te rgyu sbyor ba 'brel thogs dang bcas par gnas skabs mi 'dod pa'i nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi zhing / dal rten rim brgyud sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan gyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i thugs smon bskyangs/ sngon nas ku lur bod dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling nas gsol ba btab bzhin/ tshes gsum nyin mo codar thog ku lur phebs thon gnang ste thog mar khul der yod pa'i rang gzhung bod kyi slob grwa ba rnams nas phebs bsu gzab rgyas dang bcas slob grwar gdan drangs/ de nas dge rgan dang / cadab phrug pha ma bcas brgya stodar zhig la mjal kha dang / bka' cadab bstsal/ ku lu bod dgon nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ nyin gnyis kyi rjes chos zhu ba lnga brgya skor la gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang chen sta gon dang bcas pa/ de'i phyi nyin bod rigs dang khu nu ba sogs ser skya chig stong lnga brgya skor la tshe dbang dang / mchog gsum

231 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa spyi wa'i chodad du bkur nas las 'bras la blang dor tshul bzhin bya rgyu gal che ba sogs kyi bka' slob bstsal/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur mdzad rgyu'i dgongs bzhed bcang yang / gang ci'i cha rkyen stabs ma 'grigs pas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas tshes brgyad nyin sta gon dang 'brel nyin gsum ring ser skya bzhi brgya skor la 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma dang / zhe dgu ma/ ro langs brgyad skor bcas kyi dbang chen sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nges dang / de'i nyin rjes mar blo gling rgyal sras sprul sku dang / ri rgya sprul sku gnyis kyis gsol ba btab pa ltar lam rim bsdus don gyi bshad lung bcas bstsal te skye rgu rnams kyi yid kyi re 'dod skong bar mdzad/ tshes bcu drug nyin sim lar sngo da dgon sangs rgyas chos gling du gdan zhus ltar chibs bsgyur gnang / tshes bco brgyad nyin bod dgon de'i tshogs mgon du gdan zhus ltar phebs/ tshes nyer gcig nyin gnas 'dzin dge sbyin pa rgya mtsho nas zhus ngor khul de'i ser skya mi mang chig stong sum brgya skor la yon tan gzhi gyur ma'i steng nas mdo sngags kyi lam sku/ngas rdzogs kyi bshad pa dang 'brel spyan ras gzigs ngan sku nga kun grol gyi rjes gnang tshe dbang bcas bka' drin nod/ bo nga gsal gnas 'dzin dang / bla brang zhabs gras rnying pa chos 'phel thun mong nas bla mchod tshogs 'a〈per 'bul gshams dang 'brel brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan bstar 'bul zhus skabs der yod bod mi spyi dang / bod gzhung slob grwa slob phrug bcas nas rten gsum phul te mjal kha zhus/ de rjes gtsug lag khang du rab gnas rta thog ma'i sgo nas dam ye dbyer med du mdzad/ de nas bod gzhung slob grwar gdan zhus ltar tshes drug nyin snga dror ser skya mi mang dang slob grwa ba bcas mi grangs lnga brgya skor la drag 14 gsum bsgril gyi rjes gnang dang / bden gsol smon lam gyi bshad khrid dang 'brel/ bka' slob bstsal zhing / skabs de'i mjal rten 'bul dngos rnams khungs so sor phyir log bstsal/ de'i phyi nyin dz+nya sar phebs thon gyis nyin gnyis kyi rjes kho tho'i sar phebs te ku lu mā na li dang / sim la

sus si dang / 'jar ma ni/ dbyin yul/ pha ran si bcas par phebs te 'gro don 233khur du bstan 'gror sman pa'i mdzad bzang bka' drin che lugs skor gyi gnas tshul gsungs/phyi tshes bcu bzhi bod zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i dus chen nyin theg chen snu sa gling du gdan zhus kyis rab gnas dbu bzhugs su phebs/ phyi zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun nyin kho bor gdugs dkar sta gon dang / de'i phyi nyin dbang chen dngos gzhi/ de rjes mgon po zhal dang / lha mo bcas kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ de'i nyin gnyis par rdzogs chen pad+ma rig 'dzin gyi sprul sku dang / gser kong mtshan zhabs rin po che/ gnas chung sku rten/ gnas grwa bco lnga skor bcas la sku lnga'i srog gtad gnang /tshes nyi shu nyin bu gso khang gi btsun ma skal ldan sogs la gdugs dkar gyi lha nas byad grol bstsal/ tshes nyer gsum nas bzung kho bo'i las brel dang stabs bstun nyin lnga'i ring 'dod chos mang po zhig gi bka' drin bskyangs te/ nyin tha mar mon ghor phebs rgyu'i thon mjal gnang / phyi zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum nyin ldi lir phebs thon gnang ste khul der bca' sdod li thang a dar can mi grangs sum cu skor la tshe dbang bstsal/ tshes drug nyin ldi li nas gnam gru brgyud 'bel sgam dang / de nas mo ṭor thog 'bras spungs chos sgar gyi bla brang gzim shag tu zhabs sor 'kho da skabs 'bras spungs bla spyi dang / blo gling grwa tshang sogs nas maṇ+ḍal rten gsum phul/ bod zla bcu pa'i tshes nyer lnga nyin 'jam mabo na bla ma tsong kha pa chen po dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin du phebs pa'i dus chen gyi nyin tre+e hor 'khrungs gsar bla brang nas snga dro tshogs chen dang / phyi dro blo gling gra tshang gi tshogs mgon du gdan zhus ltar phebs/ tshes nyer bzhi nyin sgo mang grwa tshang nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ dga' 'bras dge 'dun yongs rdzogs la mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bstsal/ tshes nyer dgu nyin 'khon rigs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya bdag khri rin po che skyabs rje yongs 'dzin dga' khri gling rdo rje 'chang mchog gi mjal khar phebs/rnam gnyis dbar phan tshun rten gsum mjal dar 'bul res mdzad de lhod bzhugs thog

234 4skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul ldo rje 'chang chen pa 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa mdo sngags kyi skor las brtsams pa'i chos kyi bka' mchid lhug por mdzad/ 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che yang de nyin mjal khar phebs/phyi lo 1977 zla 1 tshes 1 nyin dga' ldan chos sgar du khri byang rin po che mjal bar phebs te de nyin rnam gnyis lhod bzhugs mdzad/ de rjes nyin bzhi par blo gling grwa tshang gi g.yang sgrub cho gas mgon du phebs/ tshes bcu drug nyin phyag mdzod blo bzang lung rigs mgrib lta bu'i nad mnar la thugs g.yeng chen po byung ste bod tshes bco lnga nam shar la rdo rje rnam 'jo mas kyi sgo nas byabs khrus bstsal/ tshes bco brgyad nyin dga' ldan shar rtse grwa tshang du chos zhu ba lnga brgya skor la blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi bshad lung dbu 'dzugs mdzad/ tshes nyer dgu nyin gsung chos legs par grub/ de'iskabs 'bul ba rnams phyir slog bstsal/ phyi nyin cha phreng dge chod bzang chos 'dzin nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ gong gsal cesas zhu ba rnams la spyan ras gzigs ngan sku/nga kun grol gyi rjes gnang ba455/ tshes so gcig nyin blo gling grwa tshang nas yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis lhan rgyas thog bla mchod dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs phul zhing / de nyin 'bras spungs bla spyi dang / mon gho gzhis chags spyi nas kyang rten gsum phul te sku tshe zhabs pad yun du brtan pa'i gsol 'debs zhus/ phyi zla gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis nyin dga' ldan bla spyi nas gdan zhus ltar tshogs mgon du khri byang rin po che dang lhan du mdo lugs kyi brtan bzhugs 'bul bzhes zin pa'i mtshams khri byang bla brang du phebs te nyin gung gasku la tshigs lhan bzhes mdzad/ de'i phyi nyin khri byang bla brang nas rgyu sbyar te 'bras blo gling grwa tshang gi 'du khang du yongs 'dzin khri rin po cher bla mchod dang 'brel ba'i mkha' 'gro brtan bzhugs phul skabs khri byang rin po che nas rdzas brgyad kyi mthun 'gyur sogs mdzad/ phyi nyin skyabs rje khri byang ririn po che'i drung nas grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang zhig gsan skabs mdzod pa blo bzang lung smyoregs kyang bcar/ tshes drug nas nyin bzhi'i ring blo gling chos rur bla sprul dge bshes bzhi bcu skor

sus si dang / 'jar ma ni/ dbyin yul/ pha ran si bcas pa ra phebs te 'gro don 235la 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsnyen chen gyi bka' khrid bskyangs/ tshes bcu nyin dga' shar grwa tshang du rab gnas sta gon du gdan zhus ltar phebs zhor du khri byang bla brang du phebs skabs khri byang rin po che nas dmigs bsal mdzod par dug dbyung byabs khrus shig gnang bar yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang chen pos kyang lhan du zhu gnang mdzad/ tshes bcu dgu nyin bod me sprul gnam lo gsar tshes 'khel bar bla brang du 'char can mdzad sgo grub rjes chod gling grwa tshang gi tshogs mgon du gdan zhus kyis phye mar/ gsol ja/ bzhes 'bras sogs rim phul rjes mkhan bla las sne sogs la mjal kha dang phyag mdud bcas bstsal/ tshes nyer gcig nyin dga' ldan du phebs te bar lam khri byang rin po che'i sku tshe tshe sgrub mdzad pa'i tshe rdzas ril bu dang / dgung gsar rten 'byung mjal dar bcas 'bul gnang thog sku spyod bzhugs gnang / tshes nyer bzhi nyin snga dro 'bras spungs tshogs chen du gdan zhus ltar dge 'dun rnams dang lhan gcig tu bkra shis gso sbyong mdzad/ de rjes blo gling grwa tshang nas gdan zhus ltar 'du khang du 'dus mang nas brtan bzhugs 'bul bzhes skabs bla spyi dang / khang tshan khag sa skya dang / rnying dgon bcas nas rten gsum mjal dar phul/ tshes nyer drug nas bzung 'bras spungs tshogs chen du dga' 'bras gnyis cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo lhan tshogs skabs tshogs dbur phebs shing / nyin dang wa'i gung tshigs mang ja'i skabs yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis la 'dus mang nas malhun lugs kyi brtan bzhugs 'bul lam zhus/ brtan bzhugs grub mtshams khri byang rin po che gling bla brang gi gzim shag tu phebs te dgung gsar gyi rten 'brel mjal dar 'bul bzhes lhod mjal gnang / phyi zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig nyin blo gling chos rur bsgrub bya zhe lnga la dge tshul dang / tshes gsum nyin dge tshul nyi shu la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bstsal/ tshes bdun nyin dga' 'bras bla spyi dang / go bo chos mdzad bcas nas skyabs zhus ltar ser skya mi mang stong phrag kha shas 'du 'dzoms sar tshe dbang dang / rab byung rnams nas thos bsam sgom

236 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen wa 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa gsum ya ma bral ba dang / khyim pa rnams nas kyang sdig spong dge sgrub la ci nus kyis bsnyu na pa gal che lugs sku gas 'di phyi kun tu dge ba'i bka' slob kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad/tshe bcu bzhi nyin skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang sku 'khor gsum mkha' lam brgyud ldi lir phebs/tshes bco brgyad nyin gyi snga dror dbyin ji'i bud med pad+ma sogs la tshe dbang bstsal zhing /de'i phyi dro dz+nya sar phebs thon mdzad nas/ tshes nyer gnyis nyin kho bo'i sar phebs par yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang dang / khri byang rin po che bcas lhan du lhod mjal zhus/ tshes gsum bcu nyin tu shi twa chos tshogs su gdan zhus ltar der phyi rgyal mi rigs kha shas la bsnyen rdzogs dang / 'ga' shas la dge tshul gyi sdom pa bstsal/ de rjes nyin drug par kho sku'i ngag bkod ltar sku sger yig tshang nas rgyu sbyar te gling bla brang gi gzim shag tu yongs 'dzin rin po cher brtan bzhugs phul/ de rjes kho bos mtshams sbyor zhus pa rgya gar ba gcig la dge tshul gyi sdom pa bstsal/ phyi zla drug pa'i tshes drug nyin gnas chung co sa rgyal chen po rten gzhir spyan drangs te gang ci'i lung 'dri gnang / tshes bcu gsum nyin kho the dang lhan du don ldan gyi bka' mchid la rol/ tshes sum cu nyin yongs 'dzin rin po che'i gzim chung du dbyin ji'i mi rigs dge tshul thub bstan chos dar nas rgyu sbyar te phyi rgyal mi rigs nang chos lag len bstar mkhan gzhan dag dang / dge bshes ngag dbang dar rgyas sku gas chog grwa nyi shu skor nas bla mchod dang 'brel ba'i chodags phul ba dgyes pa'i mchod sprin du gyur/ phyi zla bdun pa'i tshes drug nyin kho bo bgrang bya zhe gsum la slebs pa'i skyes skar gyi nyin rtsaba'i bla ma mchog khri byang rin po che dang lhan du phebs te mjal dar bstsal/tshes nyer drug nyin bde mkhar ba'i btsun ma sogs mi grangs 'ga' shas la tshe dbang bstsal/phyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin rgyud stod grwa tshang nas brtan bzhugs 'bul skabs khri byang rin po che nas kyang rdo rje 'chang chen po mchog bstan 'tho'i mgon dpung dam par zhabs zung g.yung drung rtag pa chen po'i ngo bor brtan pa'i gasku la 'debs phyag bris dang /

sus si dang / 'jar ma ni/ dbyin yul/ pha ran si bcas par phebs te 'gro don 237sku tshe tshe sgrub mdzad pa'i tshe rdzas bcas kyang 'bul gnang mdzad/ phyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes sum cu nyin kho sngo sa gdan zhus ltar bar lam ngos rang rgya gar lho phyogs chos sgar khag tu chos 'chad spel ji ltar byas tshul gyi gnas tshul rnams zhus par thugs gting nas dgyes pa'i bka' mchid phebs/ phyi zla dgu pa'i tshes gsum nyin thub bstan bzod pa sogs bla sprul dge bshes brgyad la gtor ma brgya rtsa'i bka' khrid dang / rje tshe 'dzin ma'i bka' dbang bstsal/ yang tshes brgyad nyin a ri ba zhig la gsung bsgyur brgyud dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i bka' khrid bstsal/ phyi zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin kho bos gdan zhus ltar phran sar phebs te lhod bzhugs kyis zab pa dang rgya che ba'i cadar gyi bka' gnad las brtsams pa'i the tshom gyi mdud pa mang po zhig ga༄ da par mdzad/ phyi zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin chos don lhan khang nas kho bo'i don du tshe sgrub mdzad dgos pa'i snyan seng zhus pa ltar bka' drin bskyangs/ nyin bzhi'i rjes gnas chung lha tshes zhu gnang dang / 'di skabs mdzod pa blo bzang lung rigs snying dang / chu nad lta bu'i rkyen gyis nad gzhi ha cang lci bar 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che gling bla brang du ched phebs kyis byin rten rtsa che zhig dang / rta mgrin gyi sgo nas bka' sgo bcas kyi thog sman bcos byed phyogs sogs kyi skor la bka' phru ba gnang zhing / rdo rje 'chang chen pos kyang thugs khur chen po mdzad de dgong mo nyal khar bka' bsgo byin rlabs sogs lan mang ba355/ phyi zla bcu pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin ka na ṭar gnas 'khod bod mi spyi nas yongs 'dzin rin po che sku tshe zhabs pad yun du brtan pa'i gsol 'debs zhus/ tshes nyer brgyad nyin byams pa bzod pa nang mi tshor ba〉〉ma ldan 'das 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo'i sgo nas byad grol bstsal/ nyin gnyis kyi rjes pha ran si'i bu mo 'jag gling (/'i09021102)zhes pa de sngon pha ran sir sman khang du phebs skabs kyi sman rogs zhabs zhu ba nar si des rgyu sbyar te rgyud stod 6)ga grwa nas brtan bzhugs 'bul bzhes bskyangs/ bod zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin ngos kyis yongs 'dzin rin po cher

238 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa snyan gsan zhu don zhig la/ sgra'i bka' khrid cig stsol grub pa zhes zhus par/ dbyangs can sgra mdo dang / ka la pa gnyis ga'i gsan rgyun yod/ ga re gsan 'gab che min dgongs bzhes brtag dpyad gnang 'thus phebs par/ mo zhig rgyab par ka la pa bzang babs byung ba de don gnas tshul snyan gsan zhus par/ dbyangs can sgra mdo'i khrid thengs 'ga' shas zhu myong yod kyang / ka la pa'i khrid da phan zhus med la/ dpe cha yang da phan gtan nas lta rgyu ma byung zhes phebs par 'grel pa'i phyag dpe thugs zhib gnang ched phyag dpe gzim chung nas phul ba dang / zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu bzhi nas dbu 'dzugs kyis brel seng dang bstun ka la pa'i bka' khrid mtshams sbyor lnga pa yan rim bzhin bstsal ba thob/ yongs 'dzin rin po che nas ka la pa gsan sa khu nu bla ma bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan rin sngo/ che yin pa dang / de ni nga ma skyes pa'i gong nas gsan grub pa dang / 'grel pa ni sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi 'grel pa'i thog nas gsan 'dug de nas da phan lo bzhi bcu zhe grangs song ba'i ring phyag dper gzigs rtog gtan nas gnang khom ma byung yang / da lam thengs gcig gzigs rtog mdzad rjes bka' khrid gnang skabs ka la pa'i rtsab gzhi 8 bzung 'grel bshad khag thugs thog nas thogs pa med par zhib lhug tu gnang gi 'dug dngos gnas drang gnas rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhus nga/'i paṇ+ḍita de 'dra zhig yin dgos kyi red snyam pa'i ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab par mthong nas shin tu ha las dad gus skyes/ ngas sgra'i tshig 'ga' shas 'khyor la mi 'khyor byed pa'i skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che bzhad mo mang po bzhad par mjal ba ni skal ba bzang po byung / de rjes shig la 7rgyal mchog lnga pa'i dbyangs can dgyes glu'i thog nas snyan ngag gi bka' khrid cig zhus pa yongs rdzogs rang ma grub/phyi zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes drug nyin dgun thog ring rdo rje 'chang chen po mchog wā khā+e dang /rdor gdan sogs su phebs rgyu'i thon mjal gnang / dge ldan spyi las khang nas gdan zhus ltar/ tshes bcu nyin r+ha sa nas phebs thon gyis wā ra khā+e sir phebs 'byor skabs bod kyi

sus si dang / 'jar ma ni/ dbyin yul/ pha ran si bcas par phebs te 'gro don 239mtho rim slob grwa'i gtso 'dzin zam gdong sprul sku sogs rgya gar ba dang / bod rigs dge rgan 〈 ba phrug bcas pas phebs bsu zhus/ de rjes rgya mi'i lha khang du phebs sgrig zhus pa ltar bzhugs/ tshes bcu bzhi nyin la dwags ba ku la rin po che sogs la tshe dbang bstsal/phyi nyin yongs 'dzin lda je 'chang chen po ston 'khor dang / pha ran si'i btsun ma thub bstan sgrol dkar/ sman zhabs jig ling (/'i09501122)zhes pa bcas ba༄ ma ldan 'das 'khor nyan chodas kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa lo mang ring gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas khyad par can mnyan yod du phebs 'byor gyis byang chub chen mo6) chos tshogs kyi mgron khang du bzhugs/gzhis rtse tshong khang gi ma rgan 'das pa'i rjes 'jug ched mgron khang gi nye 'dabs su mchod rten gsar bzhengs dang dus mtshungs su gyur par nang mi rnams kyis ji ltar gasku lo ba btab pa ltar/ gzungs gzhugs rnams la rab gnas dang / mchad 'bul thugs sman/yang bla brang nas kyang mchod 'bul rgya cher mdzad/ gnas chen der ha cang gi dgyes spro'i ngang sku spyod bzhugs bskyangs/ bka' zur sne shar thub bstan thar pa nas zhus ngor/ bcom ldan 'das kyis stong pa rten 'byung gi don du 'asnga mas par mdzad pa'i tshul las brtsams pa'i bstod pa legs par bshad pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ljags lung dang / gnas kyi che ba sogs kyang bka' bstsal/ tshes bcu bdun nyin bcom ldan 'das gang du mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdzad pa ston pa'i gnas cangamachog grong du phebs/ rnam grwa tshangs pa can nas phebs sgrig zhus pa ltar thodad dgon gsar par bzhugs te mchod 'bul thugs smon sogs bskyangs/ de'i phyi nyin slar yang wā ra khā+e sir phyir phebs mdzad/ dge ldan spyi las khang gis sngon nas gsol ba btab pa ltar bod dgon du tshes nyer gcig nas bzung don gnyer ba bzhi brgya lnga bcu skor la bcom ldan 'das dpal sho je 'jigs byed chen wa'i bka' dbang /zab lam bla ma mchodad pa'i bka' khrid/ sus si'i gzhis kho ngas rtse drung pad+ma sogs nas skyabs zhus ltar/ rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi ljags rtsom dus 'khor bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bka'

240 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa khrid bcas rim bzhin ba355/ bla brang nas 〉〉sa zhu ba rnams la gsol ja/ galha/la tshigs/sku 'gyed/ mchod rten chen mo'i spyan sngar mchod sprin sna lnga stong tshar bcas phul/ tshes nyi shu nyin slo gling grwa tshang nas rgyu sbyar te chos zhu ba spyir bsnyen bkur dang 'brel brtan bzhugs phul/ phyi zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bzhi nyin chodab spyi zam gdong rin sngo che nas maṇ+ḍal bshad 'bul dang 'brel dge ldan spyi las khang nas brtan bzhugs bstar ba dgyes bzhes mdzad/ de'i phyi nyin rta'u dge blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / gling zhabs bstan 'dzin phun tshogs thun mong nas zhus ngor/ spyan ras gzigs ngan song kun grol gyi rjes gnang dang tshe dbang bcas bstsal/ de rjes dga' ldan lnga mchod kyi mdzad sgor gdan zhus ltar gsung bshad dang bka' slob bcas bstsal/ phyi tshes bdun nyin rdor gdan du zhabs sku ra 'khod/rgyun du bathodam ldan 'das sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'kho ra lo'i sgo nas tshe sgrub gnang mus thog da lam tshes bcu gsum nas bzung snga dro tshe sgrub 'phar ma thun re gnang / tshes so gcig nas bzung nyin shas ring ser byes 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sogs la 'jigs byed bsnyen chen gyi bka' khrid bstsal/phyi lo 1978 zla 1 tshes 5 nyin bsgrub bya bcu la dge tshul gyi sdom pa bcing5/tshes bcu bzhi'i snga dro chu tshod bdun dang phyed /ra kho bo bod dgon du 'byor skabs yongs 'dzin rin yongs 'dzin jo rje 'chang yang lhan du phebs/

nas skyabs zhus ltar tshes nyer brgyad nyin skya ser nyis brgya skor la sgrol dkar tshe dbang bstsal/ phyi zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu nyin rdor gdan mgon khang rgya bskyed bgyis pa legs zin skabs rab gnas rta chodag ma'i sgo nas byin brgya dbab par mdzad/ phyi tshes bcu gsum nyin r+ha sar phebs thon gyis tshes bco lnga nyin kho tho'i sar phebs par lgod mjal zhus/ tshes nyer bdun nyin 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che gling bla brang du ched phebs kyis skyabs rje khri byang rin po che gang nyid nas ljags rtsom gnang ba'i phyag dpe po ti gsum 'bul gnang dgyes bzhes mdzad/ phyi zla bzhi pa'i 'bul bar mdzad/ nyin gung chu tshod bcu gnyis par/ phud

296 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa/ 'di ltar bgyis pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag la drin gyis bskyangs pa'i pha ma dang / /sems bskyed zhus pa'i bla ma slob dpon dang / /dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje spun rnams dang / /rgyu rdzas 'brel ba yod pa'i mi rnams dang / /bzhon khal srog gcod 'o zho 'thung ba dang / /sha khrag zas pa'i dud 'gro ma lu+os pa/ /myur du sangs rgyas ga 'phang thab par shag /ces gsungs te 'brel thogs rnams la thugs smon yun ring du gnang / de nas sku phyag lan gsum gnang rjes mtshan gzim khang du phebs te nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel sku gzim gnang ba sogs nyin re bzhin mdzad pa rnams par btab pa ltar gnang / rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa'i thugs dam bka' lan dang mthun par khyad chos chen po lnga'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa nyid thun mong ma yin pa'i lhag pa'i lhar mdzad de zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi spyan dmigs dang bcas de nyid kyi rnal 'byor gtso bor thugs nyams su bzhes/ bla ma mchod pa'i sgo nas dbang bzhi byin rlabs rgyas pa yi dam de nyid dang 'brel bar gsungs/ bde mchog gu/sa dkyil dang / rnal 'byor ma/ gsang 'dus bcas kyi bdag bskyed bcas ma chag par gnang ste khams gsum chos kyi rgyal sngo/ tsong kha pa chen 16) mdzad pa dang mthun par yi dam gsang bde 'jigs gsum ya ma bral bar thugs nyams su bzhes/ gzhan yang nyid kyi klog pa'i slob dpon rgyud stod dge ngag dbang lhun 'grub/ sku gong ma'i gsol dpon byams pa blo bzang / yongs 'dzin nyag re dge bshes bstan pa chos 'dzin/ 7rgyal dbang sku 'phreng

phyi lo 1980 lor slar yang yo rob dang / byang a ri'i khul du zhabs sor bkod de 297bcu gsum pa chen po ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya ma〉rga/ pha bong kha pa byams pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ 'bul sdud jo rjo 'chang blo bzang ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/yongs 'dzin rwa stod mkhan zur blo bzang bsam gtan/ stag brag rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang gsung rab mthu stobs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ khang sar jo rje 'chang ngag dbang thub bstan chos kyi dbang phyug co ne+e dge bshes rin po che blo bzang rgya mtsho/ sog po dge bshes dpal ldan bzang po/ khri byang rdo rje 'chang blo bzang ye shes bstan 'dzin rgya mcho / bka' 'gyur bla ma blo bzang don ldan/ mi nyag khri zur ye shes dbang ldan/ gzim 'og rin po che byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ lha btsun rdo rje 'chang blo bzang thub bstan dge legs rab rgyas/ sku 'bum mi nyag rin po che ngag dbang legs bshad rgya mtsho/bkras lhun gzigs rgyab rin po che blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi dbang phyug rgyud stod dge ye shes rab rgyas/ rgyud lha da mchod g.yog pa tshul khrims/ bde yangs mtshan zhabs rin po che bstan 'dzin 'phrin las 'od zer/ lcang rgyab khri chen mkhyen rab yon tan/ rgyud stod dge bstan rgyas/ zhwa 'phel sprul sku ngag dbang dam chos blo bzang / rgyud stod sngags rams pa blo bzang nyi ma/ khu nu bla ma rin po che bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan/ khri chen thub bstan nyin byed/ rwa stod brag g.yab gdong kong sprul sku thub bstan dge legs rgya mtsho/yer slob 'phrin las dbang grags te dngos su chos gsan pa'i bla ma nyer dgu'i mtshan sngags yod pa rnams dang / 'jam dpal mtshan bsgyurd/ 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor 'o'i thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i gsol 'debs snu sa gus kyi tam bu ra/ rin 'byung brgya rtsadang / zur bka' brgya mnas 'byung ba'i chag med 'don dgos kyi gzungs sngags dam bca' can zur du bkol ba/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seṅge'i gdong pa can gyi sgrub thabs the rje'i pha lam/ mgon po snying zhugs bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhing skyong stobs 'phrog

298 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa dbang gro'i gsang khrid/ bzang spyod dang / spyod 'jug smon lam/ lam rim sa bcad mdo sngags kyi gzhung la slob gnyer byed tshul dang / nyams snu nga rgan wa'i 'bel gtam/lam rim shar sgom gnad don kun tshang / gung thang gsung sdom gsum bslab bya'i sdodam tshig blo sbyong man ngag zhi gnas skor gyi zin bris/ 'jigs byed kyi sngo gas rim gyi rnam bshad/ blo sbyong man ngag thu'u bkan gyi gsung / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar gshin rje gshed rigs lnga la brten nas dam tshig nyams chag gasku ba'i gdams pa nyams su blang tshul/ 'jigs mdzad ser ngo'i sgo nas tshe sgrub byed tshul 'chi med srog gi ka ba/ 10sa med gtad rul mi mthun bar chad kun sel/ sngags pa rnams nas 'bral med bcang dgos pa'i sku byad rnams kyi dpe ris/ yodape/ rgyud the ga bdun gyi mchan 'grel snyan brgyud rin chen 'phreng ba bcas rgyun gzigs phyag dpe'i sgam chung nang khe gtsang bzhugs par dpags na mdzad brel chung skabs 'di dag rgyun du nyams bzhes gnang gi sku da 'dug/

15mkhas btsun bzang gsurjo /)chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bston 'azlo'i do+on na mdzad tshul sags ༵ ༵ sdu ba/༄/ /da ni sngon gyi dam pa mang yi rnam thar dang mthun par klog pa po rnams kyis yid la gzung bde ba'i phyir slar yang rnam thar gyi don bsdu ba tsam brjod na/dam pa 'di nyid kyis bshes gnyen bcu phrag gsum du nye ba bsten par mdzad pa las/sku'i na tshod ches phra ba'i skabs bla brang gi zhabs gras rnams kyis rgyun du bcar bzhugs mdzad pa'i dpe khrid dge rgan sogs su 'os brtag dpyad kyis thag gcod byas mod/ sku nar son pa'i rjes rang nyid kyis theg gsum gang gi dbang du byas pa'i bkur 'os bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid ldan min sogs zhib brtag las g.yam rgyugs mi mdzad pa/dper na/co ne+e dge cho kyi ༄ zhebashes rin po blo bzang rgya mtsho sprin gtsug lag chos 'dod 'ja mdun nas gsung chas gsan 'gab che min skyabs rje pha bong kha rin po cher bka' 'dri zhu gnang mdzad pa dang /rjes su sku 'bum mi nyag rin po che'i drung nas gsung chos gsan rgyu'i skor jo bo rin po che'i mdun zan bsgril zhu gnang mdzad pa sogs kyis dpog par nus/gsung chos gsan yul gyi bla ma de dag spyir mtshan nyid dang ldan pa sha stag yin yang /dam pa nyid dang lung rtogs kyi yon tan mnyam pa dang / mi mnyam pa ci rigs mchis mod/ chos 'brel gsan pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan sha stag brjod pa las/ma

300 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen ngo/'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa dad pa dang brnyas smod sogs zhar yang mi mdzad/ zhal nas kyang bla ma rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha'i drung nas lam rim gyi bshes gnyen bsten tshul skor rang gi snang ba la nges pa med pa thos stabs/ bla ma dag gi thun mong gi mdzad pa ci ltar bstan kyang / thugs la mi bde ba yong gi mi 'dug ces skyong blar gsungs/ mgon po nyid gzhan la chos 'chad spel gyi bya ba rgya chen po bdag gir bzhes zin pa'i rjes shig la/ gang la dkyil 'khor gyi bri thig 'khrid par mdzad mkhan rgyud stod sngags rams pa blo bzang nyi mas/ gsol tshigs kyi gong du dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mdo tshar re gsung ba gal che tshul zhus pa phyin chad de bzhin mdzad pa sogs bla ma grwa rkyang sogs su 'dra zhig yin kyang / de dag gi gsung ras su mi bor bar/ ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par mdzad/ sku gzhon nu'i skabs rje pha ྅peng kha pa sogs kyi mdun nas 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa dang /lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang / bskyed rdzogs bcas gsan/ thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i sgo nas gzhan la 'chad spel rgya chen po mdzad mus de ltar yang / sku tshe'i smad la lha mchog de nyid kyi las rung gi bsnyen pa bskyar du mdzad rgyu'i thugs bzhed byung bar/ rdor gdan du 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che'i mdun nas bka' dbang de dag bskyar du gsan pa nas bzung thog ma'i gsan yul rje pha bong kha pa'i mtshan bstod kyi rjes su/ khri byang rin po che'i mtshan bstod gsar rtsom gnang ste gsungs par mdzad pa phyag bris shig tu gsal/de tsam du ma zad/ snumis 'brel gsan pa'i bla ma/ tshang ma'i mtshan sngags gsol 'debs phyag bstar mas bri gnang mdzad de nyin re bzhin gsungs pas mtshon/ tshigs bcad gcig tsam gsan pa thams cad la khyad par med par/ sangs rgyas dngos su lta ba dang / bka' drin dran pa'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsten par mdzad/ lung gi skor gsan rgya de tsam mi che yang / dbang dang / lhag par khrid kyi skor gsan rgya che/ de dag kyang sgrub pa lhur bzhes kyi thugs 'dun drag 1/sa gresan tshul/ zhal nas/ kho sngo/sa bka' chos zhu skabs/

mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 3()/nga tsho 'dra bas gzhan la phar ga 'dra byas nas 'chad thub bsam gyi sku/da stabs/ dbang chog gang gi steng nas gnang min sogs rjes sor brag ri rin po che sogs chos grogs rnams la 'dri rtsad byed dgos byung tshul phebs/ gsan skabs kyang / spyan dmigs gnang rgyu sogs la ha cang thugs zhib tshags pa dper na/ de sngon skyabs rje khang sar rin po che'i mdun nas bde mchog ྅i pa'i bka' dbang gsan te gsung bshad zin bris kyang bzhugs mod/ spyan dmigs mdzad tshul 'di ltar gnang ba yin zhes thugs dran ma sos par brten/lha mchog 'di nyid kyi las rung gnang nye'i skabs skyabs rje khri byang rin po che'i mdun nas bka' dbang gsan par mdzad pas shes par nus/ mkhas pa'i sku na tan ni/ de sngon gdan sar slob gnyer mdzad skabs kyang / rtsod rigs bzang ba'i tshad du brtsi/ rtags gsal phar gnang ba dang / lan gnang ba sogs gang gi skabs kyang gzhan gyi spobs pa rmeg med du ba3)ma pa'i lo rgyus mang po de skabs kyi mkhas pa mang pos gleng / mtshan rtags grub nas kyang / zhal 'don dang mjal kha zhu mkhan sku gas med skabs phyag dpe sha stag thugs zhib gnang ba'i rkyen gyis/ mdo sngags rig gnas bcas par gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa mchog tu brtas te smra ba'i khyu mchog chen por gyur kyang / phyag dpe sogs mkhyen mkhan yin pa'i khur gtan nas mi bzhes par/ slob ma gzhan dag gis gzhung don gtan la 'bebs tshul/ nyams len byed tshul sogs kyi bka' 'dri zhus skabs/ nyid dang lhan du bla ma dang / dge bshes sogs bzhugs yod tshe/ thog mar de dag dang bka' bsdur mdzad/ de dag gis mtha' chod pa'i lan ma byung na/ dam pa nyid nas 'di dang 'di ltar zhes gsung chodag sku da/ thugs g.yeng ba sogs kyi skabs 'ga' zhig la/ thugs nang gtsang yul slob ma dag la/ gzhung lugs 'di dang 'di 'dra zhig tu 'di ltar bshad ces shog grangs yig phreng tshun chad gsal por gsungs pa de dang de bzhin du gnas/ rjes sor sku na mthon por phebs nas kyang / mkhas pa'i g.yer thon pa 'ga' shas sku mdun du bcar

301 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sbrul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa skabs mdo sngags kyi dka' gnad las brtsams pa'i bgro gleng mdzad de mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin dgos pa byung tshul zer zhing / chos rwa 'grims bzhin pa'i skabs dang mtshungs par gzhung la thugs nges che zhing / phyag dpe 'ga' zhig lo mang ring thugs zhib ma gnang yang gsung chog chog lta bur yod pa ni mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa'i rtags su mngon/btsun pa'i yon tan gyi dbang du byas na/ sdom pa len pa la dpa' ba tsam min par/ bsrung bya'i gnas mtha' dag la sgro 'dogs chod de thugs nges yod mus kyang / gung thang gsung sdom gsum bslab bya'i sgyu ma tshig rgyun gyi zhal 'don gzigs dpe'i gras su bzhugs pa dang / dka' chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi gsung sems dang sems byung gi sdom tshig gi ma'agrel gnyis ka phyag dpe 'bral spangs lta bur gnang / thun dang thun mtshams thams cad du/ rang gi sems la yang yang brtag nas nyon mongs gang skyes pa de dang de'i gnyen po 'phral 'phral du bsten pa ni/ dge sbyor thams cad kyi gtso bo dang dam par rang nyid kyis 'dzin cing / gzhan la yang de ltar byed dgos pa 'doms par mdzad/ gzhan yang zla ba re re'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu la dpa' bo gcig pa dang / mar ngo'i tshes nyer lnga la rnal 'byor ma'i bdag 'jug 'char can bzhes/ nyin re bzhin du rdor sems bsgom bzlas dang 'brel ba'i yig brgya/ dpa' gcig gi dbang bzhi rgyas pa yang chag med mdzad de brgya la nyes pa phra mos gos kyang / de dag dang zhag tu mi 'grogs pa'i sngon gyi dam pa gong ma dag gi rnam thar bdag gir bzhes/ bzang wa'i yon tan ni/ dben pa'i ri khrod du bzhugs rgyu'i thugs 'dun che mod/ rjes sor kho wa'i rigs bdag tu bzhengs stabs/ gung seng sogs kyi skabs ma gtogs/ phal cher kho wa'i sdod gnas nor gling dang / rtse pho brang du bzhugs dbo sa byung na yang mi dgyes par med par/ mjal kha zhu mkhan sogs med na/ zhal 'don gnang ba'am/ phyag dpe gzigs pa sogs gang rung gis dus 'dang bar mdzad/ zhal 'asnga na rnams kyang mgyogs chos mi mdzad par/ cho ga'i tshig ris dang mthun

mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 303par spyan dmigs mdzad/ spyan dmigs gsal po yong ched skabs 'gar thad ma'i cho ga'i tshig gam/ lha'i sngags sogs thengs bzhi lnga tsam ldab skyor gnang / de sngon bod du rtse pho brang du bde mchog lū i pa'i las bsnyen gnang skabs bdag bskyed gcig pu gsungs pa la chu tshod gsum tsam 'gor gyi yod pa gong du bshad zin pa ltar/ phyag las thams cad la ha cang gi thugs zhib tshags chen po gnang mkhan zhig red/ sku gzhon pa'i skabs su brkyang phyag 'bum gcig mdzad pa ma zad/ sku na mthon por phebs te sku gzugs ljid por gyur kyang / snga dgong sku phyag lan gsum re gnang / thun drug sogs kyi skabs maṇ+ḍal yang phyag bstar mas 'bul ba sku gas bsags sbyangs la yang brtson pa rgya chen po mdzad pa gzhir bzung ste/ thos bsam sgom pa ya ma bral bar chu wa'i rgyun bzhin du bsnyu na par mdzad pa'i mthus snying rje chen po sogs thugs rgyud la 'khrungs zin pa'i rang rtags gsal por mchodang tshul gong du bshad zin pa ltar dang / gzhan yang masngo na shes mnga' ba'i rgyu mtshan gzhan dag gcig ni/ dgongs pa gzhan don du ma gshegs gong zla ba gcig tsam gyi sngon du/ dgong mo chu tshod bcu gcig tsam la zhabs khongs rgyud stod dge dkon mchog bstan 'dzin la glo bur du khyed rang gi shag tu kun ma shor mi 'dug gam ltos shig ces phebs pa ltar 'phral du phyin par kun mas sgra sdud 'khor lo sogs ca dngos gang 'tshams shig 'khyer te phyi rol tu thon zin pa zhabs phyi 'ga' zhig gis mthong / rgyu 'bras mi 'chol ba'i stobs kyis thugs dam nyams bzhes 'di lta bu gnang mkhan la sngags kyi rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs pa rigs pas sgrub rgyu yod pa zhig kyang red/ nang du yon tan khyad par can mnga' ba'i stobs kyis chos srung dag kyang bran du bkol ba'i rtags su/ de sngon sgar pa ri khrod du g.yang sgrub gnang skabs rgyud stod nas chog grwa dge ngag lhun dang / mchod g.yog pa dge tshul khrims gnyis phebs par/ g.yang sgrub gnang grub pa'i nyin gnas chung rgi sku phebs 'dra sku ha cang ngo mtshar can zhig yod pa de'i na bza' rdul sprugs byed skabs

304 4skyabs rje yongs 'dzig gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen ngo 'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa sku spang phran bu mtho tsam sgron gnang yod b.lo ra dase/ tshul khrims nas sku spang mtho drag tshul zhus par sku rtsed kyis rnam pas do nub khyed rang sar phebs kyi red gsungs pa bzhin nam phyed yol tsam la kho rang nyal sa'i 'gram du spos gzhong lcog rtse lta bu chen po zhig yod pa de'i steng glo bur tshag sgra ha cang gi chen po zhig byung ste gnyid har sad kyis zhed snang chen po byung skabs/ de ma thag rin po che nas gsungs pa ltar chos skyong btang gnang pa yin 'dug bsams te sems la dga' spro dang / dad pa yang sngar lhag skyes lugs brjod pa'i gnas tshul gleng / gzhan yang / 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug dpal ldan dmag zor ma lta bus kyang / mgon po gang gi gzi brjid ma bzod par dgongs bstun zhus pa'i gnas tshul mjo nga yang 'dir smra ba skabs su ma babs/ 'jam mgon chodas kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen sngo'i bzhed srol dri ma med pa rang gis 'dzin cing gzhan la spel bar mdzad kyang / chos tshul gzhan dang / de dag gi ston pa po la/ brnyas smod dang zur za sogs nam yang mi mdzad/ mchog dman su 'dra zhig bcar kyang 'dzum pa'i zhal gyis khyodan bsus te 'tshams 'dri dang / bka' lan lhug por bstsal ba las/ mthong chung khyad gsod rigs gtan nas mi mdzad/ yang yang mjal bcar zhus na lo re bzhin sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan mthong che ru 'gro thub pa zhig dang / bla ma rdo rje 'chang nas thugs gtad zin pa rnams la gnas tshul mtho dma' ji ltar gyur kyang / 'gyur ldog gtan nas med pa ri lta bur bzhugs pa tshang mas mngon sum du gyur/ sku phreng du mar 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi la gnas par goms pa'i lha/bas kyis/ na bza' dang gsol tshigs sogs sku bcar zhabs zhu rnams nas dang blangs gzengs bstod zhus pa las/ nyid kyis 'di dang 'di lta bu dgos zhes nam yang mi gsungs/ mdor na sku chas 'di lta bu la chags pa'am/ nye dga' phyogs lhung mdzad pa'i rigs lo mang bcar ba'i thugs 'dris can gyi slob ma dang / zhabs 'bring sus kyang gleng du med pa zhig bzhugs/ yang phyag dpe gsar du ljags rtsom skyabs 'jug zhu

mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 3(15mkhan rnams la/ deng sang thos bsam byed mkhan gyis phongs pa ma gtogs/ thos bsam bya byed dpe chas phongs pa mi 'dug ces gsar rtsom zhal bzhes de tsam ma gnang stabs gsung rtsom rigs ha cang khyon che ma mchis snu da/ gsung rtsom gang gnang ba de dag tshig don phun sum tshogs pa mkhas pa dgyes pa'i legs bshad sha stag bzhugs/ ljags lung gnang skabs/ sgra dag cing tshig gsal ba/ ma chodar ba bcas gtsor 'don las mkhyodags chos mi mdzad/ nyams khrid dang myong khrid sogs gnang skabs bshad pa bzhi bshad gnang rgyu sogs thodang ma dag gi phyag bzhes dang gsung rgyun gtso bor mdzad/ bshad khrid skabs gzhung lugs chen po dag gi dka' gnad che sar lung rigs kyi spros bshad zab cing rgya che ba mdzad de/ gnyis pa ltar 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig ched/ li ma'i thub dbang sku dang / srung mdud smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor bcas phul/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi bzhugs gnas su yang srid ngos 'dzin dngos phebs zin stabs shin tu dga' spro dang bcas de nyin dgung tshigs chung srid rin po che dang lhan du bgyis skabs gsol zas phyag gis bzhes te kho bor dgyis mnyes kyis gnang / de rjes kho bo phyir log skabs mo ṭor nang dbu gtugs zhus par phran gyi gzan nas bzung ste rjes bsnyegs mdzad rtsis gnang pa ni/ maba'i bla ma de nyid kyis tshe rabs kun tu 'bral ba med par dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ba'i rtags mtshan du yid ches pa'i dad spro'i spu long g.yos bar gyur/ gzhan yang chung srid rin po che'i ya mtshan can gyi mdzad pa 'ga' shas dper mtshon pa tsam brjod na/ yang srid gtan 'khel mtshams su bu khyim nas mabo/na khang zhig g.yar te/ der gdan zhus thog bla brang gi rten 'byung mdzad sgo'i skabs bzhes 'bras steng nas rgun 'brum zhig bzhes te mdzod par gnang / gzhan zhig nas phul ba'i rten dod lhan sgor lnga dang / mjal dar bcas kho rang gi ma ma bsam 'grub sgrol mar gnang / nyin dang po'i dgong mor sku gong ma'i gzim chas sgron 'bul zhu skabs skar ma lnga tsam ring thugs skyo snang dang 'brel spyan chab kyang bsil/ de'i sngon la mdzod pa bu gso khang nas bla brang du phyir log skabs lhan phebs gnang rtsis kyis phyag gnyis mdzod pa'i mjing par 'tham bzhugs par/ ma ma nas thabs shes sna tshogs kyis gdan zhu bgyid dgos byung ba ma zad/khri byang bla brang gi mdzod pa dpal ldan mjal bcar skabs de 'phral pang par phebs te dgyes mnyes dang 'brel khong nas 7skyabs rje khri byang sku gong ma'i sku gdung zhugs 'bul zhus

mchog sprul yang srid brtag dpyad ngos 'dzin ji ltar zhus pa dang / ya mtshan can gyi 329te kho bo'i 'dra dpar la gnang / der bzhugs 7skyabs rje song ma'i 'dra sku yod par mdzod pas su red zhus par/ bzhad mo bzhad de zhal gcus te bzhugs/ yang rdor gdan du bla brang gi zhabs kho ngas ka smad blo bzang bsam gtan sus si nas 'byor bar rin po ches me tog ser chen zhig gnang ste lam seng ngo shes lta bu gnang / kho rang gis phul ba'i dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi rdzas gras rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi rtags ma'i rtser kho tho'i 'dra dpar yod pa gcig dang / 'jam dbyangs kyi sku dpar sgor sgor gcig yod pa phyag tu bzhes/ na bza'i g.yas su rnam bcu dbang ldan dang / g.yon du 'jam dbyangs kyi sku dpar 'dogs su bcug pa sogs la gzhigs na/ sngon gnas rjes dran gyi yon tan dang ldan pa lta bur mngon zhing / rin po che'i yum 'das grongs rjes d+dha sa bu khyim du bcol bzhag ltar bzhugs skabs shig la yab bzang po bu chung thug 'phrad du phrin te de'i zhor gling bla brang du sku gdung rin po cher mjal bcar dang / de nas gnas chung sgra dbyangs gling du 'phrin bcol zin te 'du khang gi sgo 'gram nas smon lam btab par mchod gasna mas su 'char can sku dpar las gzhan med kyang / 7skyabs rje gong ma'i sku dpar mi tshad ma zhig mjal ba'i gnas tshul la gzhigs na sku phreng na rim nas srung ma'i gtso bor bsten pa'i chos skyong nas yang srid 'khrul med yin par lung bstan pa lta bur mngon/ gang ltar bla ma rdo rje 'chang mchog gi yang srid sprul pa'i sku 'di bzhin zhabs pad yun du brtan cing / gzhung lugs rgya mtshor gsan bsam sgom pa legs par mthar son te 7rgyal ba'i bstan la sko na pa gnyis pa lta bu'i mdzad pa skyong bar 'gyur ba'i smon 'dun bgyid bzhin du mchis so//slar smras pa/bzod pa dam pa'i khyi dor brgyas bskrun pa'i/ /mthong na mi mthun bral ba'i mtshan dpe'i sku/ /

330 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad rnam mdo tsam brjod pa bdag sogs bsil ljo ngas skye 'tho'i legs byas kyi/ /mkha' dbyings yangs pa'i thogs na gsal bar shar/ /snrib bsdun spyi dang 'jam dpal snying po yi/ /sting rtogs pad tshal /ma par bzhad pa'i phyir/ /༄ rmāl kun 'asdin sdus gzugs can bzhin gyur pa/ /smra ba'i nyi ma khyod nyid slar yang dran/ /ring mo zhig nas thos bsam sgom pa yi/ /rin chen gser gyi them skas la brten nas/ /sku thugs zung 'jug gzhal med pho brang du/ /rgyal ba gzhan dang mnyam pa nyid kyis rol/ /de lta na yang rnam grol don gnyer la/ /blang dor lam gyi 'jug ngogs bstan pa'i phyir/ /gsan bsam sgom pa'i brtson pa lhur bzhes pa/ /'phags chen dam pa rnams kyi sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /bcu phrag gnyis dang dgu las lhag pa'i bshes/ /zla med ded dpon mchog tu legs bkur te/ /gus rtag brtson pa'i gru rdzings la brten nas/ /sngo sa pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol khyod nyid son/ /brgya phrag lung dang rigs pa'i nyag phran gyis/ /rmongs pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga/ /bden gnyis nor 'dzin khyon du bsgrags pa las/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan don gsal bar mdzad/ /

mchog sprul yang srid brtag dpyad ngos 'dzin ji ltar zhus pa dang / ya mtshan can gyi 331dpyad 'jog 'phrul gyi byi dor la brten nas/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i bsam 'phel nor gyi bu/ /sa lam masngo na wa'i rang 'od 'bar ba'i mthus/ /rgyal kun dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs ma6)ga tu snyan/ /byams brtse'i chu khur dkrigs pa'i klong yangs nas/ /mdo sngags zab rgyas dam pa'i chos kyi char/ /ci dgar 'jo ba'i kun bzod sgeg mo'i khyon/ /rtsodags ldan bstan pa'i tshul gyis dog por bskrun/ /nyams 'gyur tshig rgyan 'dab lho nga rab grol zhing / /don bzang gser gyi ze'u 'bru rgod pa yi/ /legs bshad rin chen pad+ma dkar wa'i phreng / /blo gsal mgul pa'i rgyan du'ang khyod kyis sbyin/ /lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i 'phrin las kyi/ /rin chen phung po'i cha shas ji snyed cig /go sla'i tshig gi srad bur legs bstar te/ /rnam thar nor bu'i do shal 'di ltar bskrun/ /'dir 'bad dge bas drin can bshes gnyen gyi/ /bzhed dgongs gcig pu mkha' khyab lus can kun/ /sgrib gnyis g.yul las myur du grol gyur te/ /nges ngo na bla ma'i rgyal sa zin par smon/ /gang gi mchog sprul zla gzhon gsar pa yang / /gong ma'i rnam thar sang ba yongs rdzogs te/ /
